verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape sisaT sirajeeaa aape fun goiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh iko sabadh varatadhaa jo kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddiaaiee gurmukh dhei prabh har paavai soiee ||
verses.translation: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak aaraadhiaa sabh aakhahu dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n gur soiee ||29||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, ""Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!""||29||1||Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soraTh baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਜਿ ਪੂਜਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ ਮੂਏ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: but pooj pooj hi(n)dhoo mooe turak mooe sir naiee ||
verses.translation: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oi le jaare oi le gaadde teree gat dhuhoo na paiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your true state, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅੰਧ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man re sa(n)saar a(n)dh gaheraa ||
verses.translation: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chahu dhis pasario hai jam jevaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਬਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਕਬਿਤਾ ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਦਾਰੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kabit paRe paR kabitaa mooe kapaR kedhaarai jaiee ||
verses.translation: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.

verses.original: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਇਨਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaTaa dhaar dhaar jogee mooe teree gat ineh na paiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharab sa(n)ch sa(n)ch raaje mooe gadd le ka(n)chan bhaaree ||
verses.translation: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bedh paRe paR pa(n)ddit mooe roop dhekh dhekh naaree ||3||
verses.translation: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their own beauty. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin sabhai bigoote dhekhahu nirakh sareeraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ke naam bin kin gat paiee keh upadhes kabeeraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab jareeaai tab hoi bhasam tan rahai kiram dhal khaiee ||
verses.translation: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai iaa tan kee ihai baddaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਈਆ ਫਿਰਤੌ ਫੂਲਿਆ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe bhieeaa firatau fooliaa fooliaa ||
verses.translation: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhas maas uradh mukh rahataa so dhin kaise bhooliaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਠੋਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau madh maakhee tiau saThor ras jor jor dhan keeaa ||
verses.translation: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.

verses.original: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maratee baar leh leh kareeaai bhoot rahan kiau dheeaa ||2||
verses.translation: At the time of death, they shout, ""Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?""||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਆਗੈ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhehuree lau baree naar sa(n)g bhiee aagai sajan suhelaa ||
verses.translation: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.

verses.original: ਮਰਘਟ ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਗੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maraghaT lau sabh log kuTa(n)b bhio aagai ha(n)s akelaa ||3||
verses.translation: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਕੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee pare kaal gras kooaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhooThee maiaa aap ba(n)dhaiaa jiau nalanee bhram sooaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa ||
verses.translation: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaal grasat sabh log siaane uTh pa(n)ddit pai chale niraasaa ||1||
verses.translation: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: man re sario na ekai kaajaa ||
verses.translation: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;

verses.original: ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhajio na raghupat raajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ban kha(n)dd jai jog tap keeno ka(n)dh mool chun khaiaa ||
verses.translation: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

verses.original: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naadhee bedhee sabadhee monee jam ke paTai likhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat naaradhee ridhai na aaiee kaachh koochh tan dheenaa ||
verses.translation: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

verses.original: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raag raaganee ddi(n)bh hoi baiThaa un har peh kiaa leenaa ||3||
verses.translation: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

verses.original: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: pario kaal sabhai jag uoopar maeh likhe bhram giaanee ||
verses.translation: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jan bhe khaalase prem bhagat jeh jaanee ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second House||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਦੁਇ ਲੋਚਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dhui lochan pekhaa ||
verses.translation: With both of my eyes, I look around;

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau har bin aaur na dhekhaa ||
verses.translation: I don't see anything except the Lord.

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nain rahe ra(n)g laiee ||
verses.translation: My eyes gaze lovingly upon Him,

verses.original: ਅਬ ਬੇ ਗਲ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ab be gal kahan na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: and now, I cannot speak of anything else. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa bharam giaa bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: My doubts were removed, and my fear ran away,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab raam naam chit laagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: when my consciousness became attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਡੰਕ ਬਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baajeegar dda(n)k bajaiee ||
verses.translation: When the magician beats his tambourine,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh khalak tamaase aaiee ||
verses.translation: everyone comes to see the show.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੁ ਸਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: baajeegar savaiaa(n)g sakelaa ||
verses.translation: When the magician winds up his show,

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੈ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: apane ra(n)g ravai akelaa ||2||
verses.translation: then he enjoys its play all alone. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee keh bharam na jaiee ||
verses.translation: By preaching sermons, one's doubt is not dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਰਹੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kath kath rahee lukaiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone is tired of preaching and teaching.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau gurmukh aap bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord causes the Gurmukh to understand;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa ke hiradhai rahiaa samaiee ||3||
verses.translation: his heart remains permeated with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur ki(n)chat kirapaa keenee ||
verses.translation: When the Guru grants even a bit of His Grace,

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tan man dheh har leenee ||
verses.translation: one's body, mind and entire being are absorbed into the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love;

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: milio jagajeevan dhaataa ||4||4||
verses.translation: I have met with the Life of the world, the Great Giver. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਠਾਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke nigam dhoodh ke ThaaTaa ||
verses.translation: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,

verses.original: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: samu(n)dh bilovan kau maaTaa ||
verses.translation: and the ocean of the mind the churning vat.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee hoh bilovanahaaree ||
verses.translation: Be the butter-churner of the Lord,

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਗੋ ਛਾਛਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiau meTai go chhaachh tuhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: and your buttermilk shall not be wasted. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਸਿ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheree too raam na karas bhataaraa ||
verses.translation: O soul-bride slave, why don't you take the Lord as your Husband?

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Life of the world, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗਲਹਿ ਤਉਕੁ ਪਗ ਬੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tere galeh tauk pag beree ||
verses.translation: The chain is around your neck, and the cuffs are on your feet.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਰਮਈਐ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too ghar ghar ramieeaai feree ||
verses.translation: The Lord has sent you wandering around from house to house.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too ajahu na chetas cheree ||
verses.translation: And still, you do not meditate on the Lord, O soul-bride, slave.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਮਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too jam bapuree hai heree ||2||
verses.translation: Death is watching you, O wretched woman. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh karan karaavanahaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord God is the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਚੇਰੀ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa cheree haath bichaaree ||
verses.translation: What is in the hands of the poor soul-bride, the slave?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: soiee soiee jaagee ||
verses.translation: She awakens from her slumber,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jit laiee tit laagee ||3||
verses.translation: and she becomes attached to whatever the Lord attaches her. ||3||

verses.original: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: cheree tai sumat kahaa(n) te paiee ||
verses.translation: O soul-bride, slave, where did you obtain that wisdom,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te bhram kee leek miTaiee ||
verses.translation: by which you erased your inscription of doubt?

verses.original: ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: s ras kabeerai jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Kabeer has tasted that subtle essence;

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: mero gur prasaadh man maaniaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, his mind is reconciled with the Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਜੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh baajh na jeeaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without Him, we cannot even live;

verses.original: ਜਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਘਾਲ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jau milai ta ghaal aghaiee ||
verses.translation: when we meet Him, then our task is completed.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਲੋ ਕਹਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadh jeevan bhalo kahaa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: People say it is good to live forever,

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mooe bin jeevan naahee ||1||
verses.translation: but without dying, there is no life. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab kiaa katheeaai giaan beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: So now, what sort wisdom should I contemplate and preach?

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਗਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nij nirakhat gat biauhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As I watch, worldly things dissipate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਸਿ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਗਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghas ku(n)kam cha(n)dhan gaariaa ||
verses.translation: Saffron is ground up, and mixed with sandalwood;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin nainahu jagat nihaariaa ||
verses.translation: without eyes, the world is seen.

verses.original: ਪੂਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poot pitaa ik jaiaa ||
verses.translation: The son has given birth to his father;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin Thaahar nagar basaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: without a place, the city has been established. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaachak jan dhaataa paiaa ||
verses.translation: The humble beggar has found the Great Giver,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so dheeaa na jaiee khaiaa ||
verses.translation: but he is unable to eat what he has been given.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੂਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddiaa jai na mookaa ||
verses.translation: He cannot leave it alone, but it is never exhausted.

verses.original: ਅਉਰਨ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਨਾ ਚੂਕਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aauran peh jaanaa chookaa ||3||
verses.translation: He shall not go to beg from others any longer. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥ ਸੋ ਪੰਚ ਸੈਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jeevan maranaa jaanai || so pa(n)ch sail sukh maanai ||
verses.translation: Those select few, who know how to die while yet alive, enjoy great peace.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kabeerai so dhan paiaa ||
verses.translation: Kabeer has found that wealth;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: har bheTat aap miTaiaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: meeting with the Lord, he has erased his self-conceit. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਪੜੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa paReeaai kiaa guneeaai ||
verses.translation: What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa bedh puraanaa(n) suneeaai ||
verses.translation: What use is it to listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas?

verses.original: ਪੜੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: paRe sune kiaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: What use is reading and listening,

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸਹਜ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau sahaj na milio soiee ||1||
verses.translation: if celestial peace is not attained? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam na japas gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa socheh baara(n) baaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So what does he think of, over and over again? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਚਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhiaare dheepak chaheeaai ||
verses.translation: In the darkness, we need a lamp

verses.original: ਇਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: eik basat agochar laheeaai ||
verses.translation: to find the incomprehensible thing.

verses.original: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: basat agochar paiee ||
verses.translation: I have found this incomprehensible thing;

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT dheepak rahiaa samaiee ||2||
verses.translation: my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know Him;

verses.original: ਜਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab jaaniaa tau man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man maane log na pateejai ||
verses.translation: My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.

verses.original: ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: n pateejai tau kiaa keejai ||3||7||
verses.translation: They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||

verses.original: ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮੁਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kapaT mukh giaanee ||
verses.translation: In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਸਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThe kahaa bilovas paanee ||1||
verses.translation: You are false - why are you churning water? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਮਾਂਜਸਿ ਕਉਨ ਗੁਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa maa(n)jas kaun gunaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Why do you bother to wash your body?

verses.original: ਜਉ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਲਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau ghaT bheetar hai malanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your heart is still full of filth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਉਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: laukee aThasaTh teerath n(h)aiee ||
verses.translation: The gourd may be washed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines,

verses.original: ਕਉਰਾਪਨੁ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kauraapan tuoo na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: but even then, its bitterness is not removed. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer after deep contemplation,

verses.original: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: bhav saagar taar muraaree ||3||8||
verses.translation: please help me cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Lord, O Destroyer of ego. ||3||8||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ
verses.translit: soraTh
verses.translation: Sorat'h:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahu parapa(n)ch kar par dhan liaavai ||
verses.translation: Practicing great hypocrisy, he acquires the wealth of others.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਨਿ ਲੁਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sut dhaaraa peh aan luTaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Returning home, he squanders it on his wife and children. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere bhoole kapaT na keejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, do not practice deception, even inadvertently.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t niberaa tere jeea peh leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the end, your own soul shall have to answer for its account. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਜਰਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: chhin chhin tan chheejai jaraa janaavai ||
verses.translation: Moment by moment, the body is wearing away, and old age is asserting itself.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਕ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਨੀਓ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tab teree ok koiee paaneeo na paavai ||2||
verses.translation: And then, when you are old, no one shall pour water into your cup. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer koiee nahee teraa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, no one belongs to you.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: hiradhai raam kee na japeh saveraa ||3||9||
verses.translation: Why not chant the Lord's Name in your heart, when you are still young? ||3||9||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨ ਪਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu man pavanai sukh baniaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kichh jog paraapat ganiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhikhalaiee moree ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the hole,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਪੜਤ ਹੈ ਚੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jit mirag paRat hai choree ||
verses.translation: through which the deer carefully enters.

verses.original: ਮੂੰਦਿ ਲੀਏ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: moo(n)dh le'ee dharavaaje ||
verses.translation: I have now closed off the doors,

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਅਲੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baajeeale anahadh baaje ||1||
verses.translation: and the unstruck celestial sound current resounds. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੁੰਭ ਕਮਲੁ ਜਲਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)bh kamal jal bhariaa ||
verses.translation: The pitcher of my heart-lotus is filled with water;

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਊਭਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal meTiaa uoobhaa kariaa ||
verses.translation: I have spilled out the water, and set it upright.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jan jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant, this I know.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jau jaaniaa tau man maaniaa ||2||10||
verses.translation: Now that I know this, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||10||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
verses.translit: raag soraTh ||
verses.translation: Raag Sorat'h:

verses.original: ਭੂਖੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhookhe bhagat na keejai ||
verses.translation: I am so hungry, I cannot perform devotional worship service.

verses.original: ਯਹ ਮਾਲਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: yeh maalaa apanee leejai ||
verses.translation: Here, Lord, take back Your mala.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau maa(n)gau sa(n)tan renaa ||
verses.translation: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai naahee kisee kaa dhenaa ||1||
verses.translation: I do not owe anyone anything. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧੋ ਕੈਸੀ ਬਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: maadho kaisee banai tum sa(n)ge ||
verses.translation: O Lord, how can I be with You?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਵਉ ਮੰਗੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap na dheh ta levau ma(n)ge || rahaau ||
verses.translation: If You do not give me Yourself, then I shall beg until I get You. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਸੇਰ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚੂਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhui ser maa(n)gau choonaa ||
verses.translation: I ask for two kilos of flour,

verses.original: ਪਾਉ ਘੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੂਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paau gheeau sa(n)g loonaa ||
verses.translation: and half a pound of ghee, and salt.

verses.original: ਅਧ ਸੇਰੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: adh ser maa(n)gau dhaale ||
verses.translation: I ask for a pound of beans,

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੋਨਉ ਵਖਤ ਜਿਵਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mo kau dhonau vakhat jivaale ||2||
verses.translation: which I shall eat twice a day. ||2||

verses.original: ਖਾਟ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khaaT maa(n)gau chaupaiee ||
verses.translation: I ask for a cot, with four legs,

verses.original: ਸਿਰਹਾਨਾ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sirahaanaa avar tulaiee ||
verses.translation: and a pillow and mattress.

verses.original: ਊਪਰ ਕਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਖੀਂਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar kau maa(n)gau khee(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: I ask for a quilt to cover myself.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਥਂੀਧਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat karai jan tha(n)eedhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Your humble servant shall perform Your devotional worship service with love. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਲਬੋ ॥
verses.translit: mai naahee keetaa labo ||
verses.translation: I have no greed;

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਫਬੋ ॥
verses.translit: eik naau teraa mai fabo ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the only ornament I wish for.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and appeased;

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: man maaniaa tau har jaaniaa ||4||11||
verses.translation: now that my mind is pleased and appeased, I have come to know the Lord. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag soraTh baanee bhagat naamadhe jee kee ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਬ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhekhaa tab gaavaa ||
verses.translation: When I see Him, I sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜਨ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau jan dheeraj paavaa ||1||
verses.translation: Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੋ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naadh samailo re satigur bheTile dhevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਝਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jhil mil kaar dhisa(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Where the dazzling white light is seen,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh anahadh sabadh baja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: One's light merges in the Light;

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai gur parasaadhee jaanee ||2||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੋਠਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ratan kamal koTharee ||
verses.translation: The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.

verses.original: ਚਮਕਾਰ ਬੀਜੁਲ ਤਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: chamakaar beejul tahee ||
verses.translation: They sparkle and glitter like lightning.

verses.original: ਨੇਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nerai naahee dhoor ||
verses.translation: The Lord is near at hand, not far away.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij aatamai rahiaa bharapoor ||3||
verses.translation: He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਸੂਰ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh anahat soor ujayeaaraa ||
verses.translation: Where the light of the undying sun shines,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਲੈ ਛੰਛਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh dheepak jalai chha(n)chhaaraa ||
verses.translation: the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I know this.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naamaa sahaj samaaniaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ੪ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar chauthhaa soraTh ||
verses.translation: Fourth House, Sorat'h:

verses.original: ਪਾੜ ਪੜੋਸਣਿ ਪੂਛਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਈ ਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: paaR paRosan poochh le naamaa kaa peh chhaan chhavaiee ho ||
verses.translation: The woman next door asked Naam Dayv, ""Who built your house?

verses.original: ਤੋ ਪਹਿ ਦੁਗਣੀ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਦੈਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: to peh dhuganee majooree dhaihau mo kau beddee dheh bataiee ho ||1||
verses.translation: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?""||1||

verses.original: ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ree baiee beddee dhen na jaiee ||
verses.translation: O sister, I cannot give this carpenter to you.

verses.original: ਦੇਖੁ ਬੇਢੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh beddee rahio samaiee ||
verses.translation: Behold, my carpenter is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamaarai beddee praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My carpenter is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਵੈ ਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: beddee preet majooree maa(n)gai jau kouoo chhaan chhavaavai ho ||
verses.translation: This carpenter demands the wages of love, if someone wants Him to build their house.

verses.original: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਹੁ ਤੇ ਤੋਰੈ ਤਉ ਆਪਨ ਬੇਢੀ ਆਵੈ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: log kuTa(n)b sabhahu te torai tau aapan beddee aavai ho ||2||
verses.translation: When one breaks his ties with all the people and relatives, then the carpenter comes of His own accord. ||2||

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਬੇਢੀ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso beddee baran na saakau sabh a(n)tar sabh Thaa(n)iee ho ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe such a carpenter, who is contained in everything, everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: goo(n)gai mahaa a(n)mirat ras chaakhiaa poochhe kahan na jaiee ho ||3||
verses.translation: The mute tastes the most sublime ambrosial nectar, but if you ask him to describe it, he cannot. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੇਢੀ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਜਲਧਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: beddee ke gun sun ree baiee jaladh baa(n)dh dhraoo thaapio ho ||
verses.translation: Listen to the virtues of this carpenter, O sister; He stopped the oceans, and established Dhroo as the pole star.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੀਅ ਬਹੋਰੀ ਲੰਕ ਭਭੀਖਣ ਆਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naame ke suaamee seea bahoree la(n)k bhabheekhan aapio ho ||4||2||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's Lord Master brought Sita back, and gave Sri Lanka to Bhabheekhan. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third House:

verses.original: ਅਣਮੜਿਆ ਮੰਦਲੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: anamaRiaa ma(n)dhal baajai ||
verses.translation: The skinless drum plays.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਵਣ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin saavan ghanahar gaajai ||
verses.translation: Without the rainy season, the clouds shake with thunder.

verses.original: ਬਾਦਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਰਖਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: baadhal bin barakhaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without clouds, the rain falls,

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau tat bichaarai koiee ||1||
verses.translation: if one contemplates the essence of reality. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau milio raam sanehee ||
verses.translation: I have met my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh miliaai dheh sudhehee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Him, my body is made beauteous and sublime. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil paaras ka(n)chan hoiaa ||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, I have been transformed into gold.

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਮਨਸਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukh manasaa ratan paroiaa ||
verses.translation: I have threaded the jewels into my mouth and mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਭਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: nij bhaau bhiaa bhram bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: I love Him as my own, and my doubt has been dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poochhe man pateeaagaa ||2||
verses.translation: Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੁੰਭ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal bheetar ku(n)bh samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The water is contained within the pitcher;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh raam ek kar jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I know that the One Lord is contained in all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur chele hai man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: The mind of the disciple has faith in the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਮੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naamai tat pachhaaniaa ||3||3||
verses.translation: Servant Naam Dayv understands the essence of reality. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag soraTh baanee bhagat ravidhaas jee kee
verses.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੂਹੀ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab ham hote tab too naahee ab toohee mai naahee ||
verses.translation: When I am in my ego, then You are not with me. Now that You are with me, there is no egotism within me.

verses.original: ਅਨਲ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਇ ਓਦਧਿ ਜਲ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਲ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anal agam jaise lahar mi odhadh jal keval jal maa(n)hee ||1||
verses.translation: The wind may raise up huge waves in the vast ocean, but they are just water in water. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਐਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: maadhave kiaa kaheeaai bhram aaisaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, what can I say about such an illusion?

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa maaneeaai hoi na taisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Things are not as they seem. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਭਇਆ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: narapat ek si(n)ghaasan soiaa supane bhiaa bhikhaaree ||
verses.translation: It is like the king, who falls asleep upon his throne, and dreams that he is a beggar.

verses.original: ਅਛਤ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: achhat raaj bichhurat dhukh paiaa so gat bhiee hamaaree ||2||
verses.translation: His kingdom is intact, but separated from it, he suffers in sorrow. Such is my own condition. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਜਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raaj bhuia(n)g prasa(n)g jaise heh ab kachh maram janaiaa ||
verses.translation: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anik kaTak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kahan na aaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe ek anekai suaamee sabh ghaT bhuogavai soiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas haath pai nerai sahaje hoi su hoiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, will be. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jau ham baa(n)dhe moh faas ham prem badhan tum baadhe ||
verses.translation: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apane chhooTan ko jatan karahu ham chhooTe tum aaraadhe ||1||
verses.translation: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਹਹੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੈਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: maadhave jaanat hahu jaisee taisee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You know my love for You.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁਗੇ ਐਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab kahaa karahuge aaisee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਰਿ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਰਾਂਧਿ ਕੀਓ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: meen pakar faa(n)kio ar kaaTio raa(n)dh keeo bahu baanee ||
verses.translation: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਊ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kar bhojan keeno tuoo na bisario paanee ||2||
verses.translation: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh paTal sabh jagat biaapio bhagat nahee sa(n)taapaa ||3||
verses.translation: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas bhagat ik baaddee ab ieh kaa siau kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraadhe so dhukh ajahoo saheeaai ||4||2||
verses.translation: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhulabh janam pu(n)n fal paio birathaa jaat abibekai ||
verses.translation: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raaje i(n)dhr samasar gireh aasan bin har bhagat kahahu keh lekhai ||1||
verses.translation: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions and thrones like those of King Indra? ||1||

verses.original: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: n beechaario raajaa raam ko ras ||
verses.translation: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ras an ras beesar jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਨਿ ਅਜਾਨ ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ ਦਿਵਸ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaan ajaan bhe ham baavar soch asoch dhivas jaahee ||
verses.translation: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree sabal nibal bibek budh paramaarath paraves nahee ||2||
verses.translation: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no access to the supreme objective. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੀਅਤ ਆਨ ਅਚਰੀਅਤ ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaheeat aan achareeat an kachh samajh na parai apar maiaa ||
verses.translation: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do not understand anything.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas udhaas dhaas mat parahar kop karahu jeea dhiaa ||3||3||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare me Your anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar suratar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke ||
verses.translation: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT dhasaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa ke ||1||
verses.translation: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har har na japeh rasanaa ||
verses.translation: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar sabh tiaag bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਖਰ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa khiaan puraan bedh bidh chautees akhar maa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty-four letters.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਸ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: biaas bichaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
verses.translation: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat fun baddai bhaag liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from their entanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas pragaas ridhai dhar janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||4||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth and death shall run away from you. ||3||4||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jau tum girivar tau ham moraa ||
verses.translation: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau tum cha(n)dh tau ham bhe hai chakoraa ||1||
verses.translation: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਤੋਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maadhave tum na torahu tau ham nahee toreh ||
verses.translation: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum siau tor kavan siau joreh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਵਰਾ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jau tum dheevaraa tau ham baatee ||
verses.translation: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jau tum teerath tau ham jaatee ||2||
verses.translation: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachee preet ham tum siau joree ||
verses.translation: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum siau jor avar sa(n)g toree ||3||
verses.translation: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh jaau tahaa teree sevaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, there I serve You.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tum so Thaakur aaur na dhevaa ||4||
verses.translation: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਂਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumare bhajan kaTeh jam faa(n)saa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhagat het gaavai ravidhaasaa ||5||5||
verses.translation: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal kee bheet pavan kaa tha(n)bhaa rakat bu(n)dh kaa gaaraa ||
verses.translation: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.

verses.original: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜਂੀ ਕੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haadd maas naaRa(n)ee ko pi(n)jar pa(n)khee basai bichaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells within it. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: praanee kiaa meraa kiaa teraa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕੰਧ ਉਸਾਰਹੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: raakhahu ka(n)dh usaarahu neevaa(n) ||
verses.translation: You lay the foundation and build the walls.

verses.original: ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੀਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadde teen haath teree seevaa(n) ||2||
verses.translation: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੰਕੇ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)ke baal paag sir dderee ||
verses.translation: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਭਸਮ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih tan hoigo bhasam kee dderee ||3||
verses.translation: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: uooche ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar naaree ||
verses.translation: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin baajee haaree ||4||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree jaat kameenee paa(n)t kameenee ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: tum saranaagat raajaa raam cha(n)dh keh ravidhaas chamaaraa ||5||6||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||

verses.original: ਚਮਰਟਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਜਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: chamaraTaa gaa(n)Th na janiee ||
verses.translation: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

verses.original: ਲੋਗੁ ਗਠਾਵੈ ਪਨਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: log gaThaavai panahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਤੋਪਉ ॥
verses.translit: aar nahee jeh topau ||
verses.translation: I have no awl to stitch them;

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਰਾਂਬੀ ਠਾਉ ਰੋਪਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nahee raa(n)bee Thaau ropau ||1||
verses.translation: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||

verses.original: ਲੋਗੁ ਗੰਠਿ ਗੰਠਿ ਖਰਾ ਬਿਗੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: log ga(n)Th ga(n)Th kharaa bigoochaa ||
verses.translation: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਂਠੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau bin gaa(n)The jai pahoochaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas japai raam naamaa ||
verses.translation: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: moh jam siau naahee kaamaa ||3||7||
verses.translation: he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag soraTh baanee bhagat bheekhan kee
verses.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu neer bahai tan kheenaa bhe kes dhudh vaanee ||
verses.translation: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky-white.

verses.original: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roodhaa ka(n)Th sabadh nahee ucharai ab kiaa kareh paraanee ||1||
verses.translation: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a mere mortal. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੋਹਿ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam rai hoh baidh banavaaree ||
verses.translation: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apane sa(n)teh leh ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਕ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maathe peer sareer jalan hai karak kareje maahee ||
verses.translation: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਉਪਜਿ ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaisee bedhan upaj kharee bhiee vaa kaa aaukhadh naahee ||2||
verses.translation: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam a(n)mirat jal niramal ih aaukhadh jag saaraa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kahai jan bheekhan paavau mokh dhuaaraa ||3||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam ratan niramolak pu(n)n padhaarath paiaa ||
verses.translation: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar hiradhai raakhiaa ratan na chhapai chhapaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden by hiding it. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun kahate kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise goo(n)ge kee miThiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ramat sunat sukh sravanaa chit chete sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they find peace and comfort.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਭੀਖਨ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu bheekhan dhui nain sa(n)tokhe jeh dhekhaa(n) teh soiee ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਡਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau ddarat hai aapanaa kai siau karee pukaar ||
verses.translation: My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh visaaran seviaa sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar ||1||
verses.translation: I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੀਤ ਨਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa neet navaa sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin saahib seveeaai a(n)t chhaddaae soi ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sun sun meree kaamanee paar utaaraa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal terai naam taraa ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadh kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਬੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saraba(n) saachaa ek hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa kee sevaa so kare jaa kau nadhar kare ||3||
verses.translation: He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh baajh piaare kev rahaa ||
verses.translation: Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?

verses.original: ਸਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: saa vaddiaaiee dheh jit naam tere laag rahaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa naahee koi jis aagai piaare jai kahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਚੰਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sevee saahib aapanaa avar na jaacha(n)au koi ||
verses.translation: I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kaa dhaas hai bi(n)dh bi(n)dh chukh chukh hoi ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: saahib tere naam viTahu bi(n)dh bi(n)dh chukh chukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਹਾਂ ਇਕ ਦਮੀ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham aadhamee haa(n) ik dhamee muhalat muhat na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: We are human beings of the briefest moment; we do not know the appointed time of our departure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak binavai tisai sarevahu jaa ke jeea paraanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, serve the One, to whom our soul and breath of life belong. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe jeevanaa veechaar dhekh kete ke dhinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are blind - see and consider, how many days your life shall last. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saas maas sabh jeeau tumaaraa too mai kharaa piaaraa ||
verses.translation: My breath, my flesh and my soul are all Yours, Lord; You are so very dear to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਏਵ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sair ev kahat hai sache paravadhagaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak, the poet, says this, O True Lord Cherisher. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਢੈ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: je too kisai na dhehee mere saahibaa kiaa ko kaddai gahanaa ||
verses.translation: If you gave nothing, O my Lord and Master, what could anyone pledge to You?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak binavai so kichh paieeaai purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak prays, we receive that which we are pre-destined to receive. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam khasam kaa chit na keeaa kapaTee kapaT kamaanaa ||
verses.translation: The deceitful person does not remember the Lord's Name; he practices only deceit.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam dhuaar jaa pakaR chalaiaa taa chaladhaa pachhutaanaa ||4||
verses.translation: When he is marched in chains to Death's door, then, he regrets his actions. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag dhuneeaa raheeaai naanak kichh suneeaai kichh kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: As long as we are in this world, O Nanak, we should listen, and speak of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaal rahe ham rahan na paiaa jeevatiaa mar raheeaai ||5||2||
verses.translation: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar dhoojaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਿਵਰਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau simaree sivariaa nahee jai ||
verses.translation: How can I remember the Lord in meditation? I cannot meditate on Him in remembrance.

verses.original: ਤਪੈ ਹਿਆਉ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tapai hiaau jeeaRaa bilalai ||
verses.translation: My heart is burning, and my soul is crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: siraj savaare saachaa soi ||
verses.translation: The True Lord creates and adorns.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis visariaai cha(n)gaa kiau hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting Him, how can one be good? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hikamat hukam na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: By clever tricks and commands, He cannot be found.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar saach milau meree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How am I to meet my True Lord, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vakhar naam dhekhan koiee jai ||
verses.translation: How rare is the one who goes out, and searches for the merchandise of the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko chaakhai naa ko khai ||
verses.translation: No one tastes it, and no one eats it.

verses.original: ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: lok pateenai naa pat hoi ||
verses.translation: Honor is not obtained by trying to please other people.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa pat rahai raakhai jaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: One's honor is preserved, only if the Lord preserves it. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Him, pervading and permeating.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Without You, I have no other place of rest.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kare keetai kiaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He may try, but what can anyone do by his own doing?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase saachaa soi ||3||
verses.translation: He alone is blessed, whom the True Lord forgives. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੁਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਤਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hun uTh chalanaa muhat k taal ||
verses.translation: Now, I shall have to get up and depart, in an instant, in the clapping of hands.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa muh dhesaa gun nahee naal ||
verses.translation: What face will I show the Lord? I have no virtue at all.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee nadhar kare taisaa hoi ||
verses.translation: As is the Lord's Glance of Grace, so it is.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: vin nadharee naanak nahee koi ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: Without His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, no one is blessed. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa simariaa jai ||
verses.translation: If the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one remembers Him in meditation.

verses.original: ਆਤਮਾ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aatamaa dhravai rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: The soul is softened, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਆਤਮਾ ਪਰਾਤਮਾ ਏਕੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aatamaa paraatamaa eko karai ||
verses.translation: His soul and the Supreme Soul become one.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee dhubidhaa a(n)tar marai ||1||
verses.translation: The duality of the inner mind is overcome. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, God is found.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har siau chit laagai fir kaal na khai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One's consciousness is attached to the Lord, and so Death does not devour him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach simariaai hovai paragaas ||
verses.translation: Remembering the True Lord in meditation, one is enlightened.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa te bikhiaa meh rahai udhaas ||
verses.translation: Then, in the midst of Maya, he remains detached.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee aaisee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Such is the Glory of the True Guru;

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr viche gat paiee ||2||
verses.translation: in the midst of children and spouses, they attain emancipation. ||2||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee sevak sevaa karai ||
verses.translation: Such is the service which the Lord's servant performs,

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa jeeau tis aagai dharai ||
verses.translation: that he dedicates his soul to the Lord, to whom it belongs.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahib bhaavai so paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who is pleasing to the Lord and Master is acceptable.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so sevak dharageh paavai maan ||3||
verses.translation: Such a servant obtains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee moorat hiradhai vasaae ||
verses.translation: He enshrines the image of the True Guru in his heart.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhai soiee fal paae ||
verses.translation: He obtains the rewards which he desires.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master grants His Grace;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: so sevak jam te kaisaa ddarai ||4||
verses.translation: how can such a servant be afraid of death? ||4||

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, practice contemplation,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee siau dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: and enshrine love for the True Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa ko paavai mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Then, you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: jap tap sabh ih sabadh hai saar ||5||2||4||
verses.translation: This Shabad is the most excellent of all chanting and austere meditations. ||5||2||4||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਤਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau tapat hai baaro baar ||
verses.translation: My soul burns, over and over again.

verses.original: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tap tap khapai bahut bekaar ||
verses.translation: Burning and burning, it is ruined, and it falls into evil.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jai tan baanee visar jai ||
verses.translation: That body, which forgets the Word of the Guru's Bani,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau pakaa rogee vilalai ||1||
verses.translation: cries out in pain, like a chronic patient. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahutaa bolan jhakhan hoi ||
verses.translation: To speak too much and babble is useless.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vin bole jaanai sabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even without our speaking, He knows everything. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਨ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਖੀ ਨਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kan keete akhee naak ||
verses.translation: He created our ears, eyes and nose.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਤਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin jihavaa dhitee bole taat ||
verses.translation: He gave us our tongue to speak so fluently.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin man raakhiaa aganee pai ||
verses.translation: He preserved the mind in the fire of the womb;

verses.original: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaajai pavan aakhai sabh jai ||2||
verses.translation: at His Command, the wind blows everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਆਦ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa moh pareet suaadh ||
verses.translation: These worldly attachments, loves and pleasurable tastes,

verses.original: ਸਭਾ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗਾ ਦਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: sabhaa kaalakh dhaagaa dhaag ||
verses.translation: all are just black stains.

verses.original: ਦਾਗ ਦੋਸ ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaag dhos muh chaliaa lai ||
verses.translation: One who departs, with these black stains of sin on his face

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharageh baisan naahee jai ||3||
verses.translation: shall find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਖਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karam milai aakhan teraa naau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, we chant Your Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit lag taranaa hor nahee thaau ||
verses.translation: Becoming attached to it, one is saved; there is no other way.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਡੂਬੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: je ko ddoobai fir hovai saar ||
verses.translation: Even if one is drowning, still, he may be saved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saachaa sarab dhaataar ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Giver of all. ||4||3||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: chor salaahe cheet na bheejai ||
verses.translation: If a thief praises someone, his mind is not pleased.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਤਸੂ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: je badhee kare taa tasoo na chheejai ||
verses.translation: If a thief curses him, no damage is done.

verses.original: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chor kee haamaa bhare na koi ||
verses.translation: No one will take responsibility for a thief.

verses.original: ਚੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chor keeaa cha(n)gaa kiau hoi ||1||
verses.translation: How can a thief's actions be good? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੁਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: sun man a(n)dhe kute kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind, you blind, false dog!

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin bole boojheeaai sachiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even without your speaking, the Lord knows and understands. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੋਰੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chor suaaliau chor siaanaa ||
verses.translation: A thief may be handsome, and a thief may be wise,

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਾ ਮੁਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਗਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe kaa mul ek dhugaanaa ||
verses.translation: but he is still just a counterfeit coin, worth only a shell.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਾਥਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je saath rakheeaai dheejai ralai ||
verses.translation: If it is kept and mixed with other coins,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪਰਖੀਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa parakheeaai khoTaa hoi jai ||2||
verses.translation: it will be found to be false, when the coins are inspected. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa kare su taisaa paavai ||
verses.translation: As one acts, so does he receive.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap beej aape hee khaavai ||
verses.translation: As he plants, so does he eat.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je vaddiaaieeaa aape khai ||
verses.translation: He may praise himself gloriously,

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jehee surat tehai raeh jai ||3||
verses.translation: but still, according to his understanding, so is the path he must follow. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਬਾੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: je sau kooReeaa kooR kabaaR ||
verses.translation: He may tell hundreds of lies to conceal his falsehood,

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਖਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavai sabh aakhau sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: and all the world may call him good.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਅਧੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai adhee paravaan ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, Lord, even the foolish are approved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak jaanai jaan sujaan ||4||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is wise, knowing, all-knowing. ||4||4||6||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaagadh man paravaanaa ||
verses.translation: The body is the paper, and the mind is the inscription written upon it.

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੇਖ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sir ke lekh na paRai iaanaa ||
verses.translation: The ignorant fool does not read what is written on his forehead.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਲੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh ghaRe'eh teene lekh ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, three inscriptions are recorded.

verses.original: ਖੋਟਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khoTaa kaam na aavai vekh ||1||
verses.translation: Behold, the counterfeit coin is worthless there. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak je vich rupaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if there is silver in it,

verses.original: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: then everyone proclaims, ""It is genuine, it is genuine.""||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਦੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaadhee kooR bol mal khai ||
verses.translation: The Qazi tells lies and eats filth;

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: braahaman naavai jeeaa ghai ||
verses.translation: the Brahmin kills and then takes cleansing baths.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jogee jugat na jaanai a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Yogi is blind, and does not know the Way.

verses.original: ਤੀਨੇ ਓਜਾੜੇ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teene ojaaRe kaa ba(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: The three of them devise their own destruction. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jogee jo jugat pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Yogi, who understands the Way.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he knows the One Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਉਲਟੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee so jo ulaTee karai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Qazi, who turns away from the world,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai ||
verses.translation: and who, by Guru's Grace, remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so braahaman jo braham beechaarai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who contemplates God.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sagale kul taarai ||3||
verses.translation: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਾਨਸਬੰਦੁ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaanasaba(n)dh soiee dhil dhovai ||
verses.translation: One who cleanses his own mind is wise.

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: musalamaan soiee mal khovai ||
verses.translation: One who cleanses himself of impurity is a Muslim.

verses.original: ਪੜਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaa boojhai so paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who reads and understands is acceptable.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis sir dharageh kaa neesaan ||4||5||7||
verses.translation: Upon his forehead is the Insignia of the Court of the Lord. ||4||5||7||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਢਬੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaal naahee jog naahee naahee sat kaa ddab ||
verses.translation: No, no, this is not the time, when people know the way to Yoga and Truth.

verses.original: ਥਾਨਸਟ ਜਗ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਹੋਏ ਡੂਬਤਾ ਇਵ ਜਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: thaanasaT jag bharisaT hoe ddoobataa iv jag ||1||
verses.translation: The holy places of worship in the world are polluted, and so the world is drowning. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh raam naam saar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਤ ਮੀਟਹਿ ਨਾਕ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਠਗਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: akhee ta meeTeh naak pakaReh Thagan kau sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Some people try to deceive the world by closing their eyes and holding their nostrils closed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਂਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਨਾਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਸੂਝਤੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ॥
verses.translit: aa(n)T setee naak pakaReh soojhate tin loa ||
verses.translation: They close off their nostrils with their fingers, and claim to see the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮਗਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ ਅਲੋਅ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: magar paachhai kachh na soojhai eh padham aloa ||2||
verses.translation: But they cannot even see what is behind them. What a strange lotus pose this is! ||2||

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: khatreeaa ta dharam chhoddiaa malechh bhaakhiaa gahee ||
verses.translation: The K'shatriyas have abandoned their religion, and have adopted a foreign language.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sirasaT sabh ik varan hoiee dharam kee gat rahee ||3||
verses.translation: The whole world has been reduced to the same social status; the state of righteousness and Dharma has been lost. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: asaT saaj saaj puraan sodheh kareh bedh abhiaas ||
verses.translation: They analyze eight chapters of (Panini's) grammar and the Puraanas. They study the Vedas,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
verses.translit: bin naam har ke mukat naahee kahai naanak dhaas ||4||1||6||8||
verses.translation: but without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated; so says Nanak, the Lord's slave. ||4||1||6||8||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਆਰਤੀ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa aaratee
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Aartee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
