verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)dh dheepak bane taarikaa ma(n)ddal janak motee ||
verses.translation: In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in the constellations are the pearls.

verses.original: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banarai foola(n)t jotee ||1||
verses.translation: The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetation are flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaisee aaratee hoi bhav kha(n)ddanaa teree aaratee ||
verses.translation: What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is Your Aartee, Your worship service.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anahataa sabadh vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahas tav nain nan nain hai toh kau sahas moorat nanaa ek tohee ||
verses.translation: Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, and yet You have not even one form.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahas padh bimal nan ek padh ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
verses.translation: Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh jot jot hai soi ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoi ||
verses.translation: Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee jot paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoi ||3||
verses.translation: That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kamal makara(n)dh lobhit mano anadhino moh aahee piaasaa ||
verses.translation: My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst for them.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
verses.translit: kirapaa jal dheh naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai naam vaasaa ||4||1||7||9||
verses.translation: Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan akhuT na nikhuTai na jai ||
verses.translation: This wealth is inexhaustible. It shall never be exhausted, and it shall never be lost.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru has revealed it to me.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apune satigur kau sadh bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te har ma(n)n vasaiee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se dhanava(n)t har naam liv lai ||
verses.translation: They alone are wealthy, who lovingly attune themselves to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har dhan paragaasiaa har kirapaa te vasai man aai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed to me the Lord's treasure; by the Lord's Grace, it has come to abide in my mind. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: avagun kaaT gun ridhai samai ||
verses.translation: He is rid of his demerits, and his heart is permeated with merit and virtue.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he naturally dwells in celestial peace.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: True is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sukh man a(n)tar sahaj samaanee ||2||
verses.translation: They bring peace to the mind, and celestial peace is absorbed within. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek acharaj jan dhekhahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O my humble Siblings of Destiny, behold this strange and wonderful thing:

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa maar har ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: duality is overcome, and the Lord dwells within his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam amolak na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless; it cannot be taken.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh vasai man aai ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, it comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh vasai prabh eko soi ||
verses.translation: He is the One God, abiding within all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, He is revealed in the heart.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje jin prabh jaan pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: One who intuitively knows and realizes God,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai man maaniaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, obtains the Naam; his mind is pleased and appeased. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhan niramal at apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is immaculate, and absolutely infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is over-flowing with treasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhan bin hor sabh bikh jaan ||
verses.translation: Know that, except for the wealth of the Name, all other wealth is poison.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh jalai abhimaan ||1||
verses.translation: The egotistical people are burning in their attachment to Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har ras chaakhai koi ||
verses.translation: How rare is that Gurmukh who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee poorai bhaag paraapat hoi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is always in bliss, day and night; through perfect good destiny, he obtains the Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh dheepak varatai tih loi ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is a lamp, illuminating the three worlds.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo chaakhai so niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: One who tastes it, becomes immaculate.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam haumai mal dhoi ||
verses.translation: The immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, washes off the filth of ego.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachee bhagat sadhaa sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: True devotional worship brings lasting peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin har ras chaakhiaa so har jan log ||
verses.translation: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord is the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis sadhaa harakh naahee kadhe sog ||
verses.translation: He is forever happy; he is never sad.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap mukat avaraa mukat karaavai ||
verses.translation: He himself is liberated, and he liberates others as well.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naam japai har te sukh paavai ||3||
verses.translation: He chants the Lord's Name, and through the Lord, he finds peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sabh muiee bilalai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, everyone dies, crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dhaajheh saat na pai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they burn, and find no peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai sabh tirasan bujhaae ||
verses.translation: But meeting the True Guru, all thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam saa(n)t sukh paae ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, one finds peace and tranquility. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa dhan a(n)tar naam samaale ||
verses.translation: Gather in and cherish forever the wealth of the Lord's Name, deep within;

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t jineh pratipaale ||
verses.translation: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath tin kau paae ||
verses.translation: They alone obtain the treasure of Liberation,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kai naam rate liv laae ||1||
verses.translation: who are lovingly imbued with, and focused on the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te har naam dhan paavai ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, one obtains the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar paragaas har naam dhiaavai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is illumined and enlightened within, and he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੂੜਾ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih har ra(n)g gooRaa dhan pir hoi ||
verses.translation: This love for the Lord is like the love of the bride for her husband.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t seegaar raave prabh soi ||
verses.translation: God ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride who is adorned with peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich prabh koi na paae ||
verses.translation: No one finds God through egotism.

verses.original: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moolahu bhulaa janam gavaae ||2||
verses.translation: Wandering away from the Primal Lord, the root of all, one wastes his life in vain. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur te saat sahaj sukh baanee ||
verses.translation: Tranquility, celestial peace, pleasure and the Word of His Bani come from the Guru.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa saachee naam samaanee ||
verses.translation: True is that service, which leads one to merge in the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh milai preetam sadhaa dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Blessed with the Word of the Shabad, he meditates forever on the Lord, the Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saach naam vaddiaaiee paae ||3||
verses.translation: Through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa jug jug soi ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare melaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: If He casts His Glance of Grace, then we meet Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee te har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of Gurbani, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saach rate prabh aap milaae ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God unites with Himself those who are imbued with Truth. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੈਲੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag mailaa mailo hoi jai ||
verses.translation: The world is polluted, and those in the world become polluted as well.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavai jai dhoojai lobhai ||
verses.translation: In attachment to duality, it comes and goes.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਭ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai sabh paraj vigoiee ||
verses.translation: This love of duality has ruined the entire world.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh choTaa khai apunee pat khoiee ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh suffers punishment, and forfeits his honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te jan niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, one becomes immaculate.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam vasai pat uootam hoi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within, and his state becomes exalted. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ubare har saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are saved, taking to the Lord's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam raate bhagat dhiraRaiee ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Lord's Name, they commit themselves to devotional worship.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kare jan vaddiaaiee paae ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant performs devotional worship, and is blessed with greatness.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saach rate sukh sahaj samaae ||2||
verses.translation: Attuned to Truth, he is absorbed in celestial peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saache kaa gaahak viralaa ko jaan ||
verses.translation: Know that one who purchases the True Name is very rare.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh aap pachhaan ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachee raas saachaa vaapaar ||
verses.translation: True is his capital, and true is his trade.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so dha(n)n purakh jis naam piaar ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed is that person, who loves the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin prabh saachai ik sach laae ||
verses.translation: God, the True Lord, has attached some to His True Name.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: uootam baanee sabadh sunaae ||
verses.translation: They listen to the most sublime Word of His Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh saache kee saachee kaar ||
verses.translation: True is service to the True Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam savaaranahaar ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is the Embellisher. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo har seveh tin bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who serve the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin hiradhai saach sachaa mukh naau ||
verses.translation: The Truth is in their hearts, and the True Name is on their lips.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saacho saach samaalih dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Dwelling upon the Truest of the True, their pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh vasai man aai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee sun mail gavaae ||
verses.translation: Listening to the Word of Gurbani, filth is washed off,

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje har naam ma(n)n vasaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and they naturally enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kusat tirasanaa agan bujhaae ||
verses.translation: One who conquers fraud, deceit and the fire of desire

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t sahaj sukh paae ||
verses.translation: finds tranquility, peace and pleasure within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai chalai taa aap jai ||
verses.translation: If one walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, he eliminates his self-conceit.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saach mahal paae har gun gai ||2||
verses.translation: He finds the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: n sabadh boojhai na jaanai baanee ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad; he does not know the Word of the Guru's Bani,

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhe dhukh vihaanee ||
verses.translation: and so he passes his life in misery.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe taa sukh paae ||
verses.translation: But if he meets the True Guru, then he finds peace,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai vichahu Thaak rahaae ||3||
verses.translation: and the ego within is silenced. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai dhaataa ik soi ||
verses.translation: Who else should I speak to? The One Lord is the Giver of all.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare sabadh milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: When He grants His Grace, then we obtain the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saache saachaa bhaavaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, becoming truthful, I have become pleasing to the True Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man marai dhaat mar jai ||
verses.translation: When the mind is conquered, its turbulent wanderings are stopped.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin man mooe kaise har pai ||
verses.translation: Without conquering the mind, how can the Lord be found?

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man marai dhaaroo jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: Rare is the one who knows the medicine to conquer the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man sabadh marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
verses.translation: The mind is conquered through the Word of the Shabad; this is known to the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase har dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord forgives him, and blesses him with glory.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh vasai man aaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karanee kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does good deeds,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
verses.translation: and so, he comes to understand this mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man mai mat maigal mikadhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The mind is intoxicated, like the elephant with wine.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)kas maar jeevaalanahaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru places the harness upon it, and rejuvenates it. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man asaadh saadhai jan koiee ||
verses.translation: The mind is undisciplined; only a rare few can discipline it.

verses.original: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: achar charai taa niramal hoiee ||
verses.translation: If someone eats the uneatable, then he becomes immaculate.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ih man liaa savaar ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, his mind is embellished.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai vichahu tajai vikaar ||3||
verses.translation: Egotism and corruption are eradicated from within. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur rakhian mel milai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Primal Lord keeps united in His Union,

verses.original: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kadhe na vichhuReh sabadh samai ||
verses.translation: shall never be separated from Him; they are merged in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee kalaa aape prabh jaanai ||
verses.translation: Only God Himself knows His own power.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam pachhaanai ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kaachaa dhan sa(n)cheh moorakh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: The ignorant fools amass false wealth.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoole a(n)dh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukhs have gone astray.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਧਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa kai dhan sadhaa dhukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Poisonous wealth brings constant pain.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਾਥਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa saath jai na paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: It will not go with you, and it will not yield any profit. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa dhan gurmatee paae ||
verses.translation: True wealth is obtained through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaachaa dhan fun aavai jaae || rahaau ||
verses.translation: False wealth continues coming and going. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoole sabh mareh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukhs all go astray and die.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਨ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal ddoobe na uravaar na paar ||
verses.translation: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and they cannot reach either this shore, or the one beyond.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe poorai bhaag ||
verses.translation: But by perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru;

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saach rate ahinis bairaag ||2||
verses.translation: imbued with the True Name, day and night, they remain detached from the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: chahu jug meh a(n)mrit saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: Throughout the four ages, the True Bani of His Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag har naam samaanee ||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, one is absorbed in the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik taraseh sabh loi ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers and all men long for the Name.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag paraapat hoi ||3||
verses.translation: It is obtained only by perfect destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh saachaa saachaa hai soi ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is everything; He is True.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: uootam braham pachhaanai koi ||
verses.translation: Only a few realize the exalted Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਆਪਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach saachaa sach aap dhiraRaae ||
verses.translation: He is the Truest of the True; He Himself implants the True Name within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak aape vekhai aape sach laae ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; He Himself links us to the Truth. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naavai kee keemat mit kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: The value and worth of the Lord's Name cannot be described.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se jan dha(n)n jin ik naam liv lai ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, who lovingly focus their minds on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat saachee saachaa veechaar ||
verses.translation: True are the Guru's Teachings, and True is contemplative meditation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhe veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: God Himself forgives, and bestows contemplative meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har naam acharaj prabh aap sunaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is wonderful! God Himself imparts it.

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaal vich gurmukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh moorakh man maeh ||
verses.translation: We are ignorant; ignorance fills our minds.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich sabh kaar kamaeh ||
verses.translation: We do all our deeds in ego.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ha(n)aumai jai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase le milai ||2||
verses.translation: Forgiving us, the Lord blends us with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa kaa dhan bahut abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Poisonous wealth gives rise to great arrogance.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaar ddoobai na paavai maan ||
verses.translation: Drowning in egotism, no one is honored.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Forsaking self-conceit, one finds lasting peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat saalaahee sach soiee ||3||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, he praises the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape saaje karataa soi ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord Himself fashions all.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis sach laae soiee laagai ||
verses.translation: He alone is attached to Truth, whom the Lord Himself so attaches.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam sadhaa sukh aagai ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, lasting peace is attained in the hereafter. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: raag dhanaasiree mahalaa teejaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham bheekhak bhekhaaree tere too nij pat hai dhaataa ||
verses.translation: I am just a poor beggar of Yours; You are Your Own Lord Master, You are the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoh dhaiaal naam dheh ma(n)gat jan ka(n)au sadhaa rahau ra(n)g raataa ||1||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au balihaarai jaau saache tere naam viTahu ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran sabhanaa kaa eko avar na dhoojaa koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahute fer pe kirapan kau ab kichh kirapaa keejai ||
verses.translation: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord, please bless me with Your Grace.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal dharasan dheh apunaa aaisee bakhas kareejai ||2||
verses.translation: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak bharam paT khool(h)e gur parasaadhee jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I have come to know the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: saachee liv laagee hai bheetar satigur siau man maaniaa ||3||1||9||
verses.translation: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by the True Guru. ||3||1||9||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo har seveh sa(n)t bhagat tin ke sabh paap nivaaree ||
verses.translation: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham uoopar kirapaa kar suaamee rakh sa(n)gat tum ju piaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregation that You love. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har gun keh na sakau banavaaree ||
verses.translation: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham paapee paathar neer ddubat kar kirapaa paakhan ham taaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stones across. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke laage bikh morachaa lag sa(n)gat saadh savaaree ||
verses.translation: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau ka(n)chan baisa(n)tar taio mal kaaTee kaTit utaaree ||2||
verses.translation: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har japan japau dhin raatee jap har har har ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har har aaukhadh jag pooraa jap har har haumai maaree ||3||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam agaadh bodh apara(n)par purakh apaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is unapproachable, of unfathomable wisdom, unlimited, all-powerful and infinite.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan kau kirapaa karahu jagajeevan jan naanak paij savaaree ||4||1||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to Your humble servant, O Life of the world, and save the honor of servant Nanak. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio tin kaa dhookh bharam bhau bhaagee ||
verses.translation: The humble Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord; their pain, doubt and fear have run away.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apanee sevaa aap karaiee gurmat a(n)tar jaagee ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself inspires them to serve Him; they are awakened within to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kai naam rataa bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Name, they are unattached to the world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa sunee man bhaiee gurmat har liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds are pleased; through Guru's Instruction, they enshrine love for the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਂਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee jaat har suaamee tum(h) Thaakur ham saa(n)gee ||
verses.translation: God, the Lord and Master, is the caste and social status of His humble Saints. You are the Lord and Master; I am just Your puppet.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaisee mat dhevahu har suaamee ham taise bulag bulaagee ||2||
verses.translation: As is the understanding You bless us with, so are the words we speak. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਨਾਨੑ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ham kiram naan(h) nik keere tum(h) vadd purakh vaddaagee ||
verses.translation: What are we? Tiny worms, and microscopic germs. You are our great and glorious Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree gat mit keh na sakeh prabh ham kiau kar mileh abhaagee ||3||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meet with You? ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh suaamee kirapaa dhaarahu ham har har sevaa laagee ||
verses.translation: O God, my Lord and Master, shower me with Your Mercy, and commit me to Your service.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaasan dhaas karahu prabh ham har kathaa kathaagee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, God; I speak the speech of the Lord's sermon. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sa(n)t satagur sat purakhaa jo bolai har har baanee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Lord's Saint, the True Being, who chants the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo kahai sunai so mukataa ham tis kai sadh kurabaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever chants it, and listens to it, is liberated; I am forever a sacrifice to him. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jas kaanee ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, listen to the Lord's Praises with your ears.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa sunahu ik nimakh pal sabh kilavikh paap leh jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, for a moment, for even an instant, and all your sins and mistakes shall be erased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa sa(n)t saadh jin paiaa te vadd purakh vaddaanee ||
verses.translation: Those who find such humble, Holy Saints, are the greatest of the great persons.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੰਗਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhoor ma(n)geh prabh suaamee ham har loch luchaanee ||2||
verses.translation: I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for the longing for God, my Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har safalio birakh prabh suaamee jin japio se tirapataanee ||
verses.translation: The Name of God, the Lord and Master, Har, Har, is the fruit-bearing tree; those who meditate on it are satisfied.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mrit pee tirapataase sabh laathee bhookh bhukhaanee ||3||
verses.translation: Drinking in the ambrosia of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am satisfied; all my hunger and thirst is quenched. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke vadde bhaag vadd uooche tin har japio japaanee ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the highest, loftiest destiny, chant and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin har sa(n)gat mel prabh suaamee jan naanak dhaas dhasaanee ||4||3||
verses.translation: Let me join their congregation, O God, my Lord and Master; Nanak is the slave of their slaves. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham a(n)dhule a(n)dh bikhai bikh raate kiau chaaleh gur chaalee ||
verses.translation: I am blind, totally blind, entangled in corruption and poison. How can I walk on the Guru's Path?

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਨ ਪਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satagur dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa ham laavai aapan paalee ||1||
verses.translation: If the True Guru, the Giver of peace, shows His kindness, He attaches us to the hem of His robe. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਚਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: gursikh meet chalahu gur chaalee ||
verses.translation: O Sikhs of the Guru, O friends, walk on the Guru's Path.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur kahai soiee bhal maanahu har har kathaa niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Guru says, accept that as good; the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is unique and wonderful. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਬੇਗਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jan bhaiee gur sevih beg begaalee ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: serve the Guru, quickly now!

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਾਲੑੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satagur sev kharach har baadhahu mat jaanahu aaj k kaal(h)ee ||2||
verses.translation: Let your service to the True Guru be your supplies on the Lord's Path; pack them up, and don't think of today or tomorrow. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t japahu har japanaa har sa(n)t chalai har naalee ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, chant the chant of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Saints walk with the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਲਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin har japiaa se har hoe har miliaa kel kelaalee ||3||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord, become the Lord; the playful, wondrous Lord meets them. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੋੁਚਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har japan jap loch luochaanee har kirapaa kar banavaalee ||
verses.translation: To chant the chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the longing I long for; have Mercy upon me, O Lord of the world-forest.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sa(n)gat saadh har melahu ham saadh janaa pag raalee ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; make me the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har boo(n)dh bhe har suaamee ham chaatirak bilal bilalaatee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is the rain-drop; I am the song-bird, crying, crying out for it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa karahu prabh apanee mukh dhevahu har nimakhaatee ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please bless me with Your Mercy, and pour Your Name into my mouth, even if for only an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har bin reh na sakau ik raatee ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਮ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bin amalai amalee mar jaiee hai tiau har bin ham mar jaatee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Like the addict who dies without his drug, I die without the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਵਰ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਹਮ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum har saravar at agaeh ham leh na sakeh a(n)t maatee ||
verses.translation: You, Lord, are the deepest, most unfathomable ocean; I cannot find even a trace of Your limits.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too parai parai apara(n)par suaamee mit jaanahu aapan gaatee ||2||
verses.translation: You are the most remote of the remote, limitless and transcendent; O Lord Master, You alone know Your state and extent. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio gur ra(n)g chaloolai raatee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble Saints meditate on the Lord; they are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Guru's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਊਤਮ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har bhagat banee at sobhaa har japio uootam paatee ||3||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, they attain great glory, and the most sublime honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape Thaakur aape sevak aap banaavai bhaatee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself creates His environments.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਾਤੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jan tumaree saranaiee har raakhahu laaj bhagaatee ||4||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord; protect and preserve the honor of Your devotee. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਵ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਛੁਟਕਾਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug kaa dharam kahahu tum bhaiee kiv chhooTeh ham chhuTakaakee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O Siblings of Destiny, the religion for this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. I seek emancipation - how can I be emancipated?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har jap beRee har tulahaa har japio tarai taraakee ||1||
verses.translation: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, the raft; meditating on the Lord, the swimmer swims across. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jee laaj rakhahu har jan kee ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, protect and preserve the honor of Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਮ ਮਾਗੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕਾਕੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har japan japaavahu apanaa ham maagee bhagat ikaakee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, please make me chant the chant of Your Name; I beg only for Your devotional worship. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਬਚਨਾਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sevak se har piaare jin japio har bachanaakee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servants are very dear to the Lord; they chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਛੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lekhaa chitr gupat jo likhiaa sabh chhooTee jam kee baakee ||2||
verses.translation: The account of the recording angels, Chitr and Gupt, and the account with the Messenger of Death is totally erased. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t japio man har har lag sa(n)gat saadh janaa kee ||
verses.translation: The Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord in their minds; they join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਸਿਵ ਚਰਿਓ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੰਦਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhineear soor tirasanaa agan bujhaanee siv chario cha(n)dh cha(n)dhaakee ||3||
verses.translation: The piercing sun of desires has set, and the cool moon has risen. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum vadd purakh vadd agam agochar tum aape aap apaakee ||
verses.translation: You are the Greatest Being, absolutely unapproachable and unfathomable; You created the Universe from Your Own Being.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਕੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai kar dhaasan dhaas dhasaakee ||4||6||
verses.translation: O God, take pity on servant Nanak, and make him the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar panjavaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aur dhaar beechaar muraar ramo ram manmohan naam japeene ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord within your heart, and contemplate Him. Dwell upon Him, reflect upon Him, and chant the Name of the Lord, the Enticer of hearts.

verses.original: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: adhirasaT agochar apara(n)par suaamee gur poorai pragaT kar dheene ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is unseen, unfathomable and unreachable; through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਸਟ ॥
verses.translit: raam paaras cha(n)dhan ham kaasaT losaT ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold, and sandalwood, while I am just dry wood and iron.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g haree satasa(n)g bhe har ka(n)chan cha(n)dhan keene ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Lord, and the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation, the Lord has transformed me into gold and sandalwood. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਆਗਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਵ ਨ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: nav chhia khaT boleh mukh aagar meraa har prabh iv na pateene ||
verses.translation: One may repeat, verbatim, the nine grammars and the six Shaastras, but my Lord God is not pleased by this.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਇਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har hiradhai sadh dhiaavahu iau har prabh meraa bheene ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; this is what pleases my Lord God. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gun kahu har lahu kar sevaa satigur iv har har naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Chant His Praises, learn of the Lord, and serve the True Guru; in this way, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dharageh bhaaveh fir janam na aaveh har har har jot samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, He shall be pleased with you, and you shall not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again; you shall merge in the Divine Light of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap man naam haree hoh sarab sukhee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and you shall be totally at peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਚ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jas uooch sabhanaa te uoopar har har har sev chhaddaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Praises are the most sublime, the most exalted; serving the Lord, Har, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa nidh keenee gur bhagat har dheenee tab har siau preet ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the treasure of mercy, blessed me, and so the Guru blessed me with the Lord's devotional worship; I have come to be in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: bahu chi(n)t visaaree har naam ur dhaaree naanak har bhe hai sakhaiee ||2||2||8||
verses.translation: I have forgotten my cares and anxieties, and enshrined the Lord's Name in my heart; O Nanak, the Lord has become my friend and companion. ||2||2||8||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har paR har likh har jap har gaau har bhaujal paar utaaree ||
verses.translation: Read about the Lord, write about the Lord, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Lord's Praises; the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਇਵ ਭਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man bachan ridhai dhiaai har hoi sa(n)tusaT iv bhan har naam muraaree ||1||
verses.translation: In your mind, by your words, and within your heart, meditate on the Lord, and He will be pleased. In this way, repeat the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: man japeeaai har jagadhees ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo meet ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O friend.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee har keerat kar banavaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall be happy forever, day and night; sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਬ ਭਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har karee dhirasaT tab bhio man udham har har naam japio gat bhiee hamaaree ||
verses.translation: When the Lord, Har, Har, casts His Glance of Grace, then I made the effort in my mind; meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been emancipated.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kee pat raakh mere suaamee har aai pario hai saran tumaaree ||2||3||9||
verses.translation: Preserve the honor of servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||3||9||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chauraaseeh sidh budh tetees koT mun jan sabh chaaheh har jeeau tero naau ||
verses.translation: The eighty-four Siddhas, the spiritual masters, the Buddhas, the three hundred thirty million gods and the silent sages, all long for Your Name, O Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh ko viralaa paavai jin kau lilaaT likhiaa dhur bhaau ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, a rare few obtain it; upon their foreheads, the pre-ordained destiny of loving devotion is written. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raamai naam har jas uootam kaam ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord; singing the Lord's Praises is the most exalted activity.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo gaaveh suneh teraa jas suaamee hau tin kai sadh balihaarai jaau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who sing, and hear Your Praises, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saranaagat pratipaalak har suaamee jo tum dheh soiee hau paau ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Cherisher God, my Lord and Master; whatever You give me, I accept.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaa kar dheejai naanak har simaran kaa hai chaau ||2||4||10||
verses.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, give me this blessing; Nanak longs for the Lord's meditative remembrance. ||2||4||10||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਪੂਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sikh poojan sabh aaveh sabh gaaveh har har uootam baanee ||
verses.translation: All the Sikhs and servants come to worship and adore You; they sing the sublime Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਿਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaaviaa suniaa tin kaa har thai paavai jin satigur kee aagiaa sat sat kar maanee ||1||
verses.translation: Their singing and listening is approved by the Lord; they accept the Order of the True Guru as True, totally True. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੀਰਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu bhaiee har keerat har bhavajal teerath ||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Praises, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage in the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਜਿਨ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dhar tin kee uootam baat hai sa(n)tahu har kathaa jin janahu jaanee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: They alone are praised in the Court of the Lord, O Saints, who know and understand the Lord's sermon. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape har prabh choj viddaanee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; the Lord God Himself plays His wondrous games.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਓਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak aap milaae soiee har milasee avar sabh tiaag ohaa har bhaanee ||2||5||11||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, he alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself merges; all the others are forsaken, but the Lord loves him. ||2||5||11||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eichhaa poorak sarab sukhadhaataa har jaa kai vas hai kaamadhenaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Fulfiller of desires, the Giver of total peace; the Kaamadhaynaa, the wish-fulfilling cow, is in His power.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har dhiaaieeaai mere jeeaRe taa sarab sukh paaveh mere manaa ||1||
verses.translation: So meditate on such a Lord, O my soul. Then, you shall obtain total peace, O my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man sat naam sadhaa sat naam ||
verses.translation: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat mukh uoojal hoiee hai nit dhiaaieeaai har purakh nira(n)janaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this world, and in the world beyond, your face shall be radiant, by meditating continually on the immaculate Lord God. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਹ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਗਤੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh har simaran bhiaa teh upaadh gat keenee vaddabhaagee har japanaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever anyone remembers the Lord in meditation, disaster runs away from that place. By great good fortune, we meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau gur ieh mat dheenee jap har bhavajal taranaa ||2||6||12||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed servant Nanak with this understanding, that by meditating on the Lord, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||6||12||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahaa mai har dharasan sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O my King, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I am at peace.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree bedhan too jaanataa saahaa avar kiaa jaanai koi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You alone know my inner pain, O King; what can anyone else know? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib sach too mere saahaa teraa keeaa sach sabh hoi ||
verses.translation: O True Lord and Master, You are truly my King; whatever You do, all that is True.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਾਹਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa kis kau aakheeaai saahaa dhoojaa naahee koi ||1||
verses.translation: Who should I call a liar? There is no other than You, O King. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa vich too varatadhaa saahaa sabh tujheh dhiaaveh dhin raat ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating in all; O King, everyone meditates on You, day and night.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh tujh hee thaavahu ma(n)gadhe mere saahaa too sabhanaa kareh ik dhaat ||2||
verses.translation: Everyone begs of You, O my King; You alone give gifts to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko tujh hee vich hai mere saahaa tujh te baahar koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: All are under Your Power, O my King; none at all are beyond You.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tere too sabhas dhaa mere saahaa sabh tujh hee maeh samaeh ||3||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours-You belong to all, O my King. All shall merge and be absorbed in You. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kee too aas hai mere piaare sabh tujheh dhiaaveh mere saeh ||
verses.translation: You are the hope of all, O my Beloved; all meditate on You, O my King.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too mere piaare sach naanak ke paatisaeh ||4||7||13||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, protect and preserve me, O my Beloved; You are the True King of Nanak. ||4||7||13||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhav kha(n)ddan dhukh bha(n)jan savaiaamee bhagat vachhal nira(n)kaare ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of fear, Remover of suffering, Lord and Master, Lover of Your devotees, Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT paraadh miTe khin bheetar jaa(n) gurmukh naam samaare ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are eradicated in an instant when, as Gurmukh, one contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man laagaa hai raam piaare ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal karee prabh kirapaa vas keene pa(n)ch dhootaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God, Merciful to the meek, granted His Grace, and placed the five enemies under my control. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa thaan suhaavaa roop suhaavaa tere bhagat soheh dharabaare ||
verses.translation: Your place is so beautiful; Your form is so beautiful; Your devotees look so beautiful in Your Court.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa ke dhaate suaamee kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, Giver of all beings, please, grant Your Grace, and save me. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa varan na jaapai roop na lakheeaai teree kudharat kaun beechaare ||
verses.translation: Your color is not known, and Your form is not seen; who can contemplate Your Almighty Creative Power?

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal raviaa srab Thaiee agam roop giradhaare ||3||
verses.translation: You are contained in the water, the land and the sky, everywhere, O Lord of unfathomable form, Holder of the mountain. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: keerat kareh sagal jan teree too abinaasee purakh muraare ||
verses.translation: All beings sing Your Praises; You are the imperishable Primal Being, the Destroyer of ego.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran dhuaare ||4||1||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, please protect and preserve me; servant Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਹੈ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bin jal praan taje hai meenaa jin jal siau het baddaio ||
verses.translation: The fish out of water loses its life; it is deeply in love with the water.

verses.original: ਕਮਲ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਾ ਉਨਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kamal het binasio hai bhavaraa un maarag nikas na paio ||1||
verses.translation: The bumble bee, totally in love with the lotus flower, is lost in it; it cannot find the way to escape from it. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab man ekas siau moh keenaa ||
verses.translation: Now, my mind has nurtured love for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: marai na jaavai sadh hee sa(n)ge satigur sabadhee cheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not die, and is not born; He is always with me. Through the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, I know Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਹੇਤਿ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਲੈ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam het ku(n)char lai faa(n)kio oh par vas bhio bichaaraa ||
verses.translation: Lured by sexual desire, the elephant is trapped; the poor beast falls into the power of another.

verses.original: ਨਾਦ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੁਰੰਕਾ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਦਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naadh het sir ddaario kura(n)kaa us hee het bidhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Lured by the sound of the hunter's bell, the deer offers its head; because of this enticement, it is killed. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh kuTa(n)b lobh mohio praanee maiaa kau lapaTaanaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon his family, the mortal is enticed by greed; he clings in attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਉਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਾਪਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: at rachio kar leeno apunaa un chhodd saraapar jaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Totally engrossed in worldly things, he considers them to be his own; but in the end, he shall surely have to leave them behind. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gobi(n)dh avar sa(n)g nehaa oh jaanahu sadhaa dhuhelaa ||
verses.translation: Know it well, that anyone who loves any other than God, shall be miserable forever.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur ihai bujhaio preet prabhoo sadh kelaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has explained this to me, that love for God brings lasting bliss. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa dheeo moh naamaa ba(n)dhan te chhuTakaae ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with His Name, and released me of my bonds.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man te bisario sagalo dha(n)dhaa gur kee charanee laae ||1||
verses.translation: I have forgotten all worldly entanglements, and I am attached to the Guru's feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਛਾਡੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g chi(n)t biraanee chhaaddee ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have renounced my other cares and anxieties.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗਡਹਾ ਗਾਡੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh moh man baasan dhe kar gaddahaa gaaddee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I dug a deep pit, and buried my egotistical pride, emotional attachment and the desires of my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਕੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko meraa dhusaman rahiaa naa ham kis ke bairaiee ||
verses.translation: No one is my enemy, and I am no one's enemy.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: braham pasaar pasaario bheetar satigur te sojhee paiee ||2||
verses.translation: God, who expanded His expanse, is within all; I learned this from the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਮ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko meet ham aapan keenaa ham sabhanaa ke saajan ||
verses.translation: I am a friend to all; I am everyone's friend.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਜਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhoor paraio man kaa birahaa taa mel keeo merai raajan ||3||
verses.translation: When the sense of separation was removed from my mind, then I was united with the Lord, my King. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਢੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: binasio ddeeThaa a(n)mrit vooThaa sabadh lago gur meeThaa ||
verses.translation: My stubbornness is gone, Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to me.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਮਈਆ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal sarab nivaasee naanak ramieeaa ddeeThaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: He is pervading everywhere, in the water, on the land and in the sky; Nanak beholds the all-pervading Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਓਇ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jab te dharasan bheTe saadhoo bhale dhinas oi aae ||
verses.translation: Ever since I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, my days have been blessed and prosperous.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh sadhaa kar keeratan purakh bidhaataa paae ||1||
verses.translation: I have found lasting bliss, singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh raam jaso man gaio ||
verses.translation: Now, I sing the Praises of the Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhio pragaas sadhaa sukh man meh satigur pooraa paio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has been illumined and enlightened, and it is always at peace; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan ridh bheetar vasiaa taa dhookh bharam bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, abides deep within the heart, and so pain, doubt and fear have been dispelled.

verses.original: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhiee paraapat vasat agochar raam naam ra(n)g laagaa ||2||
verses.translation: I have obtained the most incomprehensible thing, enshrining love for the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)t achi(n)taa soch asochaa sog lobh moh thaakaa ||
verses.translation: I was anxious, and now I am free of anxiety; I was worried, and now I am free of worry; my grief, greed and emotional attachments are gone.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਬਿਬਾਕਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai rog miTe kirapaa te jam te bhe bibaakaa ||3||
verses.translation: By His Grace, I am cured of the disease of egotism, and the Messenger of Death no longer terrifies me. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee Tahal guroo kee sevaa gur kee aagiaa bhaanee ||
verses.translation: Working for the Guru, serving the Guru and the Guru's Command, all are pleasing to me.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin jam te kaadde tis gur kai kurabaanee ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He has released me from the clutches of Death; I am a sacrifice to that Guru. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa tan man dhan sabh tis kaa soiee sughaR sujaanee ||
verses.translation: Body, mind, wealth and everything belong to Him; He alone is all-wise and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin hee suniaa dhukh sukh meraa tau bidh neekee khaTaanee ||1||
verses.translation: He listens to my pains and pleasures, and then my condition improves. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee ekai hee peh maanee ||
verses.translation: My soul is satisfied with the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar jatan kar rahe bahutere tin til nahee keemat jaanee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: People make all sorts of other efforts, but they have no value at all. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam niramolak heeraa gur dheeno ma(n)taanee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel. The Guru has given me this advice.

verses.original: ਡਿਗੈ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ddigai na ddolai dhiraR kar rahio pooran hoi tirapataanee ||2||
verses.translation: It cannot be lost, and it cannot be shaken off; it remains steady, and I am perfectly satisfied with it. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਬੀਚ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: oi ju beech ham tum kachh hote tin kee baat bilaanee ||
verses.translation: Those things which tore me away from You, Lord, are now gone.

verses.original: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ala(n)kaar mil thailee hoiee hai taa te kanik vakhaanee ||3||
verses.translation: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTio jot sahaj sukh sobhaa baaje anahat baanee ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak nihachal ghar baadhio gur keeo ba(n)dhaanee ||4||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
verses.translit: vadde vadde raajan ar bhooman taa kee tirasan na boojhee ||
verses.translation: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

verses.original: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lapaT rahe maiaa ra(n)g maate lochan kachhoo na soojhee ||1||
verses.translation: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa meh kin hee tirapat na paiee ||
verses.translation: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau paavak ieedhan nahee dhraapai bin har kahaa aghaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhin dhin karat bhojan bahu bi(n)jan taa kee miTai na bhookhaa ||
verses.translation: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: audham karai suaan kee niaaiee chaare ku(n)Taa ghokhaa ||2||
verses.translation: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaamava(n)t kaamee bahu naaree par gireh joh na chookai ||
verses.translation: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhin prat karai karai pachhutaapai sog lobh meh sookai ||3||
verses.translation: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||
