verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam apaar amolaa a(n)mrit ek nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh sa(n)tan kai naanak gur te jaanaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: lavai na laagan kau hai kachhooaai jaa kau fir ih dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau gur dheeno ih a(n)mrit tis hee kau ban aavai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau aaio ek rasaa || khaan paan aan nahee khudhiaa taa kai chit na basaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires, do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maulio man tan hoio hariaa ek boo(n)dh jin paiee ||
verses.translation: The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau usatat taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaal na milio sev na milio milio aai achi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service; He comes and meets us spontaneously.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dhiaa karee merai Thaakur tin gureh kamaano ma(n)taa ||3||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru's Mantra. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhaiaal sadhaa kirapaalaa sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes and nurtures all beings.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: ot pot naanak sa(n)g raviaa jiau maataa baal guopaalaa ||4||7||
verses.translation: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like the mother her child. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ॥
verses.translit: baar jaau gur apune uoopar jin har har naam dhiraR(h)aayaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਯਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa udhiaan a(n)dhakaar meh jin seedhaa maarag dhikhaayaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: hamare praan gupaal gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੀ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa sarab thok kee jiseh hamaaree chi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran sarab nidhaanaa maan mahat pat pooree ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਾਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam lait koT agh naase bhagat baachheh sabh dhooree ||2||
verses.translation: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dust of His feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੇਵੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab manorath je ko chaahai sevai ek nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve the one supreme treasure.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham apara(n)par suaamee simarat paar paraanaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him in remembrance, one is carried across. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਓਲੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: seetal saa(n)t mahaa sukh paiaa sa(n)tasa(n)g rahio ol(h)aa ||
verses.translation: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor has been preserved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: har dhan sa(n)chan har naam bhojan ih naanak keeno chol(h)aa ||4||8||
verses.translation: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਇਹਾ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh karanee hoveh sarami(n)dhaa ihaa kamaanee reet ||
verses.translation: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa saakat kee poojaa aaisee dhiraR(h)ee bipareet ||1||
verses.translation: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਅਵਰੈ ਹੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh bhoolo avarai heet ||
verses.translation: Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,

verses.original: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haricha(n)dhauree ban har paat re ihai tuhaaro beet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such is your way of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan lep hot dheh kau sukh garadhabh bhasam sa(n)geet ||
verses.translation: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in the mud.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat sa(n)g naeh ruch aavat bikhai Thagauree preet ||2||
verses.translation: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug of corruption. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਤਮ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: autam sa(n)t bhale sa(n)jogee is jug meh pavit puneet ||
verses.translation: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.

verses.original: ਜਾਤ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਜੀਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaat akaarath janam padhaarath kaach baadharai jeet ||3||
verses.translation: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mere glass. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh dhukh bhaage gur giaan a(n)jan netr dheet ||
verses.translation: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g in dhukh te nikasio naanak ek pareet ||4||9||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles; Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai gun govi(n)dh jas gaiee ||
verses.translation: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saas saas man naam sam(h)aarai ih bisraam nidh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) karahu dhiaa mere saiee ||
verses.translation: Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee mat dheejai mere Thaakur sadhaa sadhaa tudh dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te moh maan chhooTai binas jai bharamaiee ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadh roop ravio sabh madhe jat kat pekhau jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh patit paavan gosaiee ||
verses.translation: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koT sookh aana(n)dh raaj paae mukh te nimakh bulaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap bhagat saa pooree jo prabh kai man bhaiee ||
verses.translation: That alone is perfect (chanting, meditation, penance, and devotional worship service) which is pleasing to God's Mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naam japat tirasanaa sabh bujhee hai naanak tirapat aghaiee ||4||10||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਵਸਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਵਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin keene vas apunai trai gun bhavan chatur sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jag isanaan taap thaan kha(n)dde kiaa ih ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee oT gahee tau chhooTo ||
verses.translation: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh prasaadh har har har gaae bikhai biaadh tab hooTo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and my sins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: neh suneeaai neh mukh te bakeeaai neh mohai uh ddeeThee ||
verses.translation: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaisee Thagauree pai bhulaavai man sabh kai laagai meeThee ||2||
verses.translation: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet to everyone's mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਉਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਦੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai baap poot hit bhraataa un ghar ghar melio dhooaa ||
verses.translation: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father, children, friends and siblings.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਾਧਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਰਿ ਲਰਿ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kis hee vaadh ghaaT kis hee peh sagale lar lar mooaa ||3||
verses.translation: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin ih chalat dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.

verses.original: ਗੂਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਭਗਤ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: goojhee bhaeh jalai sa(n)saaraa bhagat na biaapai maiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh mahaa sukh paiaa sagale ba(n)dhan kaaTe ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds have been broken.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਖਾਟੇ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam naanak dhan paiaa apunai ghar lai aaiaa khaaTe ||5||11||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned his profits, he has now returned home. ||5||11||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਨਾਇਕ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum dhaate Thaakur pratipaalak naik khasam hamaare ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, Master and Nurturer of all, my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nimakh nimakh tum hee pratipaalahu ham baarik tumare dhaare ||1||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ek kavan gun kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee tero a(n)t na kin hee laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਖੰਡਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: koT paraadh hamaare kha(n)ddahu anik bidhee samajhaavahu ||
verses.translation: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham agiaan alap mat thoree tum aapan biradh rakhaavahu ||2||
verses.translation: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree saran tumaaree aasaa tum hee sajan suhele ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my best friend.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: raakhahu raakhanahaar dhiaalaa naanak ghar ke gole ||3||12||
verses.translation: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa varat tilak isanaanaa pu(n)n dhaan bahu dhain ||
verses.translation: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generous donations to charities and self-mortification

verses.original: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahoo(n) na bheejai sa(n)jam suaamee boleh meeThe bain ||1||
verses.translation: - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly one may speak. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee ko naam japat man chain ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahu prakaar khojeh sabh taa kau bikham na jaiee lain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and He cannot be found. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap bhraman basudhaa kar uradh taap lai gain ||
verses.translation: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh neh pateeaano Thaakur jog jugat kar jain ||2||
verses.translation: - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path of Yogis and Jains. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam niramolak har jas tin paio jis kirapain ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless; he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh bheTe naanak sukh jan rain ||3||13||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God; his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan te chhuTakaavai prabhoo milaavai har har naam sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asathir kare nihachal ih manooaa bahur na katahoo dhaavai ||1||
verses.translation: and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

verses.original: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸੋ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: hai kouoo aaiso hamaraa meet ||
verses.translation: Do I have any such friend?

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree jeeau heeau dheau arapau apano cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par tan par kee ni(n)dhaa in siau preet na laagai ||
verses.translation: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love to them.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)teh sa(n)g sa(n)t sa(n)bhaakhan har keeratan man jaagai ||2||
verses.translation: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan dhiaal purakh prabh sarab sookh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.

verses.original: ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: maagai dhaan naam tero naanak jiau maataa baal gupaalaa ||3||14||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the mother loves her child. ||3||14||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har leene sa(n)t ubaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord saves His Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas kee chitavai buriaaiee tis hee kau fir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lord eventually. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਾਗੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jan kaa aap sahaiee hoaa ni(n)dhak bhaage haar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਊਹਾਂ ਹੀ ਮੂਏ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhramat bhramat uoohaa(n) hee mooe baahuR gireh na ma(n)jhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homes again. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saran pario dhukh bha(n)jan gun gaavai sadhaa apaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord forever.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kaa mukh kaalaa hoaa dheen dhuneeaa kai dharabaar ||2||15||
verses.translation: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the world beyond. ||2||15||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasiree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab har raakhanahaar chitaariaa ||
verses.translation: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet ke'ee khin bheetar sagalaa rog bidhaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gosaT bhiee saadh kai sa(n)gam kaam karodh lobh maariaa ||
verses.translation: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar simar pooran naarain sa(n)gee sagale taariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai man bisavaiaas prabh dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: charan ren baa(n)chhai nit naanak puneh puneh balihaariaa ||2||16||
verses.translation: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||16||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: meraa laago raam siau het ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sadhaa sahaiee jin dhukh kaa kaaTiaa ket ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhio apunaa kar birathaa sagal miTaiee ||
verses.translation: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak ke mukh kaale keene jan kaa aap sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the help and support of His humble servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib hoaa rakhavaalaa raakh le'ee ka(n)Th lai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace, He has saved me.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe sadhaa sukh maane naanak har gun gai ||2||17||
verses.translation: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasiree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh tero naam dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh aatur teree gat nahee jaanee too(n) aap kareh pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere dhuteeaa bhaau nivaar ||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from within me.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT leh apune kar kabahoo na aaveh haar ||1||
verses.translation: Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran piaa hau jeevaa(n) too(n) sa(n)mrath purakh miharavaan ||
verses.translation: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh kau aaraadhee naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||18||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: haa haa prabh raakh leh ||
verses.translation: O God, please save me!

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham te kichhoo na hoi mere savaiaamee kar kirapaa apunaa naam dheh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: agan kuTa(n)b saagar sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bharam moh agiaan a(n)dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness. ||1||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: uooch neech sookh dhookh ||
verses.translation: High and low, pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਾਪਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhraapas naahee tirasanaa bhookh ||2||
verses.translation: Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: man baasanaa rach bikhai biaadh ||
verses.translation: The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot sa(n)g mahaa asaadh ||3||
verses.translation: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea jahaan praan dhan teraa ||
verses.translation: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak jaan sadhaa har neraa ||4||1||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh nivaar Thaakur raakhai jan kee aap ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.

verses.original: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taran taaran har nidh dhookh na sakai biaap ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touch Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g bhajahu gupaal ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of the world.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਹ ਜਤਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan sa(n)jam kichh na soojhai ieh jatan kaaT kal kaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t dhiaal pooran tis binaa nahee koi ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam maran nivaar har jap simar suaamee soi ||2||
verses.translation: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and remembering the Lord Master in meditation. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥੈ ਸਾਸਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh si(n)mirat kathai saasat bhagat kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mukat paieeaai saadhasa(n)gat binas jai a(n)dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal adhaar jan kaa raas poo(n)jee ek ||
verses.translation: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment.

verses.original: ਤਾਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: taan maan dheebaan saachaa naanak kee prabh Tek ||4||2||20||
verses.translation: The True Lord is Nanak's strength, honor and support; He alone is his protection. ||4||2||20||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat bheTe jan saadhoo poorai gur samajhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਾਂਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan sagal bidh kaa(n)m na aavai har har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: taa te moh dhaaree oT gopaal ||
verses.translation: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran pario pooran paramesur binase sagal ja(n)jaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglements were dissolved. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: surag mirat piaal bhoo ma(n)ddal sagal biaape mai ||
verses.translation: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world - all are engrossed in Maya.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeea udhaaran sabh kul taaran har har naam dhiaai ||2||
verses.translation: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nira(n)jan gaieeaai paieeaai sarab nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures are obtained.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis dhei suaamee birale kaahoo jaanaa ||3||3||21||
verses.translation: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes to know this. ||3||3||21||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd jaeh se kareh paraal ||
verses.translation: You shall have to abandon the straw which you have collected.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaam na aaveh se ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: These entanglements shall be of no use to you.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na chaaleh tin siau heet ||
verses.translation: You are in love with those things that will not go with you.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਸੇਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo bairaiee seiee meet ||1||
verses.translation: You think that your enemies are friends. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaise bharam bhule sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: In such confusion, the world has gone astray.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath khoi gavaaraa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The foolish mortal wastes this precious human life. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: saach dharam nahee bhaavai ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: He does not like to see Truth and righteousness.

verses.original: ਝੂਠ ਧੋਹ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh dhoh siau rachio meeThaa ||
verses.translation: He is attached to falsehood and deception; they seem sweet to him.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhaat piaaree visariaa dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: He loves gifts, but he forgets the Giver.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaanai naahee maran vichaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vasat paraiee kau uTh rovai ||
verses.translation: He cries for the possessions of others.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਗਲਾ ਈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam sagalaa iee khovai ||
verses.translation: He forfeits all the merits of his good deeds and religion.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: hukam na boojhai aavan jaane ||
verses.translation: He does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and so he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paap karai taa pachhotaane ||3||
verses.translation: He sins, and then regrets and repents. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, Lord, that alone is acceptable.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tere bhaane no kurabaan ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gareeb ba(n)dhaa jan teraa ||
verses.translation: Poor Nanak is Your slave, Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: raakh lei saahib prabh meraa ||4||1||22||
verses.translation: Save me, O my Lord God Master! ||4||1||22||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: moh masakeen prabh naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: I am meek and poor; the Name of God is my only Support.

verses.original: ਖਾਟਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਜਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: khaaTan kau har har rojagaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my occupation and earnings.

verses.original: ਸੰਚਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)chan kau har eko naam ||
verses.translation: I gather only the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: halat palat taa kai aavai kaam ||1||
verses.translation: It is useful in both this world and the next. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate prabh ra(n)g apaar ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Love of the Lord God's Infinite Name,

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh gaaveh gun ek nira(n)kaar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: the Holy Saints sing the Glorious Praises of the One Lord, the Formless Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee sobhaa at masakeenee ||
verses.translation: The Glory of the Holy Saints comes from their total humility.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t vaddaiee har jas cheenee ||
verses.translation: The Saints realize that their greatness rests in the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sa(n)tan kai bhagat govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, the Saints are in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sookh sa(n)tan kai binasee chi(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: The Saints find peace, and their anxieties are dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeh saadh sa(n)tan hoveh ikatr ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Holy Saints gather,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: teh har jas gaaveh naadh kavit ||
verses.translation: there they sing the Praises of the Lord, in music and poetry.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sabhaa meh anadh bisraam ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, there is bliss and peace.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aun sa(n)g so paae jis masatak karaam ||3||
verses.translation: They alone obtain this Society, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR karee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: charan pakhaar kahaa(n) gunataas ||
verses.translation: I wash their feet, and chant the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaal kirapaal hajoor ||
verses.translation: O God, merciful and compassionate, let me remain in Your Presence.

verses.translit: naanak jeevai sa(n)taa dhoor ||4||2||23||
verses.translation: Nanak lives, in the dust of the Saints. ||4||2||23||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so kat ddarai j khasam sam(h)aarai ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?

verses.original: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ddar ddar pache manmukh vechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sir uoopar maat pitaa gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: safal moorat jaa kee niramal sev ||
verses.translation: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek nira(n)jan jaa kee raas ||
verses.translation: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)gat hovat paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined and enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeean kaa dhaataa pooran sabh Thai ||
verses.translation: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koT kales miTeh har nai ||
verses.translation: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran sagalaa dhukh naasai ||
verses.translation: All the pains of birth and death are taken away

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaa kai man tan baasai ||2||
verses.translation: from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no aap le laR lai ||
verses.translation: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh milai tisai hee jai ||
verses.translation: obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee bhagat j saache bhaane ||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jamakaal te bhe nikaane ||3||
verses.translation: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib sach dharabaar ||
verses.translation: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kaun kahai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Who can contemplate and describe His value?

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sagal adhaar ||
verses.translation: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.

verses.translit: naanak jaachai sa(n)t renaar ||4||3||24||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baahar teraa bharavaasaa too jan kai hai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa preetam prabh apune naam japau har ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau prabh apane kaa taan ||
verses.translation: God is the strength of His humble servants.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo too kareh karaaveh suaamee saa masalat paravaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome is acceptable to me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: pat paramesar gat naarain dhan gupaal gun saakhee ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorious sermon of the Lord is my wealth.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: charan saran naanak dhaas har har sa(n)tee ieh bidh jaatee ||2||1||25||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learned this way of life. ||2||1||25||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath prabh te paae ka(n)Th lai gur raakhe ||
verses.translation: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has saved me.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar meh jalan na dheene kinai na dhutar bhaakhe ||1||
verses.translation: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai man saachaa bisavaiaas ||
verses.translation: Those who have true faith in their minds,

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh suaamee kee sobhaa aanadh sadhaa ulaas || rahaau ||
verses.translation: continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਖਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran pooran paramesur a(n)tarajaamee saakhio ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher of hearts; I behold Him ever-present.

verses.original: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: jaan boojh apanaa keeo naanak bhagatan kaa a(n)kur raakhio ||2||2||26||
verses.translation: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of His devotees. ||2||2||26||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh pekhau teh hajoor dhoor katahu na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa sarabatr mai man sadhaa dhiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਛੁੜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot nahee beechhuRai so sa(n)gee ganeeaai ||
verses.translation: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here or hereafter.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binas jai jo nimakh meh so alap sukh bhaneeaai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਦੇਇ ਕਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaalai apiaau dhei kachh uoon na hoiee ||
verses.translation: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਮਾਲਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas saas sa(n)maalataa meraa prabh soiee ||2||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: achhal achhedh apaar prabh uoochaa jaa kaa roop ||
verses.translation: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਨ ਅਚਰਜ ਆਨੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jap jap kareh ana(n)dh jan acharaj aanoop ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humble servants are in bliss. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: saa mat dheh dhiaal prabh jit tumeh araadhaa ||
verses.translation: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan prabh ren pag saadhaa ||4||3||27||
verses.translation: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin tum bheje tineh bulaae sukh sahaj setee ghar aau ||
verses.translation: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal gun gaau sahaj dhun nihachal raaj kamaau ||1||
verses.translation: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: tum ghar aavahu mere meet ||
verses.translation: Come back to your home, O my friend.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tumare dhokhee har aap nivaare apadhaa bhiee biteet || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT keene prabh karanehaare naasan bhaajan thaake ||
verses.translation: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghar ma(n)gal vaajeh nit vaaje apunai khasam nivaaje ||2||
verses.translation: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: asathir rahahu ddolahu mat kabahoo gur kai bachan adhaar ||
verses.translation: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar sagal bhoo ma(n)ddal mukh uoojal dharabaar ||3||
verses.translation: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke jeea tinai hee fere aape bhiaa sahaiee ||
verses.translation: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: acharaj keeaa karanaihaarai naanak sach vaddiaaiee ||4||4||28||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨਉ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu sa(n)t piaare binau hamaare jeeau ||
verses.translation: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin mukat na kaahoo jeeau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man niramal karam kar taaran taran har avar ja(n)jaal terai kaahoo na kaam jeeau ||
verses.translation: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Other entanglements shall be of no use to you.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevan dhevaa paarabraham sevaa ih upadhes mo kau gur dheenaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਹੀਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੀਤੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau na laieeaai heet jaa ko kichh naahee beet a(n)t kee baar oh sa(n)g na chaalai ||
verses.translation: Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man tan too aaraadh har ke preetam saadh jaa kai sa(n)g tere ba(n)dhan chhooTai ||2||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨ ਅਵਰ ਆਸ ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gahu paarabraham saran hiradhai kamal charan avar aas kachh paTal na keejai ||
verses.translation: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God; do not place your hopes in any other support.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: soiee bhagat giaanee dhiaanee tapaa soiee naanak jaa kau kirapaa keejai ||3||1||29||
verses.translation: He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere laal bhalo re bhalo re bhalo har ma(n)ganaa ||
verses.translation: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਮਰਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhahu pasaar nain sunahu saadhoo ke bain praanapat chit raakh sagal hai maranaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints; enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਫੀਕੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan choaa ras bhog karat anekai bikhiaa bikaar dhekh sagal hai feeke ekai gobidh ko naam neeko kahat hai saadh jan ||
verses.translation: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of the Lord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tan dhan aapan thaapio har jap na nimakh jaapio arath dhrab dhekh kachh sa(n)g naahee chalanaa ||1||
verses.translation: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ko re karam bhalaa tin oT gahee sa(n)t palaa tin naahee re jam sa(n)taavai saadhoo kee sa(n)ganaa ||
verses.translation: One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threaten him.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: paio re param nidhaan miTio hai abhimaan ekai nira(n)kaar naanak man laganaa ||2||2||30||
verses.translation: I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak's mind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ek simar ek simar ek simar piaare ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales lobh moh mahaa bhaujal taare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas nimakh nimakh dhinas rain chitaare ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g man nidhaan dhaare ||1||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, and enshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal namasakaar gun gobidh beechaare ||
verses.translation: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kee ren naanak ma(n)gal sookh sadhaare ||2||1||31||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace. ||2||1||31||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar atthvaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Eighth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: simarau simar simar sukh paavau saas saas samaale ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਰਲੋਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eeh lok paralok sa(n)g sahaiee jat kat moh rakhavaale ||1||
verses.translation: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support; wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan basai jeea naale ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal nahee ddoobai tasakar nahee levai bhaeh na saakai jaale ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਟਿਕ ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: niradhan kau dhan a(n)dhule kau Tik maat dhoodh jaise baale ||
verses.translation: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: saagar meh bohith paio har naanak karee kirapaa kirapaale ||2||1||32||
verses.translation: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord has bestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal dhiaal gobi(n)dhaa a(n)mrit ridhai si(n)chaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectar permeates my heart.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nav nidh ridh sidh har laag rahee jan paiee ||1||
verses.translation: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling to the feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kau anadh sagal hee jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gireh baahar Thaakur bhagatan kaa rav rahiaa srab Thaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau koi na pahuchanahaaraa jaa kai a(n)g gusaiee ||
verses.translation: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: jam kee traas miTai jis simarat naanak naam dhiaaiee ||2||2||33||
verses.translation: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharabava(n)t dharab dhekh garabai bhoomava(n)t abhimaanee ||
verses.translation: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pride in his lands.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਟੇਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raajaa jaanai sagal raaj hamaraa tiau har jan Tek suaamee ||1||
verses.translation: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, the humble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਓਟ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: je kouoo apunee oT samaarai ||
verses.translation: When one considers the Lord to be his only support,

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਿਤੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa bit taisaa hoi varatai apunaa bal nahee haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਆਸਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: aan tiaag bhe ik aasar saran saran kar aae ||
verses.translation: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, ""Save me, save me!""

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t anugreh bhe man niramal naanak har gun gaae ||2||3||34||
verses.translation: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau har ra(n)g laago is jug meh so kaheeat hai sooraa ||
verses.translation: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aatam jinai sagal vas taa kai jaa kaa satigur pooraa ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur gaieeaai aatam ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.

verses.original: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saranee paavan naam dhiaavan sahaj samaavan sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan ke charan vaseh merai heearai sa(n)g puneetaa dhehee ||
verses.translation: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is made pure.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: jan kee dhoor dheh kirapaa nidh naanak kai sukh ehee ||2||4||35||
verses.translation: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jatan karai maanukh ddahakaavai oh a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
verses.translation: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paap kare kar mookar paavai bhekh karai nirabaanai ||1||
verses.translation: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaanat dhoor tumeh prabh ner ||
verses.translation: They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

verses.original: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aut taakai ut te ut pekhai aavai lobhee fer || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag tuTai naahee man bharamaa tab lag mukat na koiee ||
verses.translation: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhiaal suaamee sa(n)t bhagat jan soiee ||2||5||36||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, to whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam gur dheeo hai apunai jaa kai masatak karamaa ||
verses.translation: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhiraRaavai naam japaavai taa kaa jug meh dharamaa ||1||
verses.translation: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, true religion, in this world. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸੋਭ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau naam vaddaiee sobh ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamo gat naamo pat jan kee maanai jo jo hog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhan jis jan kai paalai soiee pooraa saahaa ||
verses.translation: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naam biauhaaraa naanak aadhaaraa naam paraapat laahaa ||2||6||37||
verses.translation: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit he earns. ||2||6||37||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: netr puneet bhe dharas pekhe maathai parau ravaal ||
verses.translation: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਮੋਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ras ras gun gaavau Thaakur ke morai hiradhai basahu gopaal ||1||
verses.translation: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: tum tau raakhanahaar dhiaal ||
verses.translation: You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sughar bea(n)t pitaa prabh hoh prabhoo kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh ma(n)gal roop tumare bachan anoop rasaal ||
verses.translation: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenched with Nectar.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: hiradhai charan sabadh satigur ko naanak baa(n)dhio paal ||2||7||38||
verses.translation: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖੇਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: apanee ukat khalaavai bhojan apanee ukat khelaavai ||
verses.translation: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh bhog ras dhevai man hee naal samaavai ||1||
verses.translation: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoyments and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: hamare pitaa gopaal dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau raakhai mahataaree baarik kau taise hee prabh paal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: meet saajan sarab gun naik sadhaa salaamat dhevaa ||
verses.translation: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot jat kat tat tum hee milai naanak sa(n)t sevaa ||2||8||39||
verses.translation: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve the Saints. ||2||8||39||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kirapaal dhiaal dhamodhar kaam karodh bikh jaare ||
verses.translation: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger and corruption.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਇਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raaj maal joban tan jeearaa in uoopar lai baare ||1||
verses.translation: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raam naam hitakaare ||
verses.translation: With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ma(n)gal sahit bhav nidh paar utaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਭਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n su thaan dha(n)n oi bhavanaa jaa meh sa(n)t basaare ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that place, and blessed is that house, in which the Saints dwell.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kee saradhaa poorahu Thaakur bhagat tere namasakaare ||2||9||40||
verses.translation: Fulfill this desire of servant Nanak, O Lord Master, that he may bow in reverence to Your devotees. ||2||9||40||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhaddai leeo mahaa balee te apane charan paraat ||
verses.translation: He has saved me from the awful power of Maya, by attaching me to His feet.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨ ਮੰਤਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek naam dheeo man ma(n)taa binas na katahoo jaat ||1||
verses.translation: He gave my mind the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, which shall never perish or leave me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai keenee dhaat ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru has given this gift.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheeo keeratan kau bhiee hamaaree gaat || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has blessed me with the Kirtan of the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I am emancipated. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai bhagatan kee raakhee paat ||
verses.translation: My God has made me His own, and saved the honor of His devotee.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: naanak charan gahe prabh apane sukh paio dhin raat ||2||10||41||
verses.translation: Nanak has grasped the feet of his God, and has found peace, day and night. ||2||10||41||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰ ਹਰਨਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਦਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: par haranaa lobh jhooTh ni(n)dh iv hee karat gudhaaree ||
verses.translation: Stealing the property of others, acting in greed, lying and slandering - in these ways, he passes his life.

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ਇਹ ਟੇਕ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mirag tirasanaa aas mithiaa meeThee ieh Tek maneh saadhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: He places his hopes in false mirages, believing them to be sweet; this is the support he installs in his mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਵਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saakat kee aavaradhaa jai birathaaree ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic passes his life uselessly.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਮੂਸਾ ਟੂਕਿ ਗਵਾਵਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise kaagadh ke bhaar moosaa Took gavaavat kaam nahee gaavaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is like the mouse, gnawing away at the pile of paper, making it useless to the poor wretch. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ieh ba(n)dhan chhuTakaaree ||
verses.translation: Have mercy on me, O Supreme Lord God, and release me from these bonds.

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਅੰਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਢਤ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: booddat a(n)dh naanak prabh kaaddat saadh janaa sa(n)gaaree ||2||11||42||
verses.translation: The blind are sinking, O Nanak; God saves them, uniting them with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||42||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਛਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa seetal tan man chhaatee ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering God, the Lord Master in meditation, my body, mind and heart are cooled and soothed.

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੂਖ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਰੈ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roop ra(n)g sookh dhan jeea kaa paarabraham morai jaatee ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is my beauty, pleasure, peace, wealth, soul and social status. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam rasain maatee ||
verses.translation: My tongue is intoxicated with the Lord, the source of nectar.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g ra(n)gee raam apane kai charan kamal nidh thaatee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in love, in love with the Lord's lotus feet, the treasure of riches. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leeaa pooran prabh kee bhaatee ||
verses.translation: I am His - He has saved me; this is God's perfect way.

verses.original: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: mel leeo aape sukhadhaatai naanak har raakhee paatee ||2||12||43||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace has blended Nanak with Himself; the Lord has preserved his honor. ||2||12||43||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoot dhusaman sabh tujh te nivareh pragaT prataap tumaaraa ||
verses.translation: All demons and enemies are eradicated by You, Lord; Your glory is manifest and radiant.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਦੁਖਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo tere bhagat dhukhaae oh tatakaal tum maaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever harms Your devotees, You destroy in an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: nirakhau tumaree or har neet ||
verses.translation: I look to You continually, Lord.

verses.original: ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: muraar sahai hoh dhaas kau kar geh udharahu meet || rahaau ||
