verses.translation: O Lord, Destroyer of ego, please, be the helper and companion of Your slaves; take my hand, and save me, O my Friend! ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sunee benatee Thaakur merai khasamaanaa kar aap ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and given me His protection.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: naanak anadh bhe dhukh bhaage sadhaa sadhaa har jaap ||2||13||44||
verses.translation: Nanak is in ecstasy, and his pains are gone; he meditates on the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||13||44||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: chatur dhisaa keeno bal apanaa sir uoopar kar dhaario ||
verses.translation: He has extended His power in all four directions, and placed His hand upon my head.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਅਵਲੋਕਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kaTaakhaye avalokan keeno dhaas kaa dhookh bidhaario ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon me with his Eye of Mercy, He has dispelled the pains of His slave. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: har jan raakhe gur govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has saved the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਟੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai avagun sabh meTe dhiaal purakh bakhasa(n)dh || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hugging me close in His embrace, the merciful, forgiving Lord has erased all my sins. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo maageh Thaakur apune te soiee soiee dhevai ||
verses.translation: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas mukh te jo bolai ieehaa uoohaa sach hovai ||2||14||45||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord's slave Nanak utters with his mouth, proves to be true, here and hereafter. ||2||14||45||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਉਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੇਈ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhee ghaRee na dhekhan dheiee apanaa biradh samaale ||
verses.translation: He does not let His devotees see the difficult times; this is His innate nature.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhai apane kau saas saas pratipaale ||1||
verses.translation: Giving His hand, He protects His devotee; with each and every breath, He cherishes him. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh siau laag rahio meraa cheet ||
verses.translation: My consciousness remains attached to God.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t prabh sadhaa sahaiee dha(n)n hamaaraa meet || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, and in the end, God is always my helper and companion; blessed is my friend. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man bilaas bhe saahib ke acharaj dhekh baddaiee ||
verses.translation: My mind is delighted, gazing upon the marvellous, glorious greatness of the Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਆਨਦ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: har simar simar aanadh kar naanak prabh pooran paij rakhaiee ||2||15||46||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak is in ecstasy; God, in His perfection, has protected and preserved his honor. ||2||15||46||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau bisarai praanapat dhaataa soiee ganahu abhaagaa ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਗਿਓ ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਪਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagio amia sarovar paagaa ||1||
verses.translation: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosial nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa jan raam naam ra(n)g jaagaa ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਆਲਸੁ ਛੀਜਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aalas chheej giaa sabh tan te preetam siau man laagaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh pekhau teh naarain sagal ghaTaa meh taagaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naam udhak peevat jan naanak tiaage sabh anuraagaa ||2||16||47||
verses.translation: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves. ||2||16||47||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jan ke pooran hoe kaam ||
verses.translation: All the affairs of the Lord's humble servant are perfectly resolved.

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaal mahaa bikhiaa meh lajaa raakhee raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the utterly poisonous Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord preserves and protects his honor. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa nikaT na aavai jaam ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering God, his Lord and Master in meditation, the Messenger of Death does not approach him.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukat baiku(n)Th saadh kee sa(n)gat jan paio har kaa dhaam ||1||
verses.translation: Liberation and heaven are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; his humble servant finds the home of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਥਾਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal har jan kee thaatee koT sookh bisraam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's lotus feet are the treasure of His humble servant; in them, he finds millions of pleasures and comforts.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh dhamodhar simarau dhin rain naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||17||48||
verses.translation: He remembers the Lord God in meditation, day and night; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||2||17||48||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maa(n)gau raam te ik dhaan ||
verses.translation: I beg for one gift only from the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooran hoveh simarau tumaraa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: May all my desires be fulfilled, meditating on, and remembering Your Name, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan tum(h)aare hiradhai vaaseh sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)g paavau ||
verses.translation: May Your feet abide within my heart, and may I find the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sog agan meh man na viaapai aaTh pahar gun gaavau ||1||
verses.translation: May my mind not be afflicted by the fire of sorrow; may I sing Your Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਧੵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਣ ॥
verses.translit: savaisat bivasathaa har kee sevaa madhaye(n)t prabh jaapan ||
verses.translation: May I serve the Lord in my childhood and youth, and meditate on God in my middle and old age.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਛਾਪਣ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g lagaa paramesar baahuR janam na chhaapan ||2||18||49||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord, is not reincarnated again to die. ||2||18||49||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: maa(n)gau raam te sabh thok ||
verses.translation: I beg only from the Lord for all things.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੋਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maanukh kau jaachat sram paieeaai prabh kai simaran mokh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberation is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੋਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਘੋਖ ॥
verses.translit: ghokhe mun jan si(n)mirat puraanaa(n) bedh pukaareh ghokh ||
verses.translation: I have studied with the silent sages, and carefully read the Simritees, the Puraanas and the Vedas; they all proclaim that,

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa si(n)dh sev sach paieeaai dhovai suhele lok ||1||
verses.translation: by serving the Lord, the ocean of mercy, Truth is obtained, and both this world and the next are embellished. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਫੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: aan achaar biauhaar hai jete bin har simaran fok ||
verses.translation: All other rituals and customs are useless, without remembering the Lord in meditation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਕ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak janam maran bhai kaaTe mil saadhoo binase sok ||2||19||50||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the fear of birth and death has been removed; meeting the Holy Saint, sorrow is dispelled. ||2||19||50||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa bujhai har kai naam ||
verses.translation: Desire is quenched, through the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa sa(n)tokh hovai gur bachanee prabh siau laagai pooran dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Great peace and contentment come through the Guru's Word, and one's meditation is perfectly focused upon God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਕਲੋਲ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa kalol bujheh maiaa ke kar kirapaa mere dheen dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, and permit me to ignore the great enticements of Maya, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apanaa naam dheh jap jeevaa pooran hoi dhaas kee ghaal ||1||
verses.translation: Give me Your Name - chanting it, I live; please bring the efforts of Your slave to fruition. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਸੂਖ ਰਸ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sarab manorath raaj sookh ras sadh khuseeaa keeratan jap naam ||
verses.translation: All desires, power, pleasure, joy and lasting bliss, are found by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing the Kirtan of His Praises.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: jis kai karam likhiaa dhur karatai naanak jan ke pooran kaam ||2||20||51||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord, who has such karma pre-ordained by the Creator Lord, O Nanak - his efforts are brought to perfect fruition. ||2||20||51||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee keenee paarabraham saar ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God takes care of His humble servant.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਊਡਿ ਗਏ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak Tikan na paavan moole uoodd ge bekaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The slanderers are not allowed to stay; they are pulled out by their roots, like useless weeds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhau teh teh suaamee koi na pahuchanahaar ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master; no one can harm me.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਤਤ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo karai avagiaa jan kee hoi giaa tat chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever shows disrespect to the Lord's humble servant, is instantly reduced to ashes. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: karanahaar rakhavaalaa hoaa jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has become my protector; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas rakhe prabh apunai ni(n)dhak kaadde maar ||2||21||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God has protected and saved His slaves; He has driven out and destroyed the slanderers. ||2||21||52||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar nauvaa paRataal
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Ninth House, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har charan saran gobi(n)dh dhukh bha(n)janaa dhaas apune kau naam dhevahu ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of Your feet; Lord of the Universe, Destroyer of pain, please bless Your slave with Your Name.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT prabh dhaarahu kirapaa kar taarahu bhujaa geh koop te kaadd levahu || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, God, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace; take my arm and save me - pull me up out of this pit! ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖਾ ਤਨਿ ਛਾਦਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh kar a(n)dh maiaa ke ba(n)dh anik dhokhaa tan chhaadh poore ||
verses.translation: He is blinded by sexual desire and anger, bound by Maya; his body and clothes are filled with countless sins.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh binaa aan na raakhanahaaraa naam simaraavahu saran soore ||1||
verses.translation: Without God, there is no other protector; help me to chant Your Name, Almighty Warrior, Sheltering Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤਾਰਣਾ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaranaa jeea ja(n)t taaranaa bedh uchaar nahee a(n)t paio ||
verses.translation: Redeemer of sinners, Saving Grace of all beings and creatures, even those who recite the Vedas have not found Your limit.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਤਨਾਗਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: guneh sukh saagaraa braham ratanaagaraa bhagat vachhal naanak gaio ||2||1||53||
verses.translation: God is the ocean of virtue and peace, the source of jewels; Nanak sings the Praises of the Lover of His devotees. ||2||1||53||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: halat sukh palat sukh nit sukh simarano naam gobi(n)dh kaa sadhaa leejai ||
verses.translation: Peace in this world, peace in the next world and peace forever, remembering Him in meditation. Chant forever the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪਾਪ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miTeh kamaane paap chiraane saadhasa(n)gat mil muaa jeejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sins of past lives are erased, by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; new life is infused into the dead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: raaj joban bisara(n)t har maiaa mahaa dhukh eh mahaa(n)t kahai ||
verses.translation: In power, youth and Maya, the Lord is forgotten; this is the greatest tragedy - so say the spiritual sages.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਮਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਾਗਵੰਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas piaas raman har keeratan eh padhaarath bhaagava(n)t lahai ||1||
verses.translation: Hope and desire to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - this is the treasure of the most fortunate devotees. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saran samarath akath agocharaa patit udhaaran naam teraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord of Sanctuary, all-powerful, imperceptible and unfathomable - Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee naanak ke suaamee sarabat pooran Thaakur meraa ||2||2||54||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Lord and Master of Nanak is totally pervading and permeating everywhere; He is my Lord and Master. ||2||2||54||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar baarvaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Twelfth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬੰਦਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhanaa har ba(n)dhanaa gun gaavahu gopaal rai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I bow in reverence to the Lord, I bow in reverence. I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my King. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag bheTe gurdhevaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one meets the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT paraadh miTe har sevaa ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are erased by serving the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jaa kaa man raapai ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's lotus feet

verses.original: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sog agan tis jan na biaapai ||2||
verses.translation: is not afflicted by the fire of sorrow. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: saagar tariaa saadhoo sa(n)ge ||
verses.translation: He crosses over the world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nirabhau naam japahu har ra(n)ge ||3||
verses.translation: He chants the Name of the Fearless Lord, and is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੋਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਫੇੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan dhokh kichh paap na feRe ||
verses.translation: One who does not steal the wealth of others, who does not commit evil deeds or sinful acts

verses.original: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam ja(n)dhaar na aavai neRe ||4||
verses.translation: - the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||4||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa agan prabh aap bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: God Himself quenches the fires of desire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak udhare prabh saranaiee ||5||1||55||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||5||1||55||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat bhiee sach bhojan khaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am satisfied and satiated, eating the food of Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan rasanaa naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: With my mind, body and tongue, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevanaa har jeevanaa ||
verses.translation: Life, spiritual life, is in the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan har jap saadhasa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Spiritual life consists of chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਓਢਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anik prakaaree basatr oddaae ||
verses.translation: He is dressed in robes of all sorts,

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin keeratan har gun gaae ||2||
verses.translation: if he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises, day and night. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee rath as asavaaree ||
verses.translation: He rides upon elephants, chariots and horses,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa maarag ridhai nihaaree ||3||
verses.translation: if he sees the Lord's Path within his own heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar charan dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, deep within his mind and body,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: har sukh nidhaan naanak dhaas paiaa ||4||2||56||
verses.translation: slave Nanak has found the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||4||2||56||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan jeea kaa nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's feet emancipate the soul.

verses.original: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: samu(n)dh saagar jin khin meh taaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They carry it across the world-ocean in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee hoaa karam rat koiee teerath naiaa ||
verses.translation: Some love rituals, and some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਦਾਸੰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaasa(n)ee har kaa naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves meditate on His Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaTanahaar suaamee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is the Breaker of bonds.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak simarai a(n)tarajaamee ||2||3||57||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||2||3||57||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਿ ਨ ਤੂਟਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kitai prakaar na tooTau preet || dhaas tere kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The lifestyle of Your slave is so pure, that nothing can break his love for You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan man dhan te piaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is more dear to me than my soul, my breath of life, my mind and my wealth.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai ba(n)dh har dhevanahaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Giver, the Restrainer of the ego. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laagau neh ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੪॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee eh ||2||4||58||
verses.translation: This alone is Nanak's prayer. ||2||4||58||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਬਨ ਖੋਜਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe re ban khojan jaiee ||
verses.translation: Why do you go looking for Him in the forest?

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਤੋਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nivaasee sadhaa alepaa tohee sa(n)g samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Although he is unattached, he dwells everywhere. He is always with you as your companion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੁਹਪ ਮਧਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: puhap madh jiau baas basat hai mukar maeh jaise chhaiee ||
verses.translation: Like the fragrance which remains in the flower, and like the reflection in the mirror,

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taise hee har base nira(n)tar ghaT hee khojahu bhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: the Lord dwells deep within; search for Him within your own heart, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bheetar eko jaanahu ih gur giaan bataiee ||
verses.translation: Outside and inside, know that there is only the One Lord; the Guru has imparted this wisdom to me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bin aapaa cheenai miTai na bhram kee kaiee ||2||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, without knowing one's own self, the moss of doubt is not removed. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadho ih jag bharam bhulaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Holy people, this world is deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kaa simaran chhoddiaa maiaa haath bikaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It has forsaken the meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name, and sold itself out to Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa taa kai ras lapaTaanaa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - he is entangled in their love.

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: joban dhan prabhataa kai madh mai ahinis rahai dhivaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal sadhaa dhukh bha(n)jan taa siau man na lagaanaa ||
verses.translation: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak koTan mai kinahoo gurmukh hoi pachhaanaa ||2||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: teh jogee kau jugat na jaanau ||
verses.translation: That Yogi does not know the way.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh maiaa mamataa fun jeh ghaT maeh pachhaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa usatat neh jaa kai ka(n)chan loh samaano ||
verses.translation: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa jogee taeh bakhaano ||1||
verses.translation: who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal man dheh dhis kau dhaavat achal jaeh Thaharaano ||
verses.translation: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ieh bidh ko jo nar mukat taeh tum maano ||2||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab mai kaun upaau karau ||
verses.translation: Now, what efforts should I make?

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bidh man ko sa(n)saa chookai bhau nidh paar parau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam pai kachh bhalo na keeno taa te adhik ddarau ||
verses.translation: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me very afraid!

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਯਹ ਜੀਅ ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man bach karam har gun nahee gaae yeh jeea soch dharau ||1||
verses.translation: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat sun kachh giaan na upajio pas jiau udhar bharau ||
verses.translation: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; like a beast, I fill my belly.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੫੮॥੪॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh biradh pachhaanau tab hau patit tarau ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner, be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saagar ratanee bharapoore ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit sa(n)t chugeh nahee dhoore ||
verses.translation: The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chog chugeh prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saravar meh ha(n)s praanapat paavai ||1||
verses.translation: Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਛਪੜੀ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa bag bapuRaa chhapaRee nai ||
verses.translation: What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?

verses.original: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: keechaR ddoobai mail na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: rakh rakh charan dhare veechaaree ||
verses.translation: After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa chhodd bhe nira(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath har ras chaakhe ||
verses.translation: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe gur raakhe ||2||
verses.translation: His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saravar ha(n)saa chhodd na jai ||
verses.translation: The swan do not leave this pool.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat kar sahaj samai ||
verses.translation: In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saravar meh ha(n)s ha(n)s meh saagar ||
verses.translation: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਆਦਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa gur bachanee aadhar ||3||
verses.translation: They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n ma(n)ddal ik jogee baise ||
verses.translation: The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: naar na purakh kahahu kouoo kaise ||
verses.translation: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan jot rahe liv laiee ||
verses.translation: The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਸਚੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sur nar naath sache saranaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh mool anaath adhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat sahaj beechaaree ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhai kaaTanahaare ||
verses.translation: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: haumai maar mile pag dhaare ||5||
verses.translation: Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar kaal sa(n)taae ||
verses.translation: He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: maran likhai ma(n)ddal meh aae ||
verses.translation: Destined only to die, he comes into the world.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath dhubidhaa khovai ||
verses.translation: He wastes this precious human life through duality.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aap na cheenas bhram bhram rovai ||6||
verses.translation: He does not know his own self, and trapped by doubts, he cries out in pain. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਹਤਉ ਪੜਤਉ ਸੁਣਤਉ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: kahatau paRatau sunatau ek ||
verses.translation: Speak, read and hear of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: dheeraj dharam dharaneedhar Tek ||
verses.translation: The Support of the earth shall bless you with courage, righteousness and protection.

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam ridhai samaae ||
verses.translation: Chastity, purity and self-restraint are infused into the heart,

verses.original: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: chauthe padh kau je man pateeaae ||7||
verses.translation: when one centers his mind in the fourth state. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: saache niramal mail na laagai ||
verses.translation: They are immaculate and true, and filth does not stick to them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bharam bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, their doubt and fear depart.

verses.original: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: soorat moorat aadh anoop ||
verses.translation: The form and personality of the Primal Lord are incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jaachai saach saroop ||8||1||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the Lord, the Embodiment of Truth. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj milai miliaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: That union with the Lord is acceptable, which is united in intuitive poise.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis maran na aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: Thereafter, one does not die, and does not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur meh dhaas dhaas meh soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave is in the Lord, and the Lord is in His slave.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh avar na koi ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see none other than the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat sahaj ghar paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and find His celestial home.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur bheTe mar aaieeaai jaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without meeting the Guru, they die, and come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so gur karau j saach dhiraRaavai ||
verses.translation: So make Him your Guru, who implants the Truth within you,

verses.original: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaavai sabadh milaavai ||
verses.translation: who leads you to speak the Unspoken Speech, and who merges you in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ke log avar nahee kaaraa ||
verses.translation: God's people have no other work to do;

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachau Thaakur saach piaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: they love the True Lord and Master, and they love the Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan meh manooaa man meh saachaa ||
verses.translation: The mind is in the body, and the True Lord is in the mind.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: so saachaa mil saache raachaa ||
verses.translation: Merging into the True Lord, one is absorbed into Truth.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak prabh kai laagai pai ||
verses.translation: God's servant bows at His feet.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa milai milai ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one meets with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap dhikhaavai aape dhekhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself watches over us, and He Himself makes us see.

verses.original: ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: haTh na pateejai naa bahu bhekhai ||
verses.translation: He is not pleased by stubborn-mindedness, nor by various religious robes.

verses.original: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaR bhaadde jin a(n)mrit paiaa ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the body-vessels, and infused the Ambrosial Nectar into them;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat prabh man pateeaaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: God's Mind is pleased only by loving devotional worship. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR bhooleh choTaa khaeh ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying, one becomes confused, and suffers punishment.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bahut siaanap aaveh jaeh ||
verses.translation: By great cleverness, one is consigned to coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਭਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam japai bhau bhojan khai ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and eats the food of the Fear of God

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevak rahe samai ||5||
verses.translation: becomes Gurmukh, the Lord's servant, and remains absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਨ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooj silaa teerath ban vaasaa ||
verses.translation: He worships stones, dwells at sacred shrines of pilgrimage and in the jungles,

verses.original: ਭਰਮਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharamat ddolat bhe udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: wanders, roams around and becomes a renunciate.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mailai soochaa kiau hoi ||
verses.translation: But his mind is still filthy - how can he become pure?

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saach milai paavai pat soi ||6||
verses.translation: One who meets the True Lord obtains honor. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਚਾਰਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aachaaraa veechaar sareer ||
verses.translation: One who embodies good conduct and contemplative meditation,

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh sahaj man dheer ||
verses.translation: his mind abides in intuitive poise and contentment, since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pal pa(n)kaj meh koT udhaare ||
verses.translation: In the twinkling of an eye, he saves millions.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gur mel piaare ||7||
verses.translation: Have mercy on me, O my Beloved, and let me meet the Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kis aagai prabh tudh saalaahee ||
verses.translation: Unto whom, O God, should I praise You?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa mai ko naahee ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tudh bhaavai tiau raakh rajai ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, keep me under Your Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj bhai gun gai ||8||2||
verses.translation: Nanak, with intuitive poise and natural love, sings Your Glorious Praises. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa asaTapadhee
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo joonee aaio teh teh urajhaio maanas janam sa(n)jog paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.

verses.original: ਤਾਕੀ ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taakee hai oT saadh raakhahu dhe kar haath kar kirapaa melahu har raiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By Your Grace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam bhram thit nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karau sevaa gur laagau charan govi(n)dh jee kaa maarag dheh jee bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, ""O Dear Lord of the Universe, please, show me the way.""||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: anik upaav karau maiaa kau bachit dharau meree meree karat sadh hee vihaavai ||
verses.translation: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in my mind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, ""Mine, mine!""

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koiee aaiso re bheTai sa(n)t meree laahai sagal chi(n)t Thaakur siau meraa ra(n)g laavai ||2||
verses.translation: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: paRe re sagal bedh neh chookai man bhedh ik khin na dheereh mere ghar ke pa(n)chaa ||
verses.translation: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koiee aaiso re bhagatu ju maiaa te rahat ik a(n)mirat naam merai ridhai si(n)chaa ||3||
verses.translation: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jete re teerath naae aha(n)budh mail laae ghar ko Thaakur ik til na maanai ||
verses.translation: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

verses.original: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kadh paavau saadhasa(n)g har har sadhaa aana(n)dh giaan a(n)jan meraa man isanaanai ||4||
verses.translation: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: sagal asram keene manooaa neh pateene bibekaheen dhehee dhoe ||
verses.translation: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: koiee paieeaai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai ra(n)g raataa mere man kee dhuramat mal khoe ||5||
verses.translation: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab paRai kahee na lekhai ||
verses.translation: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis bheTeeaai safal moorat karai sadhaa keerat gur parasaadh kouoo netrahu pekhai ||6||
verses.translation: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiau dhiaan laavai maiaa re dhaaree ||
verses.translation: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: koiee aaiso re sukheh dhaiee prabh kee kathaa sunaiee tis bheTe gat hoi hamaaree ||7||
verses.translation: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: suprasa(n)n gopaal rai kaaTai re ba(n)dhan mai gur kai sabadh meraa man raataa ||
verses.translation: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa aana(n)dh bheTio nirabhai gobi(n)dh sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa ||8||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: safal safal bhiee safal jaatraa ||
verses.translation: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||3||
verses.translation: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: teerath naavan jaau teerath naam hai ||
verses.translation: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: teerath sabadh beechaar a(n)tar giaan hai ||
verses.translation: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan saachaa thaan teerath dhas purab sadhaa dhasaaharaa ||
verses.translation: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, where the ten festivals are always observed.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau naam har kaa sadhaa jaachau dheh prabh dharaneedharaa ||
verses.translation: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar rogee naam dhaaroo mail laagai sach binaa ||
verses.translation: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filth sticks to it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur vaak niramal sadhaa chaanan nit saach teerath majanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathe in such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saach na laagai mail kiaa mal dhoieeaai ||
verses.translation: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?

verses.original: ਗੁਣਹਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: guneh haar paroi kis kau roieeaai ||
verses.translation: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?

verses.original: ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: veechaar maarai tarai taarai ulaT jon na aave ||
verses.translation: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others as well; he does not come to be born again.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap paaras param dhiaanee saach saache bhaave ||
verses.translation: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh anadhin harakh saachaa dhookh kilavikh parahare ||
verses.translation: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚ ਮਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach naam paiaa gur dhikhaiaa mail naahee sach mane ||2||
verses.translation: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat meet milaap pooraa naavano ||
verses.translation: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai gaavanahaar sabadh suhaavano ||
verses.translation: The singer who sings the Lord's Praises is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: saalaeh saache ma(n)n satigur pu(n)n dhaan dhiaa mate ||
verses.translation: Worship the True Lord, and believe in the True Guru; this brings the merit of making donations to charity, kindness and compassion.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੇਣੀ ਤ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir sa(n)g bhaavai sahaj naavai benee ta sa(n)gam sat sate ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who loves to be with her Husband Lord bathes at the true Triveni of the soul, which she regards as the sacred place where the Ganges, Jamuna and Saraswaati Rivers converge.

verses.original: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaraadh eka(n)kaar saachaa nit dhei chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the One Creator, the True Lord, who constantly gives, whose gifts continually increase.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gat sa(n)g meetaa sa(n)tasa(n)gat kar nadhar mel milaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Salvation is attained by associating with the Society of the Saints, O friend; granting His Grace, God unites us in His Union. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kahan kahai sabh koi kevadd aakheeaai ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks and talks; how great should I say He is?

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਸਮਝਾ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hau moorakh neech ajaan samajhaa saakheeaai ||
verses.translation: I am foolish, lowly and ignorant; it is only through the Guru's Teachings that I understand.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach gur kee saakhee a(n)mirat bhaakhee tit man maaniaa meraa ||
verses.translation: True are the Teachings of the Guru. His Words are Ambrosial Nectar; my mind is pleased and appeased by them.

verses.original: ਕੂਚੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kooch kareh aaveh bikh laadhe sabadh sachai gur meraa ||
verses.translation: Loaded down with corruption and sin, people depart, and then come back again; the True Shabad is found through my Guru.

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan toT na bhagat bha(n)ddaaree bharipur rahiaa soiee ||
verses.translation: There is no end to the treasure of devotion; the Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee man maa(n)jai sach soiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Nanak utters this true prayer; one who purifies his mind is True. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevaa terai nai man aana(n)dh hai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I live by Your Name; my mind is in ecstasy, Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saacho saachaa naau gun govi(n)dh hai jeeau ||
verses.translation: True is the Name of the True Lord. Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan apaaraa sirajanahaaraa jin sirajee tin goiee ||
verses.translation: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created, shall also destroy.

verses.original: ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: paravaanaa aaiaa hukam paThaiaa fer na sakai koiee ||
verses.translation: The call of death is sent out by the Lord's Command; no one can challenge it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape kar vekhai sir sir lekhai aape surat bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and watches; His written command is above each and every head. He Himself imparts understanding and awareness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib agam agochar jeevaa sachee naiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Master is inaccessible and unfathomable; I live by His True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum sar avar na koi aaiaa jaisee jeeau ||
verses.translation: No one can compare to You, Lord; all come and go.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hoi nibeR bharam chukaisee jeeau ||
verses.translation: By Your Command, the account is settled, and doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਏ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bharam chukaae akath kahaae sach meh saach samaanaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru dispels doubt, and makes us speak the Unspoken Speech; the true ones are absorbed into Truth.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae aap samaae hukamee hukam pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; I accept the Command of the Commander Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachee vaddiaaiee gur te paiee too man a(n)t sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: True greatness comes from the Guru; You alone are the mind's companion in the end.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib avar na dhoojaa naam terai vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no other than the Lord and Master; greatness comes from Your Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਸਿਰੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa sirajanahaar alakh sira(n)dhiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the True Creator Lord, the unknowable Maker.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਵਾਦ ਵਧੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek saahib dhui raeh vaadh vadha(n)dhiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: There is only the One Lord and Master, but there are two paths, by which conflict increases.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhui raeh chalaae hukam sabaae janam muaa sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa naahee ko belee bikh laadhee sir bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal has no friend at all; he carries loads of sin on his head.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee aaiaa hukam na boojhai hukam savaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he comes, but he does not understand this Hukam; the Lord's Hukam is the Embellisher.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib sabadh sin(j)aapai saachaa sirajanahaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord and Master, the True Creator Lord is realized. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat soheh dharavaar sabadh suhaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Your devotees look beautiful in Your Court, embellished with the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: boleh a(n)mirat baan rasan rasaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: They chant the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, savoring it with their tongues.

verses.original: ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਿਸਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਕਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: rasan rasaae naam tisaae gur kai sabadh vikaane ||
verses.translation: Savoring it with their tongues, they thirst for the Naam; they are a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: paaras parasiaai paaras hoe jaa terai man bhaane ||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, they become the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; O Lord, they become pleasing to your mind.

verses.original: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: amaraa padh paiaa aap gavaiaa viralaa giaan veechaaree ||
verses.translation: They attain the immortal status and eradicate their self-conceit; how rare is that person, who contemplates spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat sohan dhar saachai saache ke vaapaaree ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the True Lord; they are dealers in the Truth. ||4||

verses.original: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਆਥਿ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhookh piaaso aath kiau dhar jaisaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am hungry and thirsty for wealth; how will I be able to go to the Lord's Court?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poochhau jai naam dhiaaisaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: I shall go and ask the True Guru, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਚਵਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam dhiaaiee saach chavaiee gurmukh saach pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the True Name, chant the True Name, and as Gurmukh, I realize the True Name.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath dhiaal nira(n)jan anadhin naam vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I chant the Name of the merciful, immaculate Lord, the Master of the poor.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kaar dhurahu furamaiee aap muaa man maaree ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord has ordained the tasks to be done; self-conceit is overcome, and the mind is subdued.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam mahaa ras meeThaa tirasanaa naam nivaaree ||5||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is the sweetest essence; through the Naam, thirst and desire are stilled. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਠੜੀਏ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir sa(n)g mooThaRe'e khabar na paieeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Your Husband Lord is with you, O deluded soul-bride, but you do are not aware of Him.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: masatak likhiaRaa lekh purab kamaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Your destiny is written on your forehead, according to your past actions.

verses.original: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: lekh na miTiee purab kamaiaa kiaa jaanaa kiaa hosee ||
verses.translation: This inscription of past deeds cannot be erased; what do I know about what will happen?

verses.original: ਗੁਣੀ ਅਚਾਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gunee achaar nahee ra(n)g raatee avagun beh beh rosee ||
verses.translation: You have not adopted a virtuous lifestyle, and you are not attuned to the Lord's Love; you sit there, crying over your past misdeeds.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਆਕ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan joban aak kee chhaiaa biradh bhe dhin pu(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: Wealth and youth are like the shade of the bitter swallow-wort plant; you are growing old, and your days are coming to their end.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਛੂਟੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam binaa dhohaagan chhooTee jhooTh vichhu(n)niaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall end up as a discarded, divorced bride; your own falsehood shall separate you from the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੂਡੀ ਘਰੁ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: booddee ghar ghaalio gur kai bhai chalo ||
verses.translation: You have drowned, and your house is ruined; walk in the Way of the Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa naam dhiaai paaveh sukh mahalo ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the True Name, and you shall find peace in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaae taa sukh paae peieeaRai dhin chaare ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shall last only four days.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar jai bahai sach paae anadhin naal piaare ||
verses.translation: Sit in the home of your own being, and you shall find Truth; night and day, be with your Beloved.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vin bhagatee ghar vaas na hovee suniahu lok sabaae ||
verses.translation: Without loving devotion, you cannot dwell in your own home - listen, everyone!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਸੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sarasee taa pir paae raatee saachai naae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is happy, and she obtains her Husband Lord, if she is attuned to the True Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir dhan bhaavai taa pir bhaavai naaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: If the soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, then the Husband Lord will love His bride.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g preetam raatee gur kai sabadh veechaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the love of her Beloved, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh veechaaree naeh piaaree niv niv bhagat kareiee ||
verses.translation: She contemplates the Guru's Shabads, and her Husband Lord loves her; in deep humility, she worships Him in loving devotion.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh jalaae preetam ras meh ra(n)g kareiee ||
verses.translation: She burns away her emotional attachment to Maya, and in love, she loves her Beloved.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh saache setee ra(n)g ra(n)getee laal bhiee man maaree ||
verses.translation: She is imbued and drenched with the Love of the True Lord; she has become beautiful, by conquering her mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saach vasee sohaagan pir siau preet piaaree ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride abides in Truth; she loves to love her Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir ghar sohai naar je pir bhaave jeeau ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride looks so beautiful in the home of her Husband Lord, if she is pleasing to Him.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਣ ਚਵੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThe vain chave kaam na aave jeeau ||
verses.translation: It is of no use at all to speak false words.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh alaavai kaam na aavai naa pir dhekhai nainee ||
verses.translation: If she speaks false, it is of no use to her, and she does not see her Husband Lord with her eyes.

verses.original: ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਵਿਧਣ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: avaguniaaree ka(n)t visaaree chhooTee vidhan rainee ||
verses.translation: Worthless, forgotten and abandoned by her Husband Lord, she passes her life-night without her Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh na maanai faahee faathee saa dhan mahal na paae ||
verses.translation: Such a wife does not believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she is caught in the net of the world, and does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aape aap pachhaanai gurmukh sahaj samaae ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if she understands her own self, then, as Gurmukh, she merges in celestial peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhan sohaagan naar jin pir jaaniaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kooRiaar kooR kamaaniaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, she is false, and her actions are false as well.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat suhaavee saache bhaavee bhai bhagat prabh raatee ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship of the Lord is beautiful; the True Lord loves it. So immerse yourself in loving devotional worship of God.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa tis raave ra(n)g raatee ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord is playful and innocent; imbued with His Love, I enjoy Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਾਸੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh vigaasee sahu raavaasee fal paiaa gunakaaree ||
verses.translation: She blossoms forth through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she ravishes her Husband Lord, and obtains the most noble reward.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saach milai vaddiaaiee pir ghar sohai naaree ||5||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in Truth, she obtains glory; in her Husband's home, the soul-bride looks beautiful. ||5||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai subhai sahaj gun gaieeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: gun gai vigasai sadhaa anadhin jaa aap saache bhaave ||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaar haumai tajai maiaa sahaj naam samaave ||
verses.translation: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aap karataa kare soiee aap dhei ta paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau tis sevee dhin raat mai kadhe na veesarai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

verses.original: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kadhe na visaaree anadhin sam(h)aaree jaa naam liee taa jeevaa ||
verses.translation: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sravanee sunee ta ih man tirapatai gurmukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||
verses.translation: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa satigur mele anadhin bibek budh bicharai ||
verses.translation: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin rahai liv lai ta sahaj samaave jeeau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadhaa ateet bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat sobhaa jag a(n)tar raam naam liv laagee ||
verses.translation: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog dhuhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare su bhaave ||
verses.translation: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hai hai kare dhin raat maiaa dhukh mohiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa dhukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaave ||
verses.translation: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, ""Mine, mine!"".

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh dhei tis chetai naahee a(n)t giaa pachhutaave ||
verses.translation: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maiaa dhohiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa rahai kar joR prabh man bhaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam ma(n)n sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin japat rahai dhin raatee sahaje naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: naamo naam milee vaddiaaiee naanak naam man bhaave ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paave jeeau ||5||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
