verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dheen dhiaal jis sa(n)g har gaaveeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naam saadhasa(n)g raaveeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo ik araadhoo janam maran dhukh naase ||
verses.translation: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains of birth and death are removed.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhur karam likhiaa saach sikhiaa kaTee jam kee faase ||
verses.translation: Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose of Death is removed from their necks.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bharam naaThe chhuTee gaaThe jam pa(n)th mool na aaveeaai ||
verses.translation: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never have to walk on Death's path.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa sadhaa har gun gaaveeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nidhariaa dhar ek naam nira(n)jano jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa dhaataar sarab dhukh bha(n)jano jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh harat karataa sukheh suaamee saran saadhoo aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar mahaa bikhaRaa pal ek maeh taraiaa ||
verses.translation: please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: poor rahiaa sarab thaiee gur giaan netree a(n)jano ||
verses.translation: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment of the Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa simaree sarab dhukh bhai bha(n)jano ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow and fear. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap le'ee laR lai kirapaa dhaareeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun neech anaath prabh agam apaareeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੀਚ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal sadhaa kirapaal suaamee neech thaapanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts and establishes the lowly.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh vas terai sagal teree saariaa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap sagal beechaareeaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak gun gai jeevaa har jap japau banavaareeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa dharas apaar naam amoliee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.

verses.original: ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nit japeh tere dhaas purakh atoliee jeeau ||
verses.translation: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t rasan vooThaa aap tooThaa har raseh seiee maatiaa ||
verses.translation: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicated with Your sublime essence, O Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan laage mahaa bhaage sadhaa anadhin jaagiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remain always awake and aware.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: sadh sadhaa si(n)mratabaye suaamee saas saas gun boliee ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhoor saadhoo naam prabhoo amoliee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag dhanaasaree baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee
verses.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਸੇਖਨਾਗਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sanak sana(n)dh mahes samaanaa(n) || sekhanaag tero maram na jaanaa(n) ||1||
verses.translation: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga - none of them know Your mystery, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)gat raam ridhai basaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸਰਿ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hanoomaan sar garuR samaanaa(n) || surapat narapat nahee gun jaanaa(n) ||2||
verses.translation: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans - none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chaar bedh ar si(n)mirat puraanaa(n) || kamalaapat kavalaa nahee jaanaa(n) ||3||
verses.translation: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi and Lakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਨਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer so bharamai naahee || pag lag raam rahai saranaa(n)hee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet, and remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin te pahar pahar te ghareeaa(n) aav ghaTai tan chheejai ||
verses.translation: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaal aheree firai badhik jiau kahahu kavan bidh keejai ||1||
verses.translation: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: so dhin aavan laagaa ||
verses.translation: That day is rapidly approaching.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa kahahu kouoo hai kaa kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਰਤੈ ਆਪਾ ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag jot kaiaa meh baratai aapaa pasoo na boojhai ||
verses.translation: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laalach karai jeevan padh kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||2||
verses.translation: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee chhoddahu man ke bharamaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: keval naam japahu re praanee parahu ek kee saranaa(n) ||3||2||
verses.translation: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary of the One Lord. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau jal jal meh pais na nikasai tiau ddur milio julaaho ||1||
verses.translation: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa ||
verses.translation: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau tan kaasee tajeh kabeeraa ramieeaai kahaa nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re loiee bharam na bhoolahu koiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaasee kiaa uookhar magahar raam ridhai jau hoiee ||2||3||
verses.translation: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹਿ ਜੈਬੋ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhr lok siv lokeh jaibo ||
verses.translation: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

verses.original: ਓਛੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਐਬੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ochhe tap kar baahur aaibo ||1||
verses.translation: but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa maa(n)gau kichh thir naahee ||
verses.translation: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam rakh man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਭੈ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa raaj bibhai baddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na kaahoo sa(n)g sahaiee ||2||
verses.translation: - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr lachhamee maiaa ||
verses.translation: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya

verses.original: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ein te kahu kavanai sukh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: hamarai man dhan raam ko naamaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam simaran bin booddate adhikaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: banitaa sut dheh greh sa(n)pat sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give you peace.

verses.original: ਇਨੑ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਅਵਧ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ein(h) mai kachh naeh tero kaal avadh aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਗਜ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit karam keene ||
verses.translation: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,

verses.original: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teuoo utar paar pare raam naam leene ||2||
verses.translation: but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sookar kookar jon bhrame tuoo laaj na aaiee ||
verses.translation: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam chhaadd a(n)mirat kaahe bikh khaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: taj bharam karam bidh nikhedh raam naam lehee ||
verses.translation: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh jan kabeer raam kar sanehee ||4||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗਹਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨੀਵ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gaharee kar kai neev khudhaiee uoopar ma(n)ddap chhaae ||
verses.translation: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਧਰਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਬਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maaraka(n)dde te ko adhikaiee jin tiran dhar moo(n)dd balaae ||1||
verses.translation: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: hamaro karataa raam sanehee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord is our only friend.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe re nar garab karat hahu binas jai jhooThee dhehee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kairau karate dhurajodhan se bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, ""This is ours! This is ours!""

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਜੋਜਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਗਿਰਝਨ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baareh jojan chhatr chalai thaa dhehee girajhan khaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten by vultures. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab suoin kee la(n)kaa hotee raavan se adhikaiee ||
verses.translation: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhio dhar baa(n)dhe haathee khin meh bhiee paraiee ||3||
verses.translation: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged to someone else. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਾਦਵ ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhurabaasaa siau karat Thagauree jaadhav e fal paae ||
verses.translation: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karee jan apune uoopar naamadheau har gun gaae ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhas bairaagan moh bas keen(h)ee pa(n)chahu kaa miT naavau ||
verses.translation: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

verses.original: ਸਤਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satar dhoi bhare a(n)mirat sar bikh kau maar kaddaavau ||1||
verses.translation: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, and drained out the poison. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: paachhai bahur na aavan paavau ||
verses.translation: I shall not come into the world again.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee ghaT te ucharau aatam kau samajhaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I have instructed my soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਜਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਛੀਨਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bajar kuThaar moh hai chheenaa(n) kar mi(n)nat lag paavau ||
verses.translation: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped off emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan ke ham ulaTe sevak bhagatan te ddarapaavau ||2||
verses.translation: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no one except the Lord's devotees. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh sa(n)saar te tab hee chhooTau jau maiaa neh lapaTaavau ||
verses.translation: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maiaa naam garabh jon kaa teh taj dharasan paavau ||3||
verses.translation: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: eit kar bhagat kareh jo jan tin bhau sagal chukaieeaai ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahat naamadheau baahar kiaa bharamahu ieh sa(n)jam har paieeaai ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to find the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: maaravaaR jaise neer baalahaa bel baalahaa karahalaa ||
verses.translation: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau kura(n)k nis naadh baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam rooRo roop rooRo at ra(n)g rooRo mero raamieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਣੀ ਕਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau dharanee kau i(n)dhr baalahaa kusam baas jaise bhavaralaa ||
verses.translation: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau kokil kau a(n)b baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||2||
verses.translation: and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਕਵੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: chakavee kau jaise soor baalahaa maan sarovar ha(n)sulaa ||
verses.translation: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to the swan,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau tarunee kau ka(n)t baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baarik kau jaise kheer baalahaa chaatirak mukh jaise jaladharaa ||
verses.translation: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,

verses.original: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: machhulee kau jaise neer baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh sagal mun chaaheh birale kaahoo ddeeThulaa ||
verses.translation: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal bhavan tero naam baalahaa tiau naame man beeThulaa ||5||3||
verses.translation: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰੀਏ ਪੁੰਡਰਕ ਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: pahil pure'e pu(n)ddarak vanaa ||
verses.translation: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਚੇ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: taa che ha(n)saa sagale janaa(n) ||
verses.translation: from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਨਾਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirasanaa te jaanuoo har har naacha(n)tee naachanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰਸਾਬਿਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pahil purasaabiraa ||
verses.translation: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਅਥੋਨ ਪੁਰਸਾਦਮਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: athon purasaadhamaraa ||
verses.translation: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.

verses.original: ਅਸਗਾ ਅਸ ਉਸਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: asagaa as usagaa ||
verses.translation: All that is, is His.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਿੰਧੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa baagaraa naachai pi(n)dhee meh saagaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਗੋਪੀ ਜੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naacha(n)tee gopee ja(n)naa ||
verses.translation: Women and men both dance.

verses.original: ਨਈਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੇ ਕੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: nieeaa te baire ka(n)naa ||
verses.translation: There is no other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਰਕੁ ਨ ਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: tarak na chaa ||
verses.translation: Don't dispute this,

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੀਆ ਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhrameeaa chaa ||
verses.translation: and don't doubt this.

verses.original: ਕੇਸਵਾ ਬਚਉਨੀ ਅਈਏ ਮਈਏ ਏਕ ਆਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kesavaa bachaunee ie'ee mie'ee ek aan jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord says, ""This creation and I are one and the same.""||2||

verses.original: ਪਿੰਧੀ ਉਭਕਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dhee ubhakale sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Like the pots on the Persian wheel, sometimes the world is high, and sometimes it is low.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram aae tum che dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming around, I have come at last to Your Door.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕੁਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too kun re ||
verses.translation: "Who are you?"

verses.original: ਮੈ ਜੀ ॥ ਨਾਮਾ ॥ ਹੋ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai jee || naamaa || ho jee ||
verses.translation: "I am Naam Dayv, Sir."

verses.original: ਆਲਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: aalaa te nivaaranaa jam kaaranaa ||3||4||
verses.translation: O Lord, please save me from Maya, the cause of death. ||3||4||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan maadhau biradh teraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n te vai mun jan jin dhiaaio har prabh meraa ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੇ ਧੂਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: merai maathai laagee le dhoor gobi(n)dh charanan kee ||
verses.translation: I have applied to my forehead the dust of the feet of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan tinahoo te dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is something which is far away from the gods, mortal men and silent sages. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਕਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਾਧੌ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheen kaa dhiaal maadhau garab parahaaree ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pride

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: charan saran naamaa bal tihaaree ||2||5||
verses.translation: - Naam Dayv seeks the Sanctuary of Your feet; he is a sacrifice to You. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree bhagat ravidhaas jee kee
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ham sar dheen dhiaal na tum sar ab pateeaar kiaa keejai ||
verses.translation: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

verses.original: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bachanee tor mor man maanai jan kau pooran dheejai ||1||
verses.translation: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau bal bal jaau ramieeaa kaarane ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਵਨ ਅਬੋਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaaran kavan abol || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: bahut janam bichhure the maadhau ih janam tum(h)aare lekhe ||
verses.translation: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas aas lag jeevau chir bhio dharasan dhekhe ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਨੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
verses.translit: chit simaran karau nain avilokano sravan baanee sujas poor raakhau ||
verses.translation: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਧੁਕਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਧਰਉ ਰਸਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਭਾਖਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manu su madhukar karau charan hiradhe dharau rasan a(n)mirat raam naam bhaakhau ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is the bumble bee; I enshrine Your feet within my heart, and with my tongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: meree preet gobi(n)dh siau jin ghaTai ||
verses.translation: My love for the Lord of the Universe does not decrease.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮੋਲਿ ਮਹਗੀ ਲਈ ਜੀਅ ਸਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai tau mol mahagee liee jeea saTai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I paid for it dearly, in exchange for my soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਵ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat binaa bhaau nahee uoopajai bhaav bin bhagat nahee hoi teree ||
verses.translation: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love for the Lord does not well up; without this love, Your devotional worship cannot be performed.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahai ravidhaas ik benatee har siau paij raakhahu raajaa raam meree ||2||2||
verses.translation: Ravi Daas offers this one prayer unto the Lord: please preserve and protect my honor, O Lord, my King. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam tero aaratee majan muraare ||
verses.translation: Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam bin jhooThe sagal paasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, all ostentatious displays are useless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਉਰਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਸਰੋ ਲੇ ਛਿਟਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam tero aasano naam tero urasaa naam teraa kesaro le chhiTakaare ||
verses.translation: Your Name is my prayer mat, and Your Name is the stone to grind the sandalwood. Your Name is the saffron which I take and sprinkle in offering to You.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਭੁਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਚੰਦਨੋ ਘਸਿ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam teraa a(n)bhulaa naam tero cha(n)dhano ghas jape naam le tujheh kau chaare ||1||
verses.translation: Your Name is the water, and Your Name is the sandalwood. The chanting of Your Name is the grinding of the sandalwood. I take it and offer all this to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਬਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤੇਲੁ ਲੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa dheevaa naam tero baatee naam tero tel le maeh pasaare ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the lamp, and Your Name is the wick. Your Name is the oil I pour into it.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam tere kee jot lagaiee bhio ujiaaro bhavan sagalaare ||2||
verses.translation: Your Name is the light applied to this lamp, which enlightens and illuminates the entire world. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਗਲ ਜੂਠਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam tero taagaa naam fool maalaa bhaar aThaareh sagal jooThaare ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the thread, and Your Name is the garland of flowers. The eighteen loads of vegetation are all too impure to offer to You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਰਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਚਵਰ ਢੋਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tero keeaa tujheh kiaa arapau naam teraa tuhee chavar ddolaare ||3||
verses.translation: Why should I offer to You, that which You Yourself created? Your Name is the fan, which I wave over You. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਠਾ ਅਠਸਠੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਇਹੈ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhas aThaa aThasaThe chaare khaanee ihai varatan hai sagal sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: The whole world is engrossed in the eighteen Puraanas, the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the four sources of creation.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahai ravidhaas naam tero aaratee sat naam hai har bhog tuhaare ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, Your Name is my Aartee, my lamp-lit worship-service. The True Name, Sat Naam, is the food which I offer to You. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ
verses.translit: dhanaasaree baanee bhagataa(n) kee tiralochan
verses.translation: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Trilochan Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿੰਦਸਿ ਕਾਇ ਭੂਲੀ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naarain ni(n)dhas kai bhoolee gavaaree ||
verses.translation: Why do you slander the Lord? You are ignorant and deluded.

verses.original: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਥਾਰੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukirat sukirat thaaro karam ree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Pain and pleasure are the result of your own actions. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)karaa masatak basataa surasaree isanaan re ||
verses.translation: The moon dwells in Shiva's forehead; it takes its cleansing bath in the Ganges.

verses.original: ਕੁਲ ਜਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਿਲੵਿੋ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kul jan madhe miliyeo saarag paan re ||
verses.translation: Among the men of the moon's family, Krishna was born;

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karam kar kala(n)k mafeeTas ree ||1||
verses.translation: even so, the stains from its past actions remain on the moon's face. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕਾ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਰਾਇ ਗਰੁੜ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਬਾਧਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: bisavai kaa dheepak savaiaamee taa che re suaarathee pa(n)khee rai garuR taa che baadhavaa ||
verses.translation: Aruna was a charioteer; his master was the sun, the lamp of the world. His brother was Garuda, the king of birds;

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਅਰੁਣ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam kar arun pi(n)gulaa ree ||2||
verses.translation: and yet, Aruna was made a cripple, because of the karma of his past actions. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਨਾਥੁ ਰੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik paatik harataa tirabhavan naath ree teerath teerath bhramataa lahai na paar ree ||
verses.translation: Shiva, the destroyer of countless sins, the Lord and Master of the three worlds, wandered from sacred shrine to sacred shrine; he never found an end to them.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਪਾਲੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam kar kapaal mafeeTas ree ||3||
verses.translation: And yet, he could not erase the karma of cutting off Brahma's head. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਸੀਅ ਧੇਨ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਚੇ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat saseea dhen lachhimee kalapatar sikhar sunaagar nadhee che naatha(n) ||
verses.translation: Through the nectar, the moon, the wish-fulfilling cow, Lakshmi, the miraculous tree of life, Sikhar the sun's horse, and Dhanavantar the wise physician - all arose from the ocean, the lord of rivers;

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਰੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: karam kar khaar mafeeTas ree ||4||
verses.translation: and yet, because of its karma, its saltiness has not left it. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਾਧੀਲੇ ਲੰਕਾ ਗੜੁ ਉਪਾੜੀਲੇ ਰਾਵਣ ਬਣੁ ਸਲਿ ਬਿਸਲਿ ਆਣਿ ਤੋਖੀਲੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaadheele la(n)kaa gaR upaaReele raavan ban sal bisal aan tokheele haree ||
verses.translation: Hanuman burnt the fortress of Sri Lanka, uprooted the garden of Raawan, and brought healing herbs for the wounds of Lachhman, pleasing Lord Raamaa;

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਛਉਟੀ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: karam kar kachhauTee mafeeTas ree ||5||
verses.translation: and yet, because of his karma, he could not be rid of his loin cloth. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੀ ਘਰ ਗੇਹਣਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਪੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਚੇ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: poorabalo kirat karam na miTai ree ghar gehan taa che moh jaapeeale raam che naama(n) ||
verses.translation: The karma of past actions cannot be erased, O wife of my house; this is why I chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ॥੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: badhat tiralochan raam jee ||6||1||
verses.translation: So prays Trilochan, Dear Lord. ||6||1||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸੈਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sree sain ||
verses.translation: Sri Sain:

verses.original: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhoop dheep ghirat saaj aaratee ||
verses.translation: With incense, lamps and ghee, I offer this lamp-lit worship service.

verses.original: ਵਾਰਨੇ ਜਾਉ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaarane jaau kamalaa patee ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Lord of Lakshmi. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)galaa har ma(n)galaa || nit ma(n)gal raajaa raam rai ko ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hail to You, Lord, hail to You! Again and again, hail to You, Lord King, Ruler of all! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਤਮੁ ਦੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: uootam dheearaa niramal baatee ||
verses.translation: Sublime is the lamp, and pure is the wick.

verses.original: ਤੁਹਂੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tuha(n)ee nira(n)jan kamalaa paatee ||2||
verses.translation: You are immaculate and pure, O Brilliant Lord of Wealth! ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa bhagat raamaana(n)dh jaanai ||
verses.translation: Raamaanand knows the devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pooran paramaana(n)dh bakhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: He says that the Lord is all-pervading, the embodiment of supreme joy. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਦਨ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: madhan moorat bhai taar gobi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the world, of wondrous form, has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸੈਨੁ ਭਣੈ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: sain bhanai bhaj paramaana(n)dhe ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Sain, remember the Lord, the embodiment of supreme joy! ||4||2||

verses.original: ਪੀਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: peepaa ||
verses.translation: Peepaa:

verses.original: ਕਾਯਉ ਦੇਵਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਦੇਵਲ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਜੰਗਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaayau dhevaa kaiaau dheval kaiaau ja(n)gam jaatee ||
verses.translation: Within the body, the Divine Lord is embodied. The body is the temple, the place of pilgrimage, and the pilgrim.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਅਉ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaiaau dhoop dheep nieebedhaa kaiaau poojau paatee ||1||
verses.translation: Within the body are incense, lamps and offerings. Within the body are the flower offerings. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa bahu kha(n)dd khojate nav nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: I searched throughout many realms, but I found the nine treasures within the body.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਆਇਬੋ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਇਬੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa kachh aaibo naa kachh jaibo raam kee dhuhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; I pray to the Lord for Mercy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਿੰਡੇ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo brahama(n)dde soiee pi(n)dde jo khojai so paavai ||
verses.translation: The One who pervades the Universe also dwells in the body; whoever seeks Him, finds Him there.

verses.original: ਪੀਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: peepaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaavai ||2||3||
verses.translation: Peepaa prays, the Lord is the supreme essence; He reveals Himself through the True Guru. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਧੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)naa ||
verses.translation: Dhannaa:

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gopaal teraa aarataa ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the world, this is Your lamp-lit worship service.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan tumaree bhagat kara(n)te tin ke kaaj savaarataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Arranger of the affairs of those humble beings who perform Your devotional worship service. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਲਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਗਉ ਘੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaal seedhaa maagau gheeau ||
verses.translation: Lentils, flour and ghee - these things, I beg of You.

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa khusee karai nit jeeau ||
verses.translation: My mind shall ever be pleased.

verses.original: ਪਨੑੀਆ ਛਾਦਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥ ਅਨਾਜੁ ਮਗਉ ਸਤ ਸੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pan(h)eeaa chhaadhan neekaa || anaaj magau sat see kaa ||1||
verses.translation: Shoes, fine clothes, and grain of seven kinds - I beg of You. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਊ ਭੈਸ ਮਗਉ ਲਾਵੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: guoo bhais magau laaveree ||
verses.translation: A milk cow, and a water buffalo, I beg of You,

verses.original: ਇਕ ਤਾਜਨਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik taajan turee cha(n)geree ||
verses.translation: and a fine Turkestani horse.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਗੀਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kee geehan cha(n)gee ||
verses.translation: A good wife to care for my home

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan dha(n)naa levai ma(n)gee ||2||4||
verses.translation: - Your humble servant Dhanna begs for these things, Lord. ||2||4||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai heearai ratan naam har basiaa gur haath dhario merai maathaa ||
verses.translation: The Jewel of the Lord's Name abides within my heart; the Guru has placed His hand on my forehead.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਰਿਨੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh dhukh utare gur naam dheeo rin laathaa ||1||
verses.translation: The sins and pains of countless incarnations have been cast out. The Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and my debt has been paid off. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj raam naam sabh arathaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate the Lord's Name, and all your affairs shall be resolved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naam dhiraRaiaa bin naavai jeevan birathaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; without the Name, life is useless. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mooR bhe hai manmukh te moh maiaa nit faathaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant; they are forever entangled in emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਥਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin saadhoo charan na seve kabahoo tin sabh janam akaathaa ||2||
verses.translation: They never serve the feet of the Holy; their lives are totally useless. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin saadhoo charan saadh pag seve tin safalio janam sanaathaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve at the feet of the Holy, the feet of the Holy, their lives are made fruitful, and they belong to the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mo kau keejai dhaas dhaas dhaasan ko har dhiaa dhaar jaga(n)naathaa ||3||
verses.translation: Make me the slave of the slave of the slaves of the Lord; bless me with Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham a(n)dhule giaanaheen agiaanee kiau chaaleh maarag pa(n)thaa ||
verses.translation: I am blind, ignorant and totally without wisdom; how can I walk on the Path?

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਚਲੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਹ ਮਿਲੰਥਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham a(n)dhule kau gur a(n)chal dheejai jan naanak chaleh mila(n)thaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: I am blind - O Guru, please let me grasp the hem of Your robe, so that servant Nanak may walk in harmony with You. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹਕ ਮੀਕਾ ਕਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa laal amolak hai bhaaree bin gaahak meekaa kaakhaa ||
verses.translation: A jewel or a diamond may be very valuable and heavy, but without a purchaser, it is worth only straw.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਤਬ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਲਾਖਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ratan gaahak gur saadhoo dhekhio tab ratan bikaano laakhaa ||1||
verses.translation: When the Holy Guru, the Purchaser, saw this jewel, He purchased it for hundreds of thousands of dollars. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai man gupat heer har raakhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has kept this jewel hidden within my mind.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੀਰੁ ਪਰਾਖਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal milaio gur saadhoo gur miliaai heer paraakhaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, merciful to the meek, led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Guru, I came to appreciate this jewel. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੋਠੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh koThee agiaan a(n)dheraa tin ghar ratan na laakhaa ||
verses.translation: The rooms of the self-willed manmukhs are dark with ignorance; in their homes, the jewel is not visible.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਅੰਗ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: te uoojhaR bharam mue gaavaaree maiaa bhua(n)g bikh chaakhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those fools die, wandering in the wilderness, eating the poison of the snake, Maya. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har saadh melahu jan neeke har saadhoo saran ham raakhaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, let me meet the humble, holy beings; O Lord, keep me in the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har a(n)geekaar karahu prabh suaamee ham pare bhaag tum paakhaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord, make me Your own; O God, Lord and Master, I have hurried to Your side. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa kiaa gun aakh vakhaaneh tum vadd agam vadd purakhaa ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I speak and describe? You are great and unfathomable, the Greatest Being.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਡੁਬਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree paakhaan ddubat har raakhaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: The Lord has bestowed His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has saved the sinking stone. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik kachhooa na jaaneh gat mit tere moorakh mugadh iaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am Your child; I know nothing about Your state and extent; I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa dhaar dheejai mat uootam kar leejai mugadh siaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, shower me with Your Mercy; bless me with an enlightened intellect; I am foolish - make me clever. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਲਸੀਆ ਉਘਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man aalaseeaa ughalaanaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is lazy and sleepy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har aan milaio gur saadhoo mil saadhoo kapaT khulaanaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Holy, the shutters have been opened wide. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur khin khin preet lagaavahu merai heearai mere preetam naam paraanaa ||
verses.translation: O Guru, each and every instant, fill my heart with love; the Name of my Beloved is my breath of life.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai mar jaieeaai mere Thaakur jiau amalee amal lubhaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, I would die; the Name of my Lord and Master is to me like the drug to the addict. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin man preet lagee har keree tin dhur bhaag puraanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who enshrine love for the Lord within their minds fulfill their pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin ham charan sareveh khin khin jin har meeTh lagaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: I worship their feet, each and every instant; the Lord seems very sweet to them. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਿਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaaree merai Thaakur jan bichhuriaa chiree milaanaa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master, Har, Har, has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; separated for so long, he is now re-united with the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan satigur jin naam dhiraRaiaa jan naanak tis kurabaanaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਫਲ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saajan purakh vadd paiaa har rasak rasak fal laagibaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the True Guru, my Friend, the Greatest Being. Love and affection for the Lord has blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਬਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maiaa bhuia(n)g grasio hai praanee gur bachanee bis har kaaddibaa ||1||
verses.translation: Maya, the snake, has seized the mortal; through the Word of the Guru, the Lord neutralizes the venom. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man raam naam ras laagibaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਬਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke'ee patit pavitr mil saadh gur har naamai har ras chaakhibaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has purified the sinners, uniting them with the Holy Guru; now, they taste the Lord's Name, and the sublime essence of the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan vaddabhaag milio gur saadhoo mil saadhoo liv unaman laagibaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those who meet the Holy Guru; meeting with the Holy, they lovingly center themselves in the state of absolute absorption.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਬਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa agan bujhee saa(n)t paiee har niramal niramal gun gaibaa ||2||
verses.translation: The fire of desire within them is quenched, and they find peace; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਖੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke bhaag kheen dhur paae jin satigur dharas na paibaa ||
verses.translation: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, have misfortune pre-ordained for them.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇਬਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: te dhoojai bhai paveh grabh jonee sabh birathaa janam tin jaibaa ||3||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they are consigned to reincarnation through the womb, and they pass their lives totally uselessly. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵਹ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dheh bimal mat gur saadh pag seveh ham har meeTh lagaibaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please, bless me with pure understanding, that I may serve the Feet of the Holy Guru; the Lord seems sweet to me.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਬਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ren saadh pag maagai har hoi dhiaal dhivaibaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; O Lord, be Merciful, and bless me with it. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har hiradhai naam na basio tin maat keejai har baa(n)jhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name does not abide within their hearts - their mothers should have been sterile.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਰਾਂਝਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin su(n)n(j)ee dheh fireh bin naavai oi khap khap mue karaa(n)jhaa ||1||
verses.translation: These bodies wander around, forlorn and abandoned, without the Name; their lives waste away, and they die, crying out in pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap raam naam har maajhaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord within you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaal kirapaa prabh dhaaree gur giaan dheeo man samajhaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord God, Har, Har, has showered me with His Mercy; the Guru has imparted spiritual wisdom to me, and my mind has been instructed. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat kalajug padh uootam har paieeaai satigur maajhaa ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise brings the most noble and exalted status; the Lord is found through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਝਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin gupat naam paragaajhaa ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has revealed the Lord's hidden Name to me. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ਗਵਾਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan saadh milio vaddabhaagee sabh kilabikh ge gavaajhaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy; it removes all stains of sin.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur saahu paiaa vadd dhaanaa har ke'ee bahu gun saajhaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have found the True Guru, the great, all-knowing King; He has shared with me the many Glorious Virtues of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau kirapaa karee jagajeevan har ur dhaario man maajhaa ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Life of the world, has shown Mercy, enshrine Him within their hearts, and cherish Him in their minds.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਫਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਮਝਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: dharam rai dhar kaagadh faare jan naanak lekhaa samajhaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, in the Court of the Lord, has torn up my papers; servant Nanak's account has been settled. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤੌ ਭਇਓ ਅਰੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saadh paiee vaddabhaagee man chalatau bhio arooRaa ||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I found the Holy, by great good fortune; my restless mind has been quieted.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਰਸਿ ਲੀੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anahat dhun vaajeh nit vaaje har a(n)mirat dhaar ras leeRaa ||1||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody ever vibrates and resounds; I have taken in the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, showering down. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap raam naam har rooRaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the beauteous Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਾਇ ਝਪੀੜਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan preet lagaiee satigur har milio lai jhapeeRaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has drenched my mind and body with the Love of the Lord, who has met me and lovingly embraced me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਕੀੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: saakat ba(n)dh bhe hai maiaa bikh sa(n)cheh lai jakeeRaa ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged in the chains of Maya; they are actively engaged, gathering in the poisonous wealth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਖਰਚਿ ਨਹ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੀੜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kai arath kharach neh saakeh jamakaal saheh sir peeRaa ||2||
verses.translation: They cannot spend this in harmony with the Lord, and so they must endure the pain which the Messenger of Death inflicts upon their heads. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har arath sareer lagaiaa gur saadhoo bahu saradhaa lai mukh dhooRaa ||
verses.translation: The Holy Guru has dedicated His Being to the Lord's service; with great devotion, apply the dust of His feet to your face.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਨਿ ਗੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: halat palat har sobhaa paaveh har ra(n)g lagaa man gooRaa ||3||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, you shall receive the Lord's honor, and your mind shall be imbued with the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har mel mel jan saadhoo ham saadh janaa kaa keeRaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, please unite me with the Holy; compared to these Holy people, I am just a worm.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਗ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak preet lagee pag saadh gur mil saadhoo paakhaan hario man mooRaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has enshrined love for the feet of the Holy Guru; meeting with this Holy One, my foolish, stone-like mind has blossomed forth in lush profusion. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har simarahu agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the Lord, Har, Har, the unfathomable, infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat dhukh miTai hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har satigur purakh milaavahu gur miliaai sukh hoiee raam ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the Guru, I am at peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavahu meet hamaare ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam rakhahu ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mirat bachan sunaavahu gur miliaai paragaT hoiee raam ||2||
verses.translation: Read the Ambrosial Words of the Lord, Har, Har; meeting with the Guru, the Lord is revealed. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: madhusoodhan har maadho praanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Slayer of demons, is my breath of life.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan a(n)mirat meeTh lagaanaa ||
verses.translation: His Ambrosial Amrit is so sweet to my mind and body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaa karahu gur melahu purakh nira(n)jan soiee raam ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, have mercy upon me, and lead me to meet the Guru, the immaculate Primal Being. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g meraa man raataa ||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: har har mahaa purakh gur melahu gur naanak naam sukh hoiee raam ||4||1||7||
verses.translation: O Lord Har, Har, lead me to meet the Guru, the Greatest Being; through the Name of Guru Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||1||7||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har naam japaahaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam sadhaa lai laahaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, ever earn the profit of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har har har bhagat dhiraRaavahu har har naam oumaahaa raam ||1||
verses.translation: Implant within yourself devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; sincerely dedicate yourself to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaal dhiaahaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g sadhaa gun gaahaa ||
verses.translation: With love, forever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘੂਮਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har har jas ghoomar paavahu mil satasa(n)g oumaahaa raam ||2||
verses.translation: Dance to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; meet with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, with sincerity. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aau sakhee har mel milaahaa ||
verses.translation: Come, O companions - let us unite in the Lord's Union.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun har kathaa naam lai laahaa ||
verses.translation: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, earn the profit of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaar gur melahu gur miliaai har oumaahaa raam ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, be merciful to me, and lead me to meet the Guru; meeting the Guru, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up in me. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar keerat jas agam athaahaa ||
verses.translation: Praise Him, the unfathomable and inaccessible Lord.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: khin khin raam naam gaavaahaa ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, sing the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: mo kau dhaar kirapaa mileeaai gur dhaate har naanak bhagat oumaahaa raam ||4||2||8||
verses.translation: Be merciful, and meet me, O Guru, Great Giver; Nanak yearns for the Lord's devotional worship. ||4||2||8||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: ras ras raam rasaal salaahaa ||
verses.translation: With love and energetic affection, praise the Lord, the storehouse of Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: man raam naam bheenaa lai laahaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is drenched with the Lord's Name, and so it earns this profit.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin khin bhagat kareh dhin raatee gurmat bhagat oumaahaa raam ||1||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, worship Him in devotion, day and night; through the Guru's Teachings, sincere love and devotion well up. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har gun govi(n)dh japaahaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan jeet sabadh lai laahaa ||
verses.translation: Conquering mind and body, I have earned the profit of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmat pa(n)ch dhoot vas aaveh man tan har omaahaa raam ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the five demons are over-powered, and the mind and body are filled with a sincere yearning for the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan har naam japaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Name is a jewel - chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai sadhaa lai laahaa ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and forever earn this profit.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaa kar maadho har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord, merciful to the meek, be kind to me, and bless me with sincere longing for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jagadhees japau man maahaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord of the world - meditate within your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har jaga(n)naath jag laahaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, is the only real profit in this world.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan vadde Thaakur prabh mere jap naanak bhagat omaahaa raam ||4||3||9||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, is my Great Lord and Master God; O Nanak, meditate on Him, worship Him with sincere love and devotion. ||4||3||9||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape jogee jugat jugaahaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Yogi, and the way throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape nirabhau taaRee laahaa ||
verses.translation: The Fearless Lord Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape hee aap aap varatai aape naam oumaahaa raam ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself, all by Himself, is all-pervading; He Himself blesses us with sincere love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਦੀਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape dheep loa dheepaahaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the lamp, and the Light pervading all the worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਮਥਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur samu(n)dh mathaahaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself churns the ocean.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape math math tat kaddaae jap naam ratan oumaahaa raam ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself churns it, churning up the essence; meditating on the jewel of the Naam, sincere love comes to the surface. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee milahu mil gun gaavaahaa ||
verses.translation: O my companions, let us meet and join together, and sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam japahu har laahaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har bhagat dhiraRee man bhaiee har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
verses.translation: Devotional worship of the Lord, Har, Har, has been implanted within me; it is pleasing to my mind. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, brings a sincere love. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape vadd dhaanaa vadd saahaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is supremely wise, the greatest King.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh poo(n)jee naam visaahaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, purchase the merchandise of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har har dhaat karahu prabh bhaavai gun naanak naam oumaahaa raam ||4||4||10||
verses.translation: O Lord God, Har, Har, bless me with such a gift, that Your Glorious Virtues seem pleasing to me; Nanak is filled with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||4||10||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat sa(n)g guraahaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and associating with the Guru,

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee naam gurmukh vesaahaa ||
verses.translation: the Gurmukh gathers in the merchandise of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaar madhusoodhan mil satasa(n)g oumaahaa raam ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, Destroyer of demons, have mercy upon me; bless me with a sincere yearning to join the Sat Sangat. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਸੁਣਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gun baanee sravan sunaahaa ||
verses.translation: Let me hear with my ears the Banis, the Hymns, in praise of the Lord;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaahaa ||
verses.translation: be merciful, and let me meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh gun boleh baanee har gun jap oumaahaa raam ||2||
verses.translation: I sing His Glorious Praises, I speak the Bani of His Word; chanting His Glorious Praises, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਤੋੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teerath varat jag pu(n)n tuolaahaa ||
verses.translation: I have tried visiting all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, fasting, ceremonial feasts and giving to charities.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਪੁਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam na pujeh pujaahaa ||
verses.translation: They do not measure up to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har atul tol at bhaaree gurmat jap oumaahaa raam ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is unweighable, utterly heavy in weight; through the Guru's Teachings, a sincere yearning to chant the Name has welled up in me. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh karam dharam har naam japaahaa ||
verses.translation: All good karma and righteous living are found in meditation on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਪ ਧੋਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh mail paap dhovaahaa ||
verses.translation: It washes away the stains of sins and mistakes.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal hoh jan uoopar dheh naanak naam omaahaa raam ||4||5||11||
verses.translation: Be merciful to meek, humble Nanak; bless him with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||5||11||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਈਹਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: koiee jaanai kavan ieehaa jag meet ||
verses.translation: Does anyone know, who is our friend in this world?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis hoi kirapaal soiee bidh boojhai taa kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone understands this, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. Immaculate and unstained is his way of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਤਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa banitaa sut ba(n)dhap isaT meet ar bhaiee || poorab janam ke mile sa(n)jogee a(n)teh ko na sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Mother, father, spouse, children, relatives, lovers, friends and siblings meet, having been associated in previous lives; but none of them will be your companion and support in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਾਲ ਕਨਿਕ ਲਾਲ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਰੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukat maal kanik laal heeraa man ra(n)jan kee maiaa ||
verses.translation: Pearl necklaces, gold, rubies and diamonds please the mind, but they are only Maya.

verses.original: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਵਧਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haa haa karat bihaanee avadheh taa meh sa(n)tokh na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Possessing them, one passes his life in agony; he obtains no contentment from them. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਸਤਿ ਰਥ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਪਵਨ ਤੇਜ ਧਣੀ ਭੂਮਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: hasat rath asavai pavan tej dhanee bhooman chaturaa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Elephants, chariots, horses as fast as the wind, wealth, land, and armies of four kinds

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਛੂਐ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਨਾਂਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na chaalio in meh kachhooaai uooTh sidhaio naa(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: - none of these will go with him; he must get up and depart, naked. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t pria preetam prabh ke taa kai har har gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints are the beloved lovers of God; sing of the Lord, Har, Har, with them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ieehaa sukh aagai mukh uoojal sa(n)g sa(n)tan kai paieeaai ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Society of the Saints, you shall obtain peace in this world, and in the next world, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹੀਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheh sa(n)dhesaro kaheeaau pria kaheeaau ||
verses.translation: Give me a message from my Beloved - tell me, tell me!

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bisam bhiee mai bahu bidh sunate kahahu suhaagan saheeaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am wonder-struck, hearing the many reports of Him; tell them to me, O my happy sister soul-brides. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਮਹੀਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: ko kahato sabh baahar baahar ko kahato sabh maheeaau ||
verses.translation: Some say that He is beyond the world - totally beyond it, while others say that He is totally within it.

verses.original: ਬਰਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਬੁਝਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baran na dheesai chihan na lakheeaai suhaagan saat bujhaheeaau ||1||
verses.translation: His color cannot be seen, and His pattern cannot be discerned. O happy soul-brides, tell me the truth! ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਸੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਪਹੀਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nivaasee ghaT ghaT vaasee lep nahee alapaheeaau ||
verses.translation: He is pervading everywhere, and He dwells in each and every heart; He is not stained - He is unstained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat sunahu re logaa sa(n)t rasan ko basaheeaau ||2||1||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O people: He dwells upon the tongues of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੀਰਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੀਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheerau sun dheerau prabh kau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am calmed, calmed and soothed, hearing of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਨੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨੀਰਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea praan man tan sabh arapau neerau pekh prabh kau neerau ||1||
verses.translation: I dedicate my soul, my breath of life, my mind, body and everything to Him: I behold God near, very near. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਗਹੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: besumaar bea(n)t badd dhaataa maneh gaheerau pekh prabh kau ||2||
