verses.translation: Beholding God, the inestimable, infinite and Great Giver, I cherish Him in my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਉ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo chaahau soiee soiee paavau aasaa manasaa poorau jap prabh kau ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever I wish for, I receive; my hopes and desires are fulfilled, meditating on God. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰਉ ਬੁਝਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak man vasiaa dhookh na kabahoo jhoorau bujh prabh kau ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, God dwells in Nanak's mind; he never suffers or grieves, having realized God. ||4||2||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋੜੀਦੜਾ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: loReedhaRaa saajan meraa ||
verses.translation: I seek my Friend the Lord.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨੀਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar ma(n)gal gaavahu neeke ghaT ghaT tiseh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In each and every home, sing the sublime songs of rejoicing; He abides in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh araadhan dhookh araadhan bisarai na kaahoo beraa ||
verses.translation: In good times, worship and adore Him; in bad times, worship and adore Him; do not ever forget Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam japat koT soor ujaaraa binasai bharam a(n)dheraa ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the light of millions of suns shines forth, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar sabhanee jaiee jo dheesai so teraa ||
verses.translation: In all the spaces and interspaces, everywhere, whatever we see is Yours.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g paavai jo naanak tis bahur na hoiee hai feraa ||2||3||4||
verses.translation: One who finds the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||2||3||4||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੵਿ ॥
verses.translit: ab mai sukh paio gur aagiye ||
verses.translation: Now, I have found peace, bowing before the Guru.

verses.original: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਿਆਗੵਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tajee siaanap chi(n)t visaaree aha(n) chhoddio hai tiaagiye ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have abandoned cleverness, quieted my anxiety, and renounced my egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹੀਅਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jau dhekhau tau sagal moh moheeaau tau saran pario gur bhaag ||
verses.translation: When I looked, I saw that everyone was enticed by emotional attachment; then, I hurried to the Guru's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਜਮਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa Tahal har laio tau jam chhoddee moree laag ||1||
verses.translation: In His Grace, the Guru engaged me in the Lord's service, and then, the Messenger of Death gave up pursuing me. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਰਿਓ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੋ ਜਉ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: tario saagar paavak ko jau sa(n)t bheTe vadd bhaag ||
verses.translation: I swam across the ocean of fire, when I met the Saints, through great good fortune.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sarab sukh paae moro har charanee chit laag ||2||1||5||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, I have found total peace; my consciousness is attached to the Lord's feet. ||2||1||5||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man meh satigur dhiaan dharaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I cherish and meditate on the True Guru.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿੑਓ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraRi(h)o giaan ma(n)tr har naamaa prabh jeeau miaa karaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has implanted within me spiritual wisdom and the Mantra of the Lord's Name; Dear God has shown mercy to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਅਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਡਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaal jaal ar mahaa ja(n)jaalaa chhuTake jameh ddaraa ||
verses.translation: Death's noose and its mighty entanglements have vanished, along with the fear of death.

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਹਿਓ ਚਰਣ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaio dhukh haran saran karunaapat gahio charan aasaraa ||1||
verses.translation: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord, the Destroyer of pain; I am holding tight to the Support of His feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naav roop bhio saadhasa(n)g bhav nidh paar paraa ||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has assumed the form of a boat, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਗਤੁ ਥੀਓ ਭਰਮਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: apiau peeo gat theeo bharamaa kahu naanak ajar jaraa ||2||2||6||
verses.translation: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and my doubts are shattered; says Nanak, I can bear the unbearable. ||2||2||6||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhe govi(n)dh sahaiee ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord of the Universe as his help and support

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਵਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh sagal siau vaa kau biaadh na kaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: is blessed with all peace, poise and bliss; no afflictions cling to him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਉਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dheeseh sabh sa(n)g raheh alepaa neh viaapai un maiee ||
verses.translation: He appears to keep company with everyone, but he remains detached, and Maya does not cling to him.

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekai ra(n)g tat ke bete satigur te budh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: He is absorbed in love of the One Lord; he understands the essence of reality, and he is blessed with wisdom by the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa miaa kirapaa Thaakur kee seiee sa(n)t subhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord and Master blesses with His kindness, compassion and mercy are the sublime and sanctified Saints.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: tin kai sa(n)g naanak nisatareeaai jin ras ras har gun gaiee ||2||3||7||
verses.translation: Associating with them, Nanak is saved; with love and exuberant joy, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||7||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jeevan praan dhan roop ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is my existence, my breath of life, wealth and beauty.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan moh magan mahaa praanee a(n)dhiaare meh dheep ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The ignorant are totally intoxicated with emotional attachment; in this darkness, the Lord is the only lamp. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan tumaraa prabh preetam charan kamal aanoop ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Beloved God; Your lotus feet are incomparably beautiful!

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਦਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰ੍ਹਾਵਉ ਧੂਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik baar karau teh ba(n)dhan maneh charhaavau dhoop ||1||
verses.translation: So many times, I bow in reverence to Him, offering my mind as incense to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹੀ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਲੂਕ ॥
verses.translit: haar pario tum(h)rai prabh dhuaarai dhiraR(h) kar gahee tum(h)aaree look ||
verses.translation: Exhausted, I have fallen at Your Door, O God; I am holding tight to Your Support.

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੇ ਕੂਪ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: kaadd leh naanak apune kau sa(n)saar paavak ke koop ||2||4||8||
verses.translation: Please, lift Your humble servant Nanak up, out of the pit of fire of the world. ||2||4||8||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: koiee jan har siau dhevai jor ||
verses.translation: If only someone would unite me with the Lord!

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ਬਕਉ ਸੁਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਕੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan gahau bakau subh rasanaa dheejeh praan akor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I hold tight to His feet, and utter sweet words with my tongue; I make my breath of life an offering to Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੰਜੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal karat kiaaro har si(n)chai sudhaa sa(n)jor ||
verses.translation: I make my mind and body into pure little gardens, and irrigate them with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eiaa ras meh magan hot kirapaa te mahaa bikhiaa te tor ||1||
verses.translation: I am drenched with this sublime essence by His Grace, and the powerful hold of Maya's corruption has been broken. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaio saran dheen dhukh bha(n)jan chitavau tum(h)ree or ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the suffering of the innocent; I keep my consciousness focused on You.

verses.original: ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੋਰਿ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
verses.translit: abhai padh dhaan simaran suaamee ko prabh naanak ba(n)dhan chhor ||2||5||9||
verses.translation: Bless me with the gifts of the state of fearlessness, and meditative remembrance, Lord and Master; O Nanak, God is the Breaker of bonds. ||2||5||9||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਬਰਸਤ ਮੇਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak chitavat barasat me(n)h ||
verses.translation: The rainbird longs for the rain to fall.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੋ ਨੇਂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa si(n)dh karunaa prabh dhaarahu har prem bhagat ko ne(n)h ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O God, ocean of mercy, shower Your mercy on me, that I may yearn for loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਚਕਵੀ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੇਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: anik sookh chakavee nahee chaahat anadh pooran pekh dhe(n)h ||
verses.translation: The chakvi duck does not desire many comforts, but it is filled with bliss upon seeing the dawn.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਨਾ ਤੇਂਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan upaav na jeevat meenaa bin jal maranaa te(n)h ||1||
verses.translation: The fish cannot survive any other way - without water, it dies. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: ham anaath naath har saranee apunee kirapaa kare(n)h ||
verses.translation: I am a helpless orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, O My Lord and Master; please bless me with Your mercy.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੇਂਹ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: charan kamal naanak aaraadhai tis bin aan na ke(n)h ||2||6||10||
verses.translation: Nanak worships and adores the Lord's lotus feet; without Him, there is no other at all. ||2||6||10||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bas rahe mere praan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my very breath of life, abides in my mind and body.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g bheTe pooran purakh sujaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your mercy, and unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O perfect, all-knowing Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prem Thagauree jin kau paiee tin ras peeaau bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom You give the intoxicating herb of Your Love, drink in the supreme sublime essence.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee kudharat kavan ham(h)aaree ||1||
verses.translation: I cannot describe their value; what power do I have? ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: lai le laR dhaas jan apune udhare udharanahaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord attaches His humble servants to the hem of His robe, and they swim across the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: prabh simar simar simar sukh paio naanak saran dhuaare ||2||7||11||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, peace is obtained; Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door. ||2||7||11||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aae anik janam bhram saranee ||
verses.translation: After wandering through so many incarnations, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: audhar dheh a(n)dh koop te laavahu apunee charanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Save me - lift my body up out of the deep, dark pit of the world, and attach me to Your feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa naahin niramal karanee ||
verses.translation: I do not know anything about spiritual wisdom, meditation or karma, and my way of life is not clean and pure.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਨਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਤਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai a(n)chal laavahu bikham nadhee jai taranee ||1||
verses.translation: Please attach me to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; help me to cross over the terrible river. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਇਹ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sa(n)pat maiaa ras meeThe ieh nahee man meh dharanee ||
verses.translation: Comforts, riches and the sweet pleasures of Maya - do not implant these within your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਆਭਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har dharasan tirapat naanak dhaas paavat har naam ra(n)g aabharanee ||2||8||12||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; his only ornamentation is the love of the Lord's Name. ||2||8||12||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har jan simarahu hiradhai raam ||
verses.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation within your heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਪਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kau apadhaa nikaT na aavai pooran dhaas ke kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Misfortune does not even approach the Lord's humble servant; the works of His slave are perfectly fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਧਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: koT bighan binaseh har sevaa nihachal govidh dhaam ||
verses.translation: Millions of obstacles are removed, by serving the Lord, and one enters into the eternal dwelling of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਦਰੁ ਦੇਵਤ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagava(n)t bhagat kau bhau kichh naahee aadhar dhevat jaam ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotee is very fortunate; he has absolutely no fear. Even the Messenger of Death pays homage to him. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਖਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: taj gopaal aan jo karanee soiee soiee binasat khaam ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Lord of the world, he does other deeds, but these are temporary and transitory.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai gahu naanak sukh samooh bisaraam ||2||9||13||
verses.translation: Grasp the Lord's lotus feet, and hold them in your heart, O Nanak; you shall obtain absolute peace and bliss. ||2||9||13||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa nauvaa
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehla: One Universal Creator God.

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolio man maiaa urajhaio ||
verses.translation: My mind is deluded, entangled in Maya.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਓ ਲਾਲਚ ਲਗਿ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo karam keeo laalach lag teh teh aap ba(n)dhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever I do, while engaged in greed, only serves to bind me down. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: samajh na paree bikhai ras rachio jas har ko bisaraio ||
verses.translation: I have no understanding at all; I am engrossed in the pleasures of corruption, and I have forgotten the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g suaamee so jaanio naahin ban khojan kau dhaio ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master is with me, but I do not know Him. Instead, I run into the forest, looking for Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ratan raam ghaT hee ke bheetar taa ko giaan na paio ||
verses.translation: The Jewel of the Lord is deep within my heart, but I do not have any knowledge of Him.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagava(n)t bhajan bin birathaa janam gavaio ||2||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, without vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, human life is uselessly wasted and lost. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har joo raakh leh pat meree ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please, save my honor!

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਇਓ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jam ko traas bhio ur a(n)tar saran gahee kirapaa nidh teree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The fear of death has entered my heart; I cling to the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Lord, ocean of mercy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਅਬ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa patit mugadh lobhee fun karat paap ab haaraa ||
verses.translation: I am a great sinner, foolish and greedy; but now, at last, I have grown weary of committing sins.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਮਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਤਿਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhai marabe ko bisarat naahin teh chi(n)taa tan jaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: I cannot forget the fear of dying; this anxiety is consuming my body. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੀਏ ਉਪਾਵ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ke'ee upaav mukat ke kaaran dheh dhis kau uTh dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have been trying to liberate myself, running around in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT hee bheetar basai nira(n)jan taa ko maram na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The pure, immaculate Lord abides deep within my heart, but I do not understand the secret of His mystery. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naahin gun naahin kachh jap tap kaun karam ab keejai ||
verses.translation: I have no merit, and I know nothing about meditation or austerities; what should I do now?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak haar pario saranaagat abhai dhaan prabh dheejai ||3||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am exhausted; I seek the shelter of Your Sanctuary; O God, please bless me with the gift of fearlessness. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗਹੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man re saachaa gaho bichaaraa ||
verses.translation: O mind, embrace true contemplation.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ਸਗਰੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mithiaa maano sagaro ih sa(n)saaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, know that this whole world is false. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੋਜਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau jogee khojat haare paio naeh teh paaraa ||
verses.translation: The Yogis are tired of searching for Him, but they have not found His limit.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so suaamee tum nikaT pachhaano roop rekh te niaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: You must understand that the Lord and Master is near at hand, but He has no form or feature. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੰਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paavan naam jagat mai har ko kabahoo naeh sa(n)bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord is purifying in the world, and yet you never remember it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਬੰਦਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saran pario jag ba(n)dhan raakhahu biradh tuhaaraa ||2||3||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the One, before whom the whole world bows down; please, preserve and protect me, by Your innate nature. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan piaasee dhinas raat chitavau anadhin neet ||
verses.translation: I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, day and night; I yearn for Him constantly, night and day.

verses.original: ਖੋਲਿੑ ਕਪਟ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kholi(h) kapaT gur meleeaa naanak har sa(n)g meet ||1||
verses.translation: Opening the door, O Nanak, the Guru has led me to meet with the Lord, my Friend. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਯਾਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਇਕ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sun yaar hamaare sajan ik karau bena(n)teeaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my intimate friend - I have just one prayer to make.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਖੋਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis mohan laal piaare hau firau khoja(n)teeaa ||
verses.translation: I have been wandering around, searching for that enticing, sweet Beloved.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰੀ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhas piaare sir dharee utaare ik bhoree dharasan dheejai ||
verses.translation: Whoever leads me to my Beloved - I would cut off my head and offer it to him, even if I were granted the Blessed Vision of His Darshan for just an instant.

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: nain hamaare pria ra(n)g ra(n)gaare ik til bhee naa dheereejai ||
verses.translation: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Beloved; without Him, I do not have even a moment's peace.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਵੈ ਤਿਸੰਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh siau man leenaa jiau jal meenaa chaatirak jivai tisa(n)teeaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to the Lord, like the fish to the water, and the rainbird, thirsty for the raindrops.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝੰਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur pooraa paiaa sagalee tikhaa bujha(n)teeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru; his thirst is totally quenched. ||1||

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹਭੇ ਸਖੀਆ ਮੂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜੇਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: yaar ve pria habhe sakheeaa moo kahee na jeheeaa ||
verses.translation: O intimate friend, my Beloved has all these loving companions; I cannot compare to any of them.

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਹਿਕ ਡੂੰ ਹਿਕ ਚਾੜੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਚਿਤੇਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: yaar ve hik ddoo(n) hik chaaRai hau kis chiteheeaa ||
verses.translation: O intimate friend, each of them is more beautiful than the others; who could consider me?

verses.original: ਹਿਕ ਦੂੰ ਹਿਕਿ ਚਾੜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: hik dhoo(n) hik chaaRe anik piaare nit karadhe bhog bilaasaa ||
verses.translation: Each of them is more beautiful than the others; countless are His lovers, constantly enjoying bliss with Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਉਠੰਦਾ ਹਉ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa dhekh man chaau uTha(n)dhaa hau kadh paiee gunataasaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding them, desire wells up in my mind; when will I obtain the Lord, the treasure of virtue?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੇਂਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinee maiddaa laal reejhaiaa hau tis aagai man dde(n)heeaa ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind to those who please and attract my Beloved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਡਿਖਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਕੇਹੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai sun binau suhaagan moo dhas ddikhaa pir keheeaa ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, O happy soul-brides; tell me, what does my Husband Lord look like? ||2||

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਸੀ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: yaar ve pir aapan bhaanaa kichh neesee chha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: O intimate friend, my Husband Lord does whatever He pleases; He is not dependent on anyone.

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਤੈ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਦਸੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: yaar ve tai raaviaa laalan moo dhas dhasa(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: O intimate friend, you have enjoyed your Beloved; please, tell me about Him.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੈ ਧਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: laalan tai paiaa aap gavaiaa jai dhan bhaag mathaane ||
verses.translation: They alone find their Beloved, who eradicate self-conceit; such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਘਿਧੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: baa(n)h pakaR Thaakur hau ghidhee gun avagan na pachhaane ||
verses.translation: Taking me by the arm, the Lord and Master has made me His own; He has not considered my merits or demerits.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun haar tai paiaa ra(n)g laal banaiaa tis habho kichh suha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: She, whom You have adorned with the necklace of virtue, and dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love - everything looks beautiful on her.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dha(n)n suhaagan saiee jis sa(n)g bhataar vasa(n)dhaa ||3||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, blessed is that happy soul-bride, who dwells with her Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: yaar ve nit sukh sukhedhee saa mai paiee ||
verses.translation: O intimate friend, I have found that peace which I sought.

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: var loReedhaa aaiaa vajee vaadhaiee ||
verses.translation: My sought-after Husband Lord has come home, and now, congratulations are pouring in.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਥੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ma(n)gal rahas theeaa pir dhiaal sadh nav ra(n)geeaa ||
verses.translation: Great joy and happiness welled up, when my Husband Lord, of ever-fresh beauty, showed mercy to me.

verses.original: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸਤਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: vadd bhaag paiaa gur milaiaa saadh kai satasa(n)geeaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found Him; the Guru has united me with Him, through the Saadh Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਅੰਕੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa sagal pooree pria a(n)k a(n)k milaiee ||
verses.translation: My hopes and desires have all been fulfilled; my Beloved Husband Lord has hugged me close in His embrace.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sukh sukhedhee saa mai gur mil paiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have found that peace which I sought, meeting with the Guru. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa agam apaar prabh kathan na jai akath ||
verses.translation: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot be described.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee raakhan kau samarath ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jaanahu tiau raakh har prabh teriaa ||
verses.translation: Save me, any way You can; O Lord God, I am Yours.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਗਨਉ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kete ganau asa(n)kh avagan meriaa ||
verses.translation: My demerits are uncountable; how many of them should I count?

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਖਤੇ ਫੇਰੇ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਸਦ ਭੂਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh avagan khate fere nitaprat sadh bhooleeaai ||
verses.translation: The sins and crimes I committed are countless; day by day, I continually make mistakes.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਘੂਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: moh magan bikaraal maiaa tau prasaadhee ghooleeaai ||
verses.translation: I am intoxicated by emotional attachment to Maya, the treacherous one; by Your Grace alone can I be saved.

verses.original: ਲੂਕ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: look karat bikaar bikhaRe prabh ner hoo te neriaa ||
verses.translation: Secretly, I commit hideous sins of corruption, even though God is the nearest of the near.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhiaa dhaarahu kaadd bhavajal feriaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord, and lift me up, out of the whirlpool of the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nirat na pavai asa(n)kh gun uoochaa prabh kaa naau ||
verses.translation: Countless are His virtues; they cannot be enumerated. God's Name is lofty and exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa milai nithaave thaau ||2||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's humble prayer, to bless the homeless with a home. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoosar naahee Thaau kaa peh jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: There is no other place at all - where else should I go?

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar kar joR so prabh dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on God.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaai so prabh sadhaa apunaa maneh chi(n)dhiaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating forever on my God, I receive the fruits of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh vikaar dhoojaa ek siau liv laieeaai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing pride, attachment, corruption and duality, I lovingly center my attention on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਰਪਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: arap man tan prabhoo aagai aap sagal miTaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Dedicate your mind and body to God; eradicate all your self-conceit.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa saach naam samaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your mercy, Lord, that I may be absorbed in Your True Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: re man taa kau dhiaaieeaai sabh bidh jaa kai haath ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the One, who holds everything in His hands.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan sa(n)cheeaai naanak nibahai saath ||3||
verses.translation: Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, it shall always be with You. ||3||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਸਾਥੀਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saatheeaRaa prabh ek dhoosar naeh koi ||
verses.translation: God is our only True Friend; there is not any other.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar aap jal thal poor soi ||
verses.translation: In the places and interspaces, in the water and on the land, He Himself is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa sarab dhaataa prabh dhanee ||
verses.translation: He is totally permeating the water, the land and the sky; God is the Great Giver, the Lord and Master of all.

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gopaal gobi(n)dh a(n)t naahee bea(n)t gun taa ke kiaa ganee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe has no limit; His Glorious Virtues are unlimited - how can I count them?

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj saran suaamee sukheh gaamee tis binaa an naeh koi ||
verses.translation: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhiaa dhaarahu tis paraapat naam hoi ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, that being, unto whom the Lord shows mercy - he alone obtains the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਜਿ ਚਿਤਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chit j chitaviaa so mai paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever I wish for, that I receive.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai sukh sabaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak has found total peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: ab man chhooT giaa saadhoo sa(n)g mile ||
verses.translation: My mind is now emancipated; I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam liaa jotee jot rale ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I chant the Naam, and my light has merged into the Light.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬੁਝੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam simarat miTe kilabikh bujhee tapat aghaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, my sins have been erased; the fire has been extinguished, and I am satisfied.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa leene dhiaa keene aapane kar maaniaa ||
verses.translation: He has taken me by the arm, and blessed me with His kind mercy; He has accepted me His own.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: lai a(n)k laae har milaae janam maranaa dhukh jale ||
verses.translation: The Lord has hugged me in His embrace, and merged me with Himself; the pains of birth and death have been burnt away.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਕ ਪਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhiaa dhaaree mel leene ik pale ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, He has blessed me with His kind mercy; in an instant, He unites me with Himself. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: jaitasaree chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਧਾਣੂ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paadhaanoo sa(n)saar gaarab aTiaa ||
verses.translation: The world is like a temporary way-station, but it is filled with pride.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karate paap anek maiaa ra(n)g raTiaa ||
verses.translation: People commit countless sins; they are dyed in the color of the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਬੂਡੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh abhimaan boodde maran cheet na aave ||
verses.translation: In greed, emotional attachment and egotism, they are drowning; they do not even think of dying.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਏਹ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: putr mitr biauhaar banitaa eh karat bihaave ||
verses.translation: Children, friends, worldly occupations and spouses - they talk of these things, while their lives are passing away.

verses.original: ਪੁਜਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਦੂਤਹ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: puj dhivas aae likhe maae dhukh dharam dhooteh ddiThiaa ||
verses.translation: When their pre-ordained days have run their course, O mother, they behold the Messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and they suffer.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirat karam na miTai naanak har naam dhan nahee khaTiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The karma of their past deeds cannot be erased, O Nanak, if they have not earned the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਦਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: audham kareh anek har naam na gaavahee ||
verses.translation: He makes all sorts of efforts, but he does not sing the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਹਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharameh jon asa(n)kh mar janameh aavahee ||
verses.translation: He wanders around in countless incarnations; he dies, only to be born again.

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੈਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਗਣਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo pa(n)khee sail taravar ganat kachhoo na aave ||
verses.translation: As beasts, birds, stones and trees - their number cannot be known.

verses.original: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਵਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: beej bovas bhog bhogeh keeaa apanaa paave ||
verses.translation: As are the seeds he plants, so are the pleasures he enjoys; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰੰਤ ਜੂਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ratan janam haara(n)t jooaai prabhoo aap na bhaavahee ||
verses.translation: He loses the jewel of this human life in the gamble, and God is not pleased with him at all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak bharameh bhramaae khin ek Tikan na paavahee ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, wandering in doubt, he does not find any rest, even for an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਤੀਤਿ ਜਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਬੈਠੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: joban giaa biteet jar mal baiTheeaa ||
verses.translation: Youth has passed, and old age has taken its place.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡੋਲ ਨੈਣ ਨ ਡੀਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar ka(n)peh sir ddol nain na ddeeThiaa ||
verses.translation: The hands tremble, the head shakes, and the eyes do not see.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਨੈਣ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਈਸੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: neh nain dheesai bin bhajan ieesai chhodd maiaa chaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The eyes do not see, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord; he must leave behind the attractions of Maya, and depart.

verses.original: ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahiaa na maaneh sir khaak chhaaneh jin sa(n)g man tan jaaliaa ||
verses.translation: He burnt his mind and body for his relatives, but now, they do not listen to him, and they throw dust on his head.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraam ra(n)g apaar pooran neh nimakh man meh vooThiaa ||
verses.translation: Love for the infinite, Perfect Lord does not abide in his mind, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਝੂਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak koT kaagar binas baar na jhooThiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the fort of paper is false - it is destroyed in an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saranai naanak aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhutar bhai sa(n)saar prabh aap taraiaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself has carried Him across the impassable, terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaje sreedhar kar a(n)g prabh jee taariaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord; God has made me His own, and saved me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har maan le'ee naam dhe'ee avar kachh na beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has approved of me, and blessed me with His Name; He did not take anything else into consideration.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan apaar Thaakur man loReedhaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the infinite Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue, which my mind had yearned for.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa tirapate har naam bhojan khaiaa ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am satisfied forever; I have eaten the food of the Lord's Name. ||4||2||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ
verses.translit: jaitasaree mahalaa panjavaa vaar salokaa naal
verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Vaar With Shaloks:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: aadh pooran madh pooran a(n)t pooran paramesureh ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, He was pervading; in the middle, He is pervading; in the end, He will be pervading. He is the Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਘਨਾਸਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simara(n)t sa(n)t sarabatr ramana(n) naanak aghanaasan jagadheesureh ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints remember in meditation the all-pervading Lord God. O Nanak, He is the Destroyer of sins, the Lord of the universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨੋ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: pekhan sunan sunaavano man meh dhiraReeaai saach ||
verses.translation: See, hear, speak and implant the True Lord within your mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poor rahio sarabatr mai naanak har ra(n)g raach ||2||
verses.translation: He is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; O Nanak, be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ek nira(n)jan gaieeaai sabh a(n)tar soiee ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord; He is contained within all.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath prabh jo kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord God; whatever He wills, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapadhaa tis bin nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; without Him, there is no other.

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਦੀਪ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd paataal dheep raviaa sabh loiee ||
verses.translation: He pervades the continents, solar systems, nether worlds, islands and all worlds.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee niramal jan soiee ||1||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself instructs; he alone is a pure and unstained being. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਅਸਥਾਪਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: racha(n)t jeea rachanaa maat garabh asathaapana(n) ||
verses.translation: Creating the soul, the Lord places this creation in the womb of the mother.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saas saas simara(n)t naanak mahaa agan na binaasana(n) ||1||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, it meditates in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak; it is not consumed by the great fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਖੁ ਤਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਉਪਰੇ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਕੁਹਥੜੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mukh talai pair upare vasa(n)dho kuhathaRai thai ||
verses.translation: With its head down, and feet up, it dwells in that slimy place.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so dhanee kiau visaario udhareh jis dhai nai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how could we forget the Master? Through His Name, we are saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: rakat bi(n)dh kar ni(n)miaa agan udhar majhaar ||
verses.translation: From egg and sperm, you were conceived, and placed in the fire of the womb.

verses.original: ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: auradh mukh kucheel bikal narak ghor gubaar ||
verses.translation: Head downwards, you abided restlessly in that dark, dismal, terrible hell.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat too naa jaleh man tan ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you were not burnt; enshrine Him in your heart, mind and body.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bikham thaanahu jin rakhiaa tis til na visaar ||
verses.translation: In that treacherous place, He protected and preserved you; do not forget Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh bisarat sukh kadhe naeh jaaseh janam haar ||2||
verses.translation: Forgetting God, you shall never find peace; you shall forfeit your life, and depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛਾ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: man ichhaa dhaan karana(n) sarabatr aasaa pooraneh ||
verses.translation: He grants our hearts' desires, and fulfills all our hopes.

verses.original: ਖੰਡਣੰ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kha(n)ddana(n) kal kaleseh prabh simar naanak neh dhooraneh ||1||
verses.translation: He destroys pain and suffering; remember God in meditation, O Nanak - He is not far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: habh ra(n)g maaneh jis sa(n)g tai siau laieeaai neh ||
verses.translation: Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so sahu bi(n)dh na visarau naanak jin su(n)dhar rachiaa dheh ||2||
verses.translation: Do not forget that Lord, even for an instant; O Nanak, He fashioned this beautiful body. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan tan dhan dheeaa dheene ras bhog ||
verses.translation: He gave you your soul, breath of life, body and wealth; He gave you pleasures to enjoy.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਦੀਏ ਰਚਿ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: gireh ma(n)dhar rath as dhe'ee rach bhale sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: He gave you households, mansions, chariots and horses; He ordained your good destiny.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sut banitaa saajan sevak dhe'ee prabh dhevan jog ||
verses.translation: He gave you your children, spouse, friends and servants; God is the all-powerful Great Giver.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat tan man hariaa leh jaeh vijog ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the body and mind are rejuvenated, and sorrow departs.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har gun ramahu binase sabh rog ||3||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Praises of the Lord, and all your sickness shall vanish. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕੁਟੰਬ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਦਮਹ ॥
verses.translit: kuTa(n)b jatan karana(n) maiaa anek udhameh ||
verses.translation: For his family, he works very hard; for the sake of Maya, he makes countless efforts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਹੀਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਤਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har bhagat bhaav heena(n) naanak prabh bisarat te pretateh ||1||
verses.translation: But without loving devotional worship of the Lord, O Nanak, he forgets God, and then, he is a mere ghost. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਟੜੀਆ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਾਈ ਬਿਅੰਨ ਸਿਉ ॥
verses.translit: tuTaReeaa saa preet jo laiee bia(n)n siau ||
verses.translation: That love shall break, which is established with any other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sachee reet saa(n)iee setee ratiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that way of life is true, which inspires love of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis bisarat tan bhasam hoi kahate sabh pret ||
verses.translation: Forgetting Him, one's body turns to dust, and everyone calls him a ghost.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋਈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: khin gireh meh basan na dhevahee jin siau soiee het ||
verses.translation: And those, with whom he was so much in love - they do not let him stay in their home, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar anarath dharab sa(n)chiaa so kaaraj ket ||
verses.translation: Practicing exploitation, he gathers wealth, but what use will it be in the end?

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa beejai so lunai karam ih khet ||
verses.translation: As one plants, so does he harvest; the body is the field of actions.

verses.original: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੇਤੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: akirataghanaa har visariaa jonee bharamet ||4||
verses.translation: The ungrateful wretches forget the Lord, and wander in reincarnation. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: koT dhaan isanaana(n) anik sodhan pavitrateh ||
verses.translation: The benefits of millions of charitable donations and cleansing baths, and countless ceremonies of purification and piety,

verses.original: ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਮੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: auchara(n)t naanak har har rasanaa sarab paap bimuchate ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with one's tongue; all sins are washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਈਧਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਮੂ ਘਣਾ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਿਤੀਮੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: e'eedhan keetomoo ghanaa bhoree dhiteem bhaeh ||
verses.translation: I gathered together a great stack of firewood, and applied a tiny flame to light it.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਵਸੰਦੜੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖੜੇ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man vasa(n)dhaRo sach sahu naanak habhe ddukhaRe ulaeh ||2||
verses.translation: When the True Lord and Master abides in one's mind, O Nanak, all sins are dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT aghaa sabh naas hoh simarat har naau ||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are totally erased, by meditating on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhe fal paie'eeh har ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: The fruits of one's heart's desires are obtained, by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhai kaTe'eeh nihachal sach thaau ||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death is eradicated, and one's eternal, unchanging true home is obtained.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorab hovai likhiaa har charan samaau ||
verses.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh naanak bal jaau ||5||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your mercy, God - please preserve and save me! Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਆਦੰ ਰਸਹ ॥
verses.translit: gireh rachanaa apaara(n) man bilaas suaadha(n) raseh ||
verses.translation: They are involved in their beautiful houses, and the pleasures of the mind's desires.

verses.original: ਕਦਾਂਚ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kadhaa(n)ch neh simara(n)t naanak te ja(n)t bisaTaa kirameh ||1||
verses.translation: They never remember the Lord in meditation; O Nanak, they are like maggots in manure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਚੁ ਅਡੰਬਰੁ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: much adda(n)bar habh kih ma(n)jh muhabat neh ||
verses.translation: They are engrossed in ostentatious displays, lovingly attached to all their possessions.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੈਂ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so saa(n)iee jai(n) visarai naanak so tan kheh ||2||
verses.translation: That body which forgets the Lord, O Nanak, shall be reduced to ashes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੇਜ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sej anek sukh ras bhogan poore ||
verses.translation: He may enjoy a beautiful bed, countless pleasures and all sorts of enjoyments.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਇਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਾਇ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gireh soin cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh lai motee heere ||
verses.translation: He may possess mansions of gold, studded with pearls and rubies, plastered with fragrant sandalwood oil.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man ichhe sukh maanadhaa kichh naeh visoore ||
verses.translation: He may relish in the pleasures of his mind's desires, and have no anxiety at all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh chit na aaviee visaTaa ke keere ||
verses.translation: But if he does not remember God, he is like a maggot in manure.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na saa(n)t hoi kit bidh man dheere ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all. How can the mind be comforted? ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਰਹੰ ਖੋਜੰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal biraha(n) khoja(n)t bairaagee dheh dhiseh ||
verses.translation: One who loves the Lord's lotus feet searches for Him in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗੰਤ ਕਪਟ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiaaga(n)t kapaT roop maiaa naanak aana(n)dh roop saadh sa(n)gameh ||1||
verses.translation: He renounces the deceptive illusion of Maya, and joins the blissful form of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਵਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
verses.translit: man saa(n)iee mukh ucharaa vataa habhe loa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is in my mind, and with my mouth I chant His Name; I seek Him in all the lands of the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak habh adda(n)bar kooRiaa sun jeevaa sachee soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, all ostentatious displays are false; hearing the Praises of the True Lord, I live. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਸਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਝੁੰਪੜੀ ਚੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਛਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: basataa tooTee jhu(n)paRee cheer sabh chhi(n)naa ||
verses.translation: He dwells in a broken-down shack, in tattered clothes,

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਦਰੋ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaat na pat na aadharo udhiaan bhrami(n)naa ||
verses.translation: with no social status, no honor and no respect; he wanders in the wilderness,

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਇਠ ਧਨ ਰੂਪਹੀਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mitr na iTh dhan roopaheen kichh saak na si(n)naa ||
verses.translation: with no friend or lover, without wealth, beauty, relatives or relations.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa sagalee sirasaT kaa har naam man bhi(n)naa ||
verses.translation: Even so, he is the king of the whole world, if his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tis kee dhooR man udharai prabh hoi suprasa(n)naa ||7||
verses.translation: With the dust of his feet, men are redeemed, because God is very pleased with him. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਰੂਪੰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਚਮਰ ਤਖਤ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: anik leelaa raaj ras roopa(n) chhatr chamar takhat aasana(n) ||
verses.translation: The various sorts of pleasures, powers, joys, beauty, canopies, cooling fans and thrones to sit on

verses.original: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: racha(n)t mooR agiaan a(n)dheh naanak supan manorath maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: - the foolish, ignorant and blind are engrossed in these things. O Nanak, desire for Maya is just a dream. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: supanai habh ra(n)g maaniaa miThaa lagaRaa moh ||
verses.translation: In a dream, he enjoys all sorts of pleasures, and emotional attachment seems so sweet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihooneeaa su(n)dhar maiaa dhroh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the beauty of Maya's illusion is fake. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: supane setee chit moorakh laiaa ||
verses.translation: The fool attaches his consciousness to the dream.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜਾਗਤ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bisare raaj ras bhog jaagat bhakhalaiaa ||
verses.translation: When he awakes, he forgets the power, pleasures and enjoyments, and he is sad.

verses.original: ਆਰਜਾ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aarajaa giee vihai dha(n)dhai dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He passes his life chasing after worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pooran bhe na kaam mohiaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: His works are not completed, because he is enticed by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kiaa vechaaraa ja(n)t jaa aap bhulaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: What can the poor helpless creature do? The Lord Himself has deluded him. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਲੋਕਹ ਜਿਤਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: basa(n)t savairag lokeh jitate pirathavee nav kha(n)ddaneh ||
verses.translation: They may live in heavenly realms, and conquer the nine regions of the world,

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭਰਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisara(n)t har gopaaleh naanak te praanee udhiaan bharamaneh ||1||
verses.translation: but if they forget the Lord of the world, O Nanak, they are just wanderers in the wilderness. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਤਕ ਕੋਡ ਤਮਾਸਿਆ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kautak kodd tamaasiaa chit na aavas naau ||
verses.translation: In the midst of millions of games and entertainments, the Lord's Name does not come to their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋੜੀ ਨਰਕ ਬਰਾਬਰੇ ਉਜੜੁ ਸੋਈ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak koRee narak baraabare ujaR soiee thaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their home is like a wilderness, in the depths of hell. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਨਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bhiaan udhiaan nagar kar maaniaa ||
verses.translation: He sees the terrible, awful wilderness as a city.

verses.original: ਝੂਠ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh samagree pekh sach kar jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the false objects, he believes them to be real.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦੇਵਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar fireh dhevaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he wanders around insane.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sir lagaa jam dda(n)dd taa pachhutaaniaa ||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death hits him on the head with his club, then he regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੈਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin poore gurdhev firai saitaaniaa ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect, Divine Guru, he roams around like Satan. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਕਪਟੰ ਰੂਪ ਕਪਟੰ ਧਨ ਕਪਟੰ ਕੁਲ ਗਰਬਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: raaj kapaTa(n) roop kapaTa(n) dhan kapaTa(n) kul garabateh ||
verses.translation: Power is fraudulent, beauty is fraudulent, and wealth is fraudulent, as is pride of ancestry.

verses.original: ਸੰਚੰਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)cha(n)t bikhiaa chhala(n) chhidhra(n) naanak bin har sa(n)g na chaalate ||1||
verses.translation: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord, nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖੰਦੜੋ ਕੀ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੁੰਮਾ ਦਿਸਮੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pekha(n)dhaRo kee bhul tu(n)maa dhisam sohanaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding the bitter melon, he is deceived, since it appears so pretty

verses.original: ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੜੋ ਮੁਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜੁਲਈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: add na laha(n)dhaRo mul naanak saath na juliee maiaa ||2||
verses.translation: But it is not worth even a shell, O Nanak; the riches of Maya will not go along with anyone. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa naal na chalai so kiau sa(n)jeeaai ||
verses.translation: It shall not go along with you when you depart - why do you bother to collect it?

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਤਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਵੰਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa kahu kiaa jatan jis te va(n)jeeaai ||
verses.translation: Tell me, why do you try so hard to acquire that which you must leave behind in the end?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har bisariaai kiau tirapataavai naa man ra(n)jeeaai ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, how can you be satisfied? Your mind cannot be pleased.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਮੰਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: prabhoo chhodd an laagai narak sama(n)jeeaai ||
verses.translation: One who forsakes God, and attaches himself to another, shall be immersed in hell.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਭੰਜੀਐ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal dhiaal naanak bhau bha(n)jeeaai ||10||
verses.translation: Be kind and compassionate to Nanak, O Lord, and dispel his fear. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਚ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nach raaj sukh misaTa(n) nach bhog ras misaTa(n) nach misaTa(n) sukh maiaa ||
verses.translation: Princely pleasures are not sweet; sensual enjoyments are not sweet; the pleasures of Maya are not sweet.

verses.original: ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: misaTa(n) saadhasa(n)g har naanak dhaas misaTa(n) prabh dharasana(n) ||1||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is sweet, O slave Nanak; the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan is sweet. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਗੜਾ ਸੋ ਨੇਹੁ ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: lagaRaa so neh ma(n)n majhaahoo ratiaa ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined that love which drenches my soul.

verses.original: ਵਿਧੜੋ ਸਚ ਥੋਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੜਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vidhaRo sach thok naanak miThaRaa so dhanee ||2||
verses.translation: I have been pierced by the Truth, O Nanak; the Master seems so sweet to me. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kachhoo na laagiee bhagatan kau meeThaa ||
verses.translation: Nothing seems sweet to His devotees, except the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: aan suaadh sabh feekiaa kar niranau ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: All other tastes are bland and insipid; I have tested them and seen them.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan bharam dhukh kaTiaa gur bhe baseeThaa ||
verses.translation: Ignorance, doubt and suffering are dispelled, when the Guru becomes one's advocate.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man bedhiaa jiau ra(n)g majeeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's lotus feet have pierced my mind, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan tan man prabhoo binase sabh jhooThaa ||11||
verses.translation: My soul, breath of life, body and mind belong to God; all falsehood has left me. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਤਿਅਕਤ ਜਲੰ ਨਹ ਜੀਵ ਮੀਨੰ ਨਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਘ ਮੰਡਲਹ ॥
verses.translit: tiakat jala(n) neh jeev meena(n) neh tiaag chaatirak megh ma(n)ddaleh ||
verses.translation: Leaving the water, the fish cannot live; the rainbird cannot live without the raindrops from the clouds.

verses.original: ਬਾਣ ਬੇਧੰਚ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੰ ਅਲਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: baan bedha(n)ch kura(n)k naadha(n) al ba(n)dhan kusam baasaneh ||
verses.translation: The deer is enticed by the sound of the hunter's bell, and shot through with the arrow; the bumble bee is entangled in the fragrance of the flowers.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨ ਰੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal racha(n)t sa(n)teh naanak aan na ruchate ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints are entranced by the Lord's lotus feet; O Nanak, they desire nothing else. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਖੁ ਡੇਖਾਊ ਪਲਕ ਛਡਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਡੇਊ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: mukh ddekhaauoo palak chhadd aan na ddeuoo chit ||
verses.translation: Show me Your face, for even an instant, Lord, and I will not give my consciousness to any other.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeevan sa(n)gam tis dhanee har naanak sa(n)taa(n) mit ||2||
verses.translation: My life is with the Lord Master, O Nanak, the Friend of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau machhulee bin paaneeaai kiau jeevan paavai ||
verses.translation: How can the fish live without water?

verses.original: ਬੂੰਦ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: boo(n)dh vihoonaa chaatirako kiau kar tirapataavai ||
verses.translation: Without the raindrops, how can the rainbird be satisfied?

verses.original: ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naadh kura(n)keh bedhiaa sanamukh uTh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: The deer, entranced by the sound of the hunter's bell, runs straight to him;

verses.original: ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhavar lobhee kusam baas kaa mil aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
verses.translation: the bumble bee is greedy for the flower's fragrance; finding it, he traps himself in it.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: tiau sa(n)t janaa har preet hai dhekh dharas aghaavai ||12||
verses.translation: Just so, the humble Saints love the Lord; beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, they are satisfied and satiated. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲੰ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: chitava(n)t charan kamala(n) saas saas araadhaneh ||
verses.translation: They contemplate the Lord's lotus feet; they worship and adore Him with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਚੁਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: neh bisara(n)t naam achut naanak aas pooran paramesureh ||1||
verses.translation: They do not forget the Name of the imperishable Lord; O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord fulfills their hopes. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੀਤੜਾ ਮੰਨ ਮੰਝਾਹਿ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਥੀਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: seetaRaa ma(n)n ma(n)jhaeh palak na theevai baaharaa ||
verses.translation: He is woven into the fabric of my mind; He is not outside of it, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਪੇਖੰਦੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aasaRee nibaeh sadhaa pekha(n)dho sach dhanee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord and Master fulfills my hopes, and always watches over me. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਸਾਵੰਤੀ ਆਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aasaava(n)tee aas gusaiee pooreeaai ||
verses.translation: My hopes rest in You, O Lord of the universe; please, fulfill them.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mil gopaal gobi(n)dh na kabahoo jhooreeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe, I shall never grieve.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas man chaau leh jaeh visooreeaai ||
verses.translation: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the desire of my mind, and my worries shall be over.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਚਰਨਾ ਧੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hoi pavitr sareer charanaa dhooreeaai ||
verses.translation: By body is sanctified, by the dust of Your feet.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀਐ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham gurdhev sadhaa hajooreeaai ||13||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, Divine Guru, You are always with me, ever-present. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਸੁਨੰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa uchara(n)t naama(n) sravana(n) suna(n)t sabadh a(n)mriteh ||
verses.translation: With my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name; with my ears, I listen to the Ambrosial Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ਜਿਨਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin sadh balihaara(n) jinaa dhiaan paarabrahamaneh ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਭਿ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਕੰਮ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਾਈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: habh kooRaave ka(n)m ikas saiee baahare ||
verses.translation: All concerns are false, except those of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak seiee dha(n)n jinaa pirahaRee sach siau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed are those, who are in love with their True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaaree tinaa j sunate har kathaa ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who listen to the sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਨਿਵਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: poore te paradhaan nivaaveh prabh mathaa ||
verses.translation: Those who bow their heads before God are perfect and distinguished.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਹਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jas likheh bea(n)t soheh se hathaa ||
verses.translation: Those hands, which write the Praises of the infinite Lord are beautiful.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan puneet pavitr chaaleh prabh pathaa ||
verses.translation: Those feet which walk on God's Path are pure and holy.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g udhaar sagalaa dhukh lathaa ||14||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, they are emancipated; all their sorrows depart. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਭਾਵੀ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavee udhot karana(n) har ramana(n) sa(n)jog pooraneh ||
verses.translation: One's destiny is activated, when one chants the Lord's Name, through perfect good fortune.

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸ ਭੇਟੰ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gopaal dharas bheTa(n) safal naanak so mahoorateh ||1||
verses.translation: Fruitful is that moment, O Nanak, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੀਮ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: keem na sakaa pai sukh mitee hoo baahare ||
verses.translation: Its value cannot be estimated; it brings peace beyond measure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਵੇਲੜੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦੜੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saa velaRee paravaan jit mila(n)dhaRo maa piree ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that time alone is approved, when my Beloved meets with me. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saa velaa kahu kaun hai jit prabh kau paiee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, what is that time, when I shall find God?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so moorat bhalaa sa(n)jog hai jit milai gusaiee ||
verses.translation: Blessed and auspicious is that moment, and that destiny, when I shall find the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har dhiaai kai man ichh pujaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, my mind's desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)g hoi niv laagaa paiee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Society of the Saints; I bow and touch their feet.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: man dharasan kee piaas hai naanak bal jaiee ||15||
verses.translation: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet gobi(n)dheh sarab dhokh nivaaraneh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Dispeller of all distress.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran soor bhagavaaneh japa(n)t naanak har har hare ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord God is Mighty, giving His Protective Sanctuary; Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਛਡਿਓ ਹਭੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਗੜੋ ਚਰਣਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhaddio habh aap lagaRo charanaa paas ||
verses.translation: Renouncing all self-conceit, I hold tight to the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਨਠੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖੰਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naThaRo dhukh taap naanak prabh pekha(n)dhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: My sorrows and troubles have departed, O Nanak, beholding God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਦੁਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mel laih dhiaal ddeh pe dhuaariaa ||
verses.translation: Unite with me, O Merciful Lord; I have fallen at Your Door.

verses.original: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਹੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: rakh levahu dheen dhiaal bhramat bahu haariaa ||
