verses.translation: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal teraa biradh har patit udhaariaa ||
verses.translation: It is Your very nature to love Your devotees, and save sinners.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਨਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin naahee koi binau moh saariaa ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all; I offer this prayer to You.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh dhiaal saagar sa(n)saariaa ||16||
verses.translation: Take me by the hand, O Merciful Lord, and carry me across the world-ocean. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਰਣ ਦਇਆਲੰ ਆਸਰੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t udharan dhiaala(n) aasara(n) gopaal keerataneh ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Savior of the Saints; their only support is to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: niramala(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen oT naanak paramesureh ||1||
verses.translation: One becomes immaculate and pure, by associating with the Saints, O Nanak, and taking the Protection of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸਰਦ ਰੁਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਘਾਂਮ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan cha(n)dh na saradh rut mool na miTiee ghaa(n)m ||
verses.translation: The burning of the heart is not dispelled at all, by sandalwood paste, the moon, or the cold season.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਪੰਦੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: seetal theevai naanakaa japa(n)dhaRo har naam ||2||
verses.translation: It only becomes cool, O Nanak, by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal kee oT udhare sagal jan ||
verses.translation: Through the Protection and Support of the Lord's lotus feet, all beings are saved.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਮਨ ॥
verses.translit: sun parataap govi(n)dh nirabhau bhe man ||
verses.translation: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe, the mind becomes fearless.

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨ ॥
verses.translit: toT na aavai mool sa(n)chiaa naam dhan ||
verses.translation: Nothing at all is lacking, when one gathers the wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੈ ਪੁਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa siau sa(n)g paieeaai vaddai pun ||
verses.translation: The Society of the Saints is obtained, by very good deeds.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਨ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har dhiaai har jas nit sun ||17||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord, and listen continually to the Lord's Praises. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਣੰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karana(n) dhukh harana(n) ucharana(n) naam keerataneh ||
verses.translation: The Lord grants His Grace, and dispels the pains of those who sing the Kirtan of the Praises of His Name.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaal purakh bhagavaaneh naanak lipat na maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: When the Lord God shows His Kindness, O Nanak, one is no longer engrossed in Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੜੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਰਖੰਦੜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaeh bala(n)dhaRee bujh giee rakha(n)dhaRo prabh aap ||
verses.translation: The burning fire has been put out; God Himself has saved me.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin upaiee medhanee naanak so prabh jaap ||2||
verses.translation: Meditate on that God, O Nanak, who created the universe. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa prabh bhe dhiaal na biaapai maiaa ||
verses.translation: When God becomes merciful, Maya does not cling.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਗਏ ਨਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT aghaa ge naas har ik dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are eliminated, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰ ਜਨ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: niramal bhe sareer jan dhooree naiaa ||
verses.translation: The body is made immaculate and pure, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servants.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bhe sa(n)tokh pooran prabh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The mind and body become contented, finding the Perfect Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਰੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਗ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: tare kuTa(n)b sa(n)g log kul sabaiaa ||18||
verses.translation: One is saved, along with his family, and all his ancestors. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: gur gobi(n)dh gopaal gur gur pooran naaraineh ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe; the Guru is the Lord of the world; the Guru is the Perfect Pervading Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur dhiaal samarath gur gur naanak patit udhaaraneh ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru is compassionate; the Guru is all-powerful; the Guru, O Nanak, is the Saving Grace of sinners. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਤਾਰਿਅਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur bohithai taariam ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat, to cross over the dangerous, treacherous, unfathomable world-ocean.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poor kara(n)m satigur charanee lagiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, one is attached to the feet of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n gurdhev jis sa(n)g har jape ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Divine Guru; associating with Him, one meditates on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਛਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal jab bhe ta avagun sabh chhape ||
verses.translation: When the Guru becomes merciful, then all one's demerits are dispelled.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਉਚ ਥਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham gurdhev neechahu uch thape ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Divine Guru, uplifts and exalts the lowly.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪ ਦਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaT silak dhukh maiaa kar leene ap dhase ||
verses.translation: Cutting away the painful noose of Maya, He makes us His own slaves.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gun gaae bea(n)t rasanaa har jase ||19||
verses.translation: With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord God. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਨੀਅੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaTa(n)t eko suneea(n)t eko varata(n)t eko narahareh ||
verses.translation: I see only the One Lord; I hear only the One Lord; the One Lord is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan jaacha(n)t naanak dhiaal purakh kirapaa kareh ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of the Naam; O Merciful Lord God, please grant Your Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਕੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: hik sevee hik sa(n)malaa har ikas peh aradhaas ||
verses.translation: I serve the One Lord, I contemplate the One Lord, and to the One Lord, I offer my prayer.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam vakhar dhan sa(n)chiaa naanak sachee raas ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak has gathered in the wealth, the merchandise of the Naam; this is the true capital. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਕੁ ਏਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaal bea(n)t pooran ik eh ||
verses.translation: God is merciful and infinite. The One and Only is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap dhoojaa kahaa keh ||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-in-all. Who else can we speak of?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap karahu prabh dhaan aape aap leh ||
verses.translation: God Himself grants His gifts, and He Himself receives them.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਥੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa hukam sabh nihachal tudh theh ||
verses.translation: Coming and going are all by the Hukam of Your Will; Your place is steady and unchanging.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan kar kirapaa naam dheh ||20||1||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for this gift; by Your Grace, Lord, please grant me Your Name. ||20||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ
verses.translit: jaitasaree baanee bhagataa kee
verses.translation: Jaitsree, The Word Of The Devotees:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਥ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: naath kachhooa na jaanau ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I know nothing.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man maiaa kai haath bikaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has sold out, and is in Maya's hands. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੌ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum kaheeat hau jagat gur suaamee ||
verses.translation: You are called the Lord and Master, the Guru of the World.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੇ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham kaheeat kalijug ke kaamee ||1||
verses.translation: I am called a lustful being of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਪੰਚਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: ein pa(n)chan mero manu ju bigaario ||
verses.translation: The five vices have corrupted my mind.

verses.original: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pal pal har jee te a(n)tar paario ||2||
verses.translation: Moment by moment, they lead me further away from the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਰਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jat dhekhau tat dhukh kee raasee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see loads of pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਅਜੌਂ ਨ ਪਤੵਾਇ ਨਿਗਮ ਭਏ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ajaua(n) na patayeai nigam bhe saakhee ||3||
verses.translation: I do not have faith, even though the Vedas bear witness to the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਮਾਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ॥ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਗਾਂਮੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gotam naar umaapat savaiaamee || sees dharan sahas bhag gaa(n)mee ||4||
verses.translation: Shiva cut off Brahma's head, and Gautam's wife and the Lord Indra mated; Brahma's head got stuck to Shiva's hand, and Indra came to bear the marks of a thousand female organs. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਦੂਤਨ ਖਲੁ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: ein dhootan khal badh kar maario ||
verses.translation: These demons have fooled, bound and destroyed me.

verses.original: ਬਡੋ ਨਿਲਾਜੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baddo nilaaj ajahoo nahee haario ||5||
verses.translation: I am very shameless - even now, I am not tired of them. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas kahaa kaise keejai ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, what am I to do now?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin raghunaath saran kaa kee leejai ||6||1||
verses.translation: Without the Sanctuary of the Lord's Protection, who else's should I seek? ||6||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag Toddee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Todee, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bin reh na sakai man meraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, my mind cannot survive.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam praan har prabh gur mele bahur na bhavajal feraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If the Guru unites me with my Beloved Lord God, my breath of life, then I shall not have to face the wheel of reincarnation again in the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai heearai loch lagee prabh keree har nainahu har prabh heraa ||
verses.translation: My heart is gripped by a yearning for my Lord God, and with my eyes, I behold my Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur dhiaal har naam dhiraRaiaa har paadhar har prabh keraa ||1||
verses.translation: The merciful True Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me; this is the Path leading to my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)gee har naam prabh paiaa har govi(n)dh har prabh keraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Lord's Love, I have found the Naam, the Name of my Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord my God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har hiradhai man tan meeThaa laagaa mukh masatak bhaag cha(n)geraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord seems so very sweet to my heart, mind and body; upon my face, upon my forehead, my good destiny is inscribed. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: lobh vikaar jinaa man laagaa har visariaa purakh cha(n)geraa ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are attached to greed and corruption forget the Lord, the good Lord God.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi manmukh mooR agiaanee kahe'eeh tin masatak bhaag ma(n)dheraa ||3||
verses.translation: Those self-willed manmukhs are called foolish and ignorant; misfortune and bad destiny are written on their foreheads. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bibek budh satigur te paiee gur giaan guroo prabh keraa ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, I have obtained a discriminating intellect; the Guru has revealed the spiritual wisdom of God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam guroo te paiaa dhur masatak bhaag likheraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the Naam from the Guru; such is the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, First House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan avar na kaahoo jaanee ||
verses.translation: The Saints do not know any other.

verses.original: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: beparavaeh sadhaa ra(n)g har kai jaa ko paakh suaamee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are carefree, ever in the Lord's Love; the Lord and Master is on their side. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: uooch samaanaa Thaakur tero avar na kaahoo taanee ||
verses.translation: Your canopy is so high, O Lord and Master; no one else has any power.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaiso amar milio bhagatan kau raach rahe ra(n)g giaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Such is the immortal Lord and Master the devotees have found; the spiritually wise remain absorbed in His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਖ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog dhukh jaraa maraa har janeh nahee nikaTaanee ||
verses.translation: Disease, sorrow, pain, old age and death do not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: nirabhau hoi rahe liv ekai naanak har man maanee ||2||1||
verses.translation: They remain fearless, in the Love of the One Lord; O Nanak, they have surrendered their minds to the Lord. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat sadhaa khuaaree ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, one is ruined forever.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੋਖਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau dhokhaa kahaa biaapai jaa kau oT tuhaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can anyone be deceived, who has Your Support, O Lord? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਲਨਾ ਸਰਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin simaran jo jeevan balanaa sarap jaise arajaaree ||
verses.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, life is like a burning fire, even if one lives long, like a snake.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲੈਗੋ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nav kha(n)ddan ko raaj kamaavai a(n)t chalaigo haaree ||1||
verses.translation: One may rule over the nine regions of the earth, but in the end, he shall have to depart, losing the game of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan gun tin hee gaae jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: He alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, upon whom the Lord showers His Grace.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਉਸੁ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: so sukheeaa dha(n)n us janamaa naanak tis balihaaree ||2||2||
verses.translation: He is at peace, and his birth is blessed; Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhaio re man dheh dhis dhaio ||
verses.translation: The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਸੁਆਦਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa magan suaadh lobh mohio tin prabh aap bhulaio || rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is intoxicated by Maya, enticed by the taste of greed. God Himself has deluded it. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: har kathaa har jas saadhasa(n)gat siau ik muhat na ih man laio ||
verses.translation: He does not focus his mind, even for a moment, on the Lord's sermon, or the Lord's Praises, or the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੋ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bigasio pekh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh ko par gireh johan jaio ||1||
verses.translation: He is excited, gazing on the transitory color of the safflower, and looking at other men's wives. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਹ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau bhaau na keeno neh sat purakh manaio ||
verses.translation: He does not love the Lord's lotus feet, and he does not please the True Lord.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaavat kau dhaaveh bahu bhaatee jiau telee baladh bhramaio ||2||
verses.translation: He runs around chasing the fleeting objects of the world, in all directions, like the ox around the oil press. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan isanaan na keeo ik nimakh na keerat gaio ||
verses.translation: He does not practice the Naam, the Name of the Lord; nor does he practice charity or inner cleansing.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanaa jhooTh lai man tokhio neh boojhio apanaio ||3||
verses.translation: He does not sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, even for an instant. Clinging to his many falsehoods, he does not please his own mind, and he does not understand his own self. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: paraupakaar na kabahoo ke'ee nahee satigur sev dhiaaio ||
verses.translation: He never does good deeds for others; he does not serve or meditate on the True Guru.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਰਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot rach sa(n)gat gosaT matavaaro madh maio ||4||
verses.translation: He is entangled in the company and the advice of the five demons, intoxicated by the wine of Maya. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: karau benatee saadhasa(n)gat har bhagat vachhal sun aaio ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer in the Saadh Sangat; hearing that the Lord is the Lover of His devotees, I have come.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪੁਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh laaj apunaio ||5||1||3||
verses.translation: Nanak runs after the Lord, and pleads, ""Protect my honor, Lord, and make me Your own.""||5||1||3||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maanukh bin boojhe birathaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, his coming into the world is useless.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਓਢਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik saaj seegaar bahu karataa jiau mritak oddaiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He puts on various ornaments and many decorations, but it is like dressing a corpse. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhai dhai kirapan sram keeno ikatr karee hai maiaa ||
verses.translation: With great effort and exertion, the miser works to gather in the riches of Maya.

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaan pu(n)n nahee sa(n)tan sevaa kit hee kaaj na aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He does not give anything in charity or generosity, and he does not serve the Saints; his wealth does not do him any good at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਆਭਰਣ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੇਜਾ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar aabharan savaaree sejaa kaaman thaaT banaiaa ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride puts on her ornaments, embellishes her bed, and fashions decorations.

verses.original: ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na paio apune bharate pekh pekh dhukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: But if she does not obtain the company of her Husband Lord, the sight of these decorations only brings her pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੁਹੁ ਮੂਸਲਹਿ ਛਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saaro dhinas majooree karataa tuh moosaleh chharaiaa ||
verses.translation: The man works all day long, threshing the husks with the pestle.

verses.original: ਖੇਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਬੇਗਾਰੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khedh bhio begaaree niaaiee ghar kai kaam na aaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is depressed, like a forced laborer, and so he is of no use to his own home. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhio anugrahu jaa kau prabh ko tis hiradhai naam vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: But when God shows His Mercy and Grace, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within the heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਅਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai paachhai pariaau jan naanak har ras paiaa ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: Search the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and find the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||2||4||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidh basahu ridhai har neet ||
verses.translation: O Lord, ocean of mercy, please abide forever in my heart.

verses.original: ਤੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taisee budh karahu paragaasaa laagai prabh sa(n)g preet || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please awaken such understanding within me, that I may be in love with You, God. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas tumaare kee paavau dhooraa masatak le le laavau ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; I touch it to my forehead.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa patit te hot puneetaa har keeratan gun gaavau ||1||
verses.translation: I was a great sinner, but I have been made pure, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਕੀਓ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa tumaree meeThee laagau keeo tuhaaro bhaavau ||
verses.translation: Your Will seems so sweet to me; whatever You do, is pleasing to me.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo too dheh tahee ih tirapatai aan na katahoo dhaavau ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever You give me, with that I am satisfied; I shall chase after no one else. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee nikaT jaanau prabh suaamee sagal ren hoi raheeaai ||
verses.translation: I know that my Lord and Master God is always with me; I am the dust of all men's feet.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat hoi paraapat taa prabh apunaa laheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: If I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall obtain God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਛੋਹਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮਰੋ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa ham chhohare tumare too prabh hamaro meeraa ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I am Your child; You are my God, my King.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ ਖੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak baarik tum maat pitaa mukh naam tumaaro kheeraa ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: Nanak is Your child; You are my mother and father; please, give me Your Name, like milk in my mouth. ||4||3||5||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maagau dhaan Thaakur naam ||
verses.translation: I beg for the Gift of Your Name, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar kachhoo merai sa(n)g na chaalai milai kirapaa gun gaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Nothing else shall go along with me in the end; by Your Grace, please allow me to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raaj maal anek bhog ras sagal taravar kee chhaam ||
verses.translation: Power, wealth, various pleasures and enjoyments, all are just like the shadow of a tree.

verses.original: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhai dhai bahu bidh kau dhaavai sagal niraarath kaam ||1||
verses.translation: He runs, runs, runs around in many directions, but all of his pursuits are useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਵਰੁ ਜੇ ਚਾਹਉ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਖਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bin govi(n)dh avar je chaahau dheesai sagal baat hai khaam ||
verses.translation: Except for the Lord of the Universe, everything he desires appears transitory.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sa(n)t ren maagau mero man paavai bisraam ||2||1||6||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints, so that my mind may find peace and tranquility. ||2||1||6||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee ko naam maneh saadhaarai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Dear Lord, is the Support of my mind.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਏਹ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan sookh is man kau baratan eh hamaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is my life, my breath of life, my peace of mind; for me, it is an article of daily use. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam jaat naam meree pat hai naam merai paravaarai ||
verses.translation: The Naam is my social status, the Naam is my honor; the Naam is my family.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam sakhaiee sadhaa merai sa(n)g har naam mo kau nisataarai ||1||
verses.translation: The Naam is my companion; it is always with me. The Lord's Name is my emancipation. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai bilaas kaheeat bahutere chalat na kachhoo sa(n)gaarai ||
verses.translation: Sensual pleasures are talked about a lot, but none of them goes along with anyone in the end.

verses.original: ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: eisaT meet naam naanak ko har naam merai bha(n)ddaarai ||2||2||7||
verses.translation: The Naam is Nanak's dearest friend; the Lord's Name is my treasure. ||2||2||7||

verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਿਟਹੀ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: neeke gun gaau miTahee rog ||
verses.translation: Sing the sublime Praises of the Lord, and your disease shall be eradicated.

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mukh uoojal man niramal hoiee hai tero rahai ieehaa uoohaa log ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your face shall become radiant and bright, and your mind shall be immaculately pure. You shall be saved here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰਾਵਉ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa maneh charaavau bhog ||
verses.translation: I wash the Guru's feet and serve Him; I dedicate my mind as an offering to Him.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਪਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhodd aapat baadh aha(n)kaaraa maan soiee jo hog ||1||
verses.translation: Renounce self-conceit, negativity and egotism, and accept what comes to pass. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t Tahal soiee hai laagaa jis masatak likhiaa likhog ||
verses.translation: He alone commits himself to the service of the Saints, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ek bin dhoojaa avar na karanai jog ||2||3||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, other than the One Lord, there is not any other able to act. ||2||3||8||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aaio saran tuhaaree ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੈ ਸੂਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: milai sookh naam har sobhaa chi(n)taa laeh hamaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Grant me the peace and glory of the Lord's Name, and remove my anxiety. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਉ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: avar na soojhai dhoojee Thaahar haar pario tau dhuaaree ||
verses.translation: I cannot see any other place of shelter; I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lekhaa chhodd alekhai chhooTeh ham niragun leh ubaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Please ignore my account; only then may I be saved. I am worthless - please, save me! ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadh bakhasi(n)dh sadhaa miharavaanaa sabhanaa dhei adhaaree ||
verses.translation: You are always forgiving, and always merciful; You give support to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sa(n)t paachhai pario raakh leh ieh baaree ||2||4||9||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak follows the Path of the Saints; save him, O Lord, this time. ||2||4||9||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa gun gopaal nidh gain ||
verses.translation: My tongue sings the Praises of the Lord of the world, the ocean of virtue.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj rahas man upajio sagale dhookh palain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Peace, tranquility, poise and delight well up in my mind, and all sorrows run away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: jo maageh soiee soiee paaveh sev har ke charan rasain ||
verses.translation: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I serve at the Lord's feet, the source of nectar.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhuhahoo te chhooTeh bhavajal jagat tarain ||1||
verses.translation: I am released from the bondage of birth and death, and so I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat tat beechaario dhaas govi(n)dh parain ||
verses.translation: Searching and seeking, I have come to understand the essence of reality; the slave of the Lord of the Universe is dedicated to Him.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖੇਮ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: abinaasee khem chaaheh je naanak sadhaa simar naarain ||2||5||10||
verses.translation: If you desire eternal bliss, O Nanak, ever remember the Lord in meditation. ||2||5||10||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak gur kirapaa te haaTio ||
verses.translation: The slanderer, by Guru's Grace, has been turned away.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਿਵ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh bhe dhiaalaa siv kai baan sir kaaTio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful; with Shiva's arrow, He shot his head off. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪੰਥਾ ਥਾਟਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai sach kaa pa(n)thaa thaaTio ||
verses.translation: Death, and the noose of death, cannot see me; I have adopted the Path of Truth.

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat kichh nikhuTat naahee raam ratan dhan khaaTio ||1||
verses.translation: I have earned the wealth, the jewel of the Lord's Name; eating and spending, it is never used up. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਸਮਾ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhasamaa bhoot hoaa khin bheetar apanaa keeaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, the slanderer was reduced to ashes; he received the rewards of his own actions.

verses.original: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aagam nigam kahai jan naanak sabh dhekhai lok sabaiaa ||2||6||11||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the truth of the scriptures; the whole world is witness to it. ||2||6||11||

verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapan tan man kilavikh bhare ||
verses.translation: O miser, your body and mind are full of sin.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਢਾਕਨ ਕਉ ਇਕੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhajan kar suaamee ddaakan kau ik hare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate, meditate on the Lord and Master; He alone can cover your sins. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਥਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anik chhidhr bohith ke chhuTakat thaam na jaahee kare ||
verses.translation: When many holes appear in your boat, you cannot plug them with your hands.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis kaa bohith tis aaraadhe khoTe sa(n)g khare ||1||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the One, to whom your boat belongs; He saves the counterfeit along with the genuine. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਲੀ ਸੈਲ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਚਾਹੈ ਓਇ ਊਹਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: galee sail uThaavat chaahai oi uoohaa hee hai dhare ||
verses.translation: People want to lift up the mountain with mere words, but it just stays there.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jor sakat naanak kichh naahee prabh raakhahu saran pare ||2||7||12||
verses.translation: Nanak has no strength or power at all; O God, please protect me - I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||7||12||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan kamal man dhiaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord within your mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਪਿਤ ਬਾਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd kuThaar pit baat ha(n)taa aaukhadh har ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine; it is like an axe, which destroys the diseases caused by anger and egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਦੁਖ ਹੰਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: teene taap nivaaranahaaraa dhukh ha(n)taa sukh raas ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the One who removes the three fevers; He is the Destroyer of pain, the warehouse of peace.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa kau bighan na kouoo laagai jaa kee prabh aagai aradhaas ||1||
verses.translation: No obstacles block the path of one who prays before God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੈਦ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh baidh naarain karan kaaran prabh ek ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has become my physician; God alone is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: baal budh pooran sukhadhaataa naanak har har Tek ||2||8||13||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of perfect peace to the innocent-minded people; O Nanak, the Lord, Har, Har, is my support. ||2||8||13||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam sadhaa sadh jaap ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਸਦੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham suaamee vasadhee keenee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Showering His Kind Mercy, the Supreme Lord God Himself has blessed the town. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke se fir tin hee sam(h)aale binase sog sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: The One who owns me, has again taken care of me; my sorrow and suffering is past.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhe jan apane har hoe maiee baap ||1||
verses.translation: He gave me His hand, and saved me, His humble servant; the Lord is my mother and father. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਦਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t hoe miharavaanaa dhayaa dhaaree har naath ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures have become kind to me; my Lord and Master blessed me with His Kind Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saran pare dhukh bha(n)jan jaa kaa badd parataap ||2||9||14||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Destroyer of pain; His glory is so great! ||2||9||14||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: savaiaamee saran pario dharabaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Court.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT aparaadh kha(n)ddan ke dhaate tujh bin kaun udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Destroyer of millions of sins, O Great Giver, other than You, who else can save me? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat bahu parakaare sarab arath beechaare ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching in so many ways, I have contemplated all the objects of life.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g param gat paieeaai maiaa rach ba(n)dh haare ||1||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the supreme state is attained. But those who are engrossed in the bondage of Maya, lose the game of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sa(n)g preet man laagee sur jan mile piaare ||
verses.translation: My mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet; I have met the Beloved Guru, the noble, heroic being.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak anadh kare har jap jap sagale rog nivaare ||2||10||15||
verses.translation: Nanak celebrates in bliss; chanting and meditating on the Lord, all sickness has been cured. ||2||10||15||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haa(n) haa(n) lapaTio re mooR(h)e kachhoo na thoree ||
verses.translation: Oh! Oh! You cling to Maya, you fool; this is not a trivial matter.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਨਹੀ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੀ ਮੋਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tero nahee su jaanee moree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: That which you consider to be yours, is not yours. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੋ ਖਿਨੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapan raam na cheeno khinooaa ||
verses.translation: You do not remember your Lord, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਰਾਈ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਨੂਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo paraiee su apanee manooaa ||1||
verses.translation: That which belongs to others, you believe to be your own. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)gee so man na basaio ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is always with you, but you do not enshrine it within your mind.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਾਹੂ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chhodd jaeh vaahoo chit laio ||2||
verses.translation: You have attached your consciousness to that which you must eventually abandon. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਸਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: so sa(n)chio jit bhookh tisaio ||
verses.translation: You collect that which will bring you only hunger and thirst.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam tosaa nahee paio ||3||
verses.translation: You have not obtained the supplies of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh moh koop pariaa ||
verses.translation: You have fallen into the pit of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak ko tariaa ||4||1||16||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, a rare few are saved. ||4||1||16||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hamaarai ekai haree haree ||
verses.translation: I have only the One Lord, my God.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan avar sin(j)aan na karee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not recognize any other. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag gur apunaa paio ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found my Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur mo kau har naam dhiraRaio ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har jaap taap brat nemaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my meditation, austerity, fasting and daily religious practice.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਮਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaai kusal sabh khemaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total joy and bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aachaar biauhaar jaat har guneeaa ||
verses.translation: The Praises of the Lord are my good conduct, occupation and social class.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh keeratan har suneeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin Thaakur paiaa || sabh kichh tis ke gireh meh aaiaa ||4||2||17||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, everything comes to the homes of those who have found their Lord and Master. ||4||2||17||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰੂੜੋ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਲੋੜੈ ॥
verses.translit: rooRo man har ra(n)go loRai ||
verses.translation: My beautiful mind longs for the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਾਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaalee har neeh na hoi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By mere words, the Lord's Love does not come. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddooddedhee dharasan kaaran beethee beethee pekhaa ||
verses.translation: I have searched for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, looking in each and every street.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur mil bharam gavaiaa he ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: eeh budh paiee mai saadhoo ka(n)nahu lekh likhio dhur maathai ||
verses.translation: I have obtained this wisdom from the Holy Saints, according to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh naanak har nain aloi ||2||1||18||
verses.translation: In this way, Nanak has seen the Lord with his eyes. ||2||1||18||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹਿਲੜੋ ਮੂੜੜੋ ਹੀਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: garab gahilaRo mooRaRo heeo re ||
verses.translation: My foolish heart is in the grip of pride.

verses.original: ਹੀਓ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਮਾਇਓ ॥ ਡੀਹਰ ਨਿਆਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕਿਓ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: heeo maharaaj ree maio || ddeehar niaaiee moh faakio re || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By the Will of my Lord God, Maya, like a witch, has swallowed my soul. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਸਦ ਲੋੜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਕੈਠੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghano ghano ghano sadh loRai bin lahane kaiThai paio re ||
verses.translation: More and more, he continually yearns for more; but unless he is destined to receive, how can he obtain it?

verses.original: ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੋ ਗਾਥੁ ਵਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਲੁਭੜਿਓ ਨਿਹਭਾਗੜੋ ਭਾਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਇਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maharaaj ro gaath vaahoo siau lubhaRio nihabhaagaRo bhaeh sa(n)joio re ||1||
verses.translation: He is entangled in wealth, bestowed by the Lord God; the unfortunate one attaches himself to the fire of desires. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸਗਲੋ ਥਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun man seekh saadhoo jan sagalo thaare sagale praachhat miTio re ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind, to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all your sins shall be totally washed away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਹਣੋ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਗਾਠੜੀਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਉੜਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jaa ko lahano maharaaj ree gaaThaReeo jan naanak garabhaas na pauRio re ||2||2||19||
verses.translation: One who is destined to receive from the Lord, O servant Nanak, shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||2||19||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਗੁਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso gun mero prabh jee keen ||
verses.translation: Such is the blessing my God has bestowed upon me.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਇਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhokh ar aha(n) rog ieh tan te sagal dhoor keen || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has totally banished the five evils and the illness of egotism from my body. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਛੋਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tor chhor bikhiaa te gur ko sabadh merai heearai dheen ||
verses.translation: Breaking my bonds, and releasing me from vice and corruption, He has enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਰੂਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗਹਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਭੀਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roop anaroop moro kachh na beechaario prem gahio moh har ra(n)g bheen ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has not considered my beauty or ugliness; instead, He has held me with love. I am drenched with His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਟ ਬੀਚ ਖੋਏ ਅਨਦ ਚਿਤਾ ਹਰਖੇ ਪਤੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: pekhio laalan paaT beech khoe anadh chitaa harakhe pateen ||
verses.translation: I behold my Beloved, now that the curtain has been torn away. My mind is happy, pleased and satisfied.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਧੀਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: tis hee ko girahu soiee prabh naanak so Thaakur tis hee ko dheen ||2||1||20||
verses.translation: My house is His; He is my God. Nanak is obedient to His Lord and Master. ||2||1||20||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mere man kee preet ||
verses.translation: O my mother, my mind is in love.

verses.original: ਏਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜਪ ਏਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ehee karam dharam jap ehee raam naam niramal hai reet || rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is my karma and my Dharma; this is my meditation. The Lord's Name is my immaculate, unstained way of life. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੈ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: praan adhaar jeevan dhan morai dhekhan kau dharasan prabh neet ||
verses.translation: The Support of my breath of life, the wealth of my life, is to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

verses.original: ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਤੋਸਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਕੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baaT ghaaT tosaa sa(n)g morai man apune kau mai har sakhaa keet ||1||
verses.translation: On the road, and on the river, these supplies are always with me. I have made my mind the Lord's companion. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh bhe man niramal kar kirapaa apune kar leet ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, my mind has become immaculate and pure. In His mercy, He has made me His own.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: simar simar naanak sukh paiaa aadh jugaadh bhagatan ke meet ||2||2||21||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, Nanak has found peace. From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the friend of His devotees. ||2||2||21||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee mil mere praan ||
verses.translation: Dear God, please meet me; You are my breath of life.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bisar nahee nimakh heeare te apane bhagat kau pooran dhaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Do not let me forget You from my heart, even for an instant; please, bless Your devotee with Your gift of perfection. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਵਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: khovahu bharam raakh mere preetam a(n)tarajaamee sughaR sujaan ||
verses.translation: Dispel my doubt, and save me, O my Beloved, all-knowing Lord, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT raaj naam dhan merai a(n)mirat dhirasaT dhaarahu prabh maan ||1||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Naam is worth millions of kingdoms to me; O God, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਅਘਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar rasanaa gun gaavai jas poor aghaaveh samarath kaan ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. They totally satisfy my ears, O my all-powerful Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: teree saran jeean ke dhaate sadhaa sadhaa naanak kurabaan ||2||3||22||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Giver of life to the soul; forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||3||22||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਗ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tere pag kee dhoor ||
verses.translation: O God, I am the dust of Your feet.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal preetam manmohan kar kirapaa meree lochaa poor || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O merciful to the meek, Beloved mind-enticing Lord, by Your Kind Mercy, please fulfill my yearning. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis rav rahiaa jas tumaraa a(n)tarajaamee sadhaa hajoor ||
verses.translation: In the ten directions, Your Praises are permeating and pervading, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, O Lord ever-present.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਰਤੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo tumaraa jas gaaveh karate se jan kabahu na marate jhoor ||1||
verses.translation: Those who sing Your Praises, O Creator Lord, those humble beings never die or grieve. ||1||

verses.original: ਧੰਧ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dh ba(n)dh binase maiaa ke saadhoo sa(n)gat miTe bisoor ||
verses.translation: The worldly affairs and entanglements of Maya disappear, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; all sorrows are taken away.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਇਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੇ ਕੂਰ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: sukh sa(n)pat bhog is jeea ke bin har naanak jaane koor ||2||4||23||
verses.translation: The comforts of wealth and the enjoyments of the soul - O Nanak, without the Lord, know them to be false. ||2||4||23||

verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mere man kee piaas ||
verses.translation: O my mother, my mind is so thirsty.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik khin reh na sakau bin preetam dharasan dhekhan kau dhaaree man aas || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without my Beloved. My mind is filled with the desire to behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: simarau naam nira(n)jan karate man tan te sabh kilavikh naas ||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the immaculate Creator Lord; all the sins and errors of my mind and body are washed away.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran paarabraham sukhadhaate abinaasee bimal jaa ko jaas ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Supreme Lord God, the eternal, imperishable Giver of peace - spotless and pure are His Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh mere poor manorath kar kirapaa bheTe gunataas ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, my desires have been fulfilled; in His Mercy, the Lord, the treasure of virtue, has met me.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj sookh man upajio koT soor naanak paragaas ||2||5||24||
verses.translation: Peace and tranquility, poise and pleasure, have welled up within my mind; millions of suns, O Nanak, illuminate me. ||2||5||24||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: har har patit paavan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is the Purifier of sinners;

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan maan sukhadhaataa a(n)tarajaamee man ko bhaavan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the soul, the breath of life, the Giver of peace and honor, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He is pleasing to my mind. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬੇਤਾ ਰਿਦ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sughaR chatur sabh betaa ridh dhaas nivaas bhagat gun gaavan ||
verses.translation: He is beautiful and wise, clever and all-knowing. He dwells within the hearts of His slaves; His devotees sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜਨ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: niramal roop anoop suaamee karam bhoom beejan so khaavan ||1||
verses.translation: His form is immaculate and pure; He is the incomparable Lord and Master. Upon the field of actions and karma, whatever one plants, one eats. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਦੂਸਰ ਲਾਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: bisaman bisam bhe bisamaadhaa aan na beeo dhoosar laavan ||
verses.translation: I am amazed, and wonder-struck by His wonder. There is none other than Him.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: rasanaa simar simar jas jeevaa naanak dhaas sadhaa bal jaavan ||2||6||25||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on His Praises with my tongue, I live; slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||6||25||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiee maiaa chhal ||
verses.translation: O my mother, Maya is so misleading and deceptive.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੇਘ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੜ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiran kee agan megh kee chhaiaa gobidh bhajan bin haR kaa jal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, it is like straw on fire, or the shadow of a cloud, or the running of the flood-waters. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਧ ਮਗਿ ਚਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd siaanap bahu chaturaiee dhui kar joR saadh mag chal ||
verses.translation: Renounce your cleverness and all your mental tricks; with your palms pressed together, walk on the Path of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਫਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee maanukh dheh kaa ih uootam fal ||1||
verses.translation: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; this is the most sublime reward of this human incarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਬਖਿਆਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹੀ ਖਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh bakhiaan karat saadhoo jan bhaagaheen samajhat nahee khal ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saints preach the teachings of the Vedas, but the unfortunate fools do not understand them.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਚੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਮਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat raache jan naanak har simaran dhahan bhe mal ||2||7||26||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is absorbed in loving devotional worship; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's dirt is burnt away. ||2||7||26||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiee charan gur meeThe ||
verses.translation: O mother, the Guru's feet are so sweet.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਡੀਠੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag dhevai paramesar koT falaa dharasan gur ddeeThe || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Transcendent Lord has blessed me with them. Millions of rewards come from the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਦ ਢੀਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat achut abinaasee kaam karodh binase madh ddeeThe ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the imperishable, indestructible Lord, sexual desire, anger and stubborn pride vanish.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਸਾਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਠੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asathir bhe saach ra(n)g raate janam maran baahur nahee peeThe ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the True Lord become permanent and eternal; birth and death do not grind them down any more. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhajan ra(n)g ras jete sa(n)t dhiaal jaane sabh jhooThe ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's meditation, all joys and pleasures are totally false and worthless; by the Kind Mercy of the Saints, I know this.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naam ratan paio jan naanak naam bihoon chale sabh mooThe ||2||8||27||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the jewel of the Naam; without the Naam, all must depart, cheated and plundered. ||2||8||27||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har har naam chitaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee a(n)kur bhalo hamaaraa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in peaceful poise and bliss, day and night; the seed of my destiny has sprouted. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa bheTio baddabhaagee jaa ko a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
verses.translation: I have met the True Guru, by great good fortune; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar geh kaadd leeo jan apunaa bikh saagar sa(n)saaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Taking His humble servant by the hand, He pulls him out of the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaaTe gur bachanee bahuR na sa(n)kaT dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are ended for me, by the Word of the Guru's Teachings; I shall no longer pass through the door of pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak saran gahee suaamee kee puneh puneh namasakaaraa ||2||9||28||
verses.translation: Nanak holds tight to the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; again and again, he bows in humility and reverence to Him. ||2||9||28||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mere man ko sukh ||
verses.translation: O my mother, my mind is at peace.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁਗਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT ana(n)dh raaj sukh bhugavai har simarat binasai sabh dhukh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I enjoy the ecstasy of millions of princely pleasures; remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam ke kilabikh naaseh simarat paavan tan man sukh ||
verses.translation: The sins of millions of lifetimes are erased, by meditating on the Lord; becoming pure, my mind and body have found peace.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਈ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਤਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhekh saroop pooran bhiee aasaa dharasan bheTat utaree bhukh ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Lord's form of perfect beauty, my hopes have been fulfilled; attaining the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my hunger has been appeased. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT mahaa sidh kaamadhen paarajaat har har rukh ||
verses.translation: The four great blessings, the eight supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the wish-fulfilling Elysian cow, and the wish-fulfilling tree of life - all these come from the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਨ ਧੁਖੁ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak saran gahee sukh saagar janam maran fir garabh na dhukh ||2||10||29||
verses.translation: O Nanak, holding tight to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace, you shall not suffer the pains of birth and death, or fall into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||10||29||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Todee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har charan ridhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the Lord's Feet within my heart.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਫਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee satigur apunaa kaaraj safal hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Contemplating my Lord and Master, my True Guru, all my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan poojaa paramesur har keerat tat beechaare ||
verses.translation: The merits of giving donations to charity and devotional worship come from the Kirtan of the Praises of the Transcendent Lord; this is the true essence of wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat atul sukh paiaa Thaakur agam apaare ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Praises of the unapproachable, infinite Lord and Master, I have found immeasurable peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan paarabraham apane keene tin kaa baahur kachh na beechaare ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God does not consider the merits and demerits of those humble beings whom He makes His own.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naam ratan sun jap jap jeevaa har naanak ka(n)Th majhaare ||2||11||30||
verses.translation: Hearing, chanting and meditating on the jewel of the Naam, I live; Nanak wears the Lord as his necklace. ||2||11||30||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯
verses.translit: Toddee mahalaa nauvaa
verses.translation: Todee, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahau kahaa apanee adhamaiee ||
verses.translation: What can I say about my base nature?

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਨਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੇ ਰਸ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aurajhio kanak kaamanee ke ras neh keerat prabh gaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am entangled in the love of gold and women, and I have not sung the Kirtan of God's Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਗ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jag jhooThe kau saach jaan kai taa siau ruch upajaiee ||
verses.translation: I judge the false world to be true, and I have fallen in love with it.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਤ ਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen ba(n)dh simario nahee kabahoo hot ju sa(n)g sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I have never contemplated the friend of the poor, who shall be my companion and helper in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਗਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨਿ ਛੁਟੀ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: magan rahio maiaa mai nis dhin chhuTee na man kee kaiee ||
verses.translation: I remain intoxicated by Maya, night and day, and the filth of my mind will not depart.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: keh naanak ab naeh anat gat bin har kee saranaiee ||2||1||31||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, now, without the Lord's Sanctuary, I cannot find salvation in any other way. ||2||1||31||

verses.original: ਟੋਡੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ
verses.translit: Toddee baanee bhagataa(n) kee
verses.translation: Todee, The Word Of The Devotees:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਰਵਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: koiee bolai niravaa koiee bolai dhoor ||
verses.translation: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਚਰੈ ਖਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal kee maachhulee charai khajoor ||1||
verses.translation: We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇ ਰੇ ਬਕਬਾਦੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)i re bakabaadh laio ||
verses.translation: Why do you speak such nonsense?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin har paio tineh chhapaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit hoi kai bedh bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: moorakh naamadheau raameh jaanai ||2||1||
verses.translation: but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaun ko kala(n)k rahio raam naam let hee ||
verses.translation: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit pavit bhe raam kahat hee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam sa(n)g naamadhev jan kau pratagiaa aaiee ||
verses.translation: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.

verses.original: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekaadhasee brat rahai kaahe kau teerath jaae(n)ee ||1||
verses.translation: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||

verses.original: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naamadheau sukirat sumat bhe ||
verses.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmat raam keh ko ko na baiku(n)Th ge ||2||2||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven? ||2||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਛੰਦੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teen chha(n)dhe khel aachhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here is a verse with a three-fold play on words. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)bhaar ke ghar haa(n)ddee aachhai raajaa ke ghar saa(n)ddee go ||
verses.translation: In the potter's home there are pots, and in the king's home there are camels.

verses.original: ਬਾਮਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baaman ke ghar raa(n)ddee aachhai raa(n)ddee saa(n)ddee haa(n)ddee go ||1||
verses.translation: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀਏ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੀਂਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਭੈਸਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਸੀਂਗੁ ਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: baane'ee ke ghar hee(n)g aachhai bhaisar maathai see(n)g go ||
verses.translation: In the home of the grocer there is asafoetida; on the forehead of the buffalo there are horns.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਲ ਮਧੇ ਲੀਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਲੀਗੁ ਸੀਗੁ ਹੀਗੁ ਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheval madhe leeg aachhai leeg seeg heeg go ||2||
verses.translation: In the temple of Shiva there are lingams. So here they are: heeng, seeng, leeng. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਲੀ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਤੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ਜੰਗਲ ਮਧੇ ਬੇਲ ਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: telee kai ghar tel aachhai ja(n)gal madhe bel go ||
verses.translation: In the house of the oil-presser there is oil; in the forest there are vines.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਕੇਲ ਆਛੈ ਕੇਲ ਬੇਲ ਤੇਲ ਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maalee ke ghar kel aachhai kel bel tel go ||3||
verses.translation: In the gardener's home there are bananas. So here they are: tayl, bayl, kayl. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਧੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਆਛੈ ਗੋਕਲ ਮਧੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa(n) madhe gobi(n)dh aachhai gokal madhe siaam go ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe, Govind, is within His Saints; Krishna, Shyaam, is in Gokal.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਮਧੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naame madhe raam aachhai raam siaam gobi(n)dh go ||4||3||
verses.translation: The Lord, Raam, is in Naam Dayv. So here they are: Raam, Shyaam, Govind. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla, First House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sun man akath kathaa har naam ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ridh budh sidh sukh paaveh bhaj gurmat har raam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Riches, wisdom, supernatural spiritual powers and peace are obtained, by vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa khiaan puraan jas uootam khaT dharasan gaaveh raam ||
verses.translation: Numerous legends, the Puraanas, and the six Shaastras, sing the sublime Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਕਰ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਮਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kar karoR tetees dhiaaio nahee jaanio har maramaam ||1||
verses.translation: Shiva and the three hundred thirty million gods meditate on the Lord, but they do not know the secret of His mystery. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਗਾਵਤ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar gan ga(n)dhrab jas gaaveh sabh gaavat jet upaam ||
verses.translation: The angelic and divine beings, and the celestial singers sing His Praises; all Creation sings of Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa karee har jin kau te sa(n)t bhale har raam ||2||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whom the Lord blesses with His Kind Mercy, become the good Saints of the Lord God. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: man mil sa(n)t janaa jas gaio ||
verses.translation: O mind, those who meet the Lord's humble servants, sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har ratan ratan har neeko gur satigur dhaan dhivaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Lord, Har, Har, the sublime jewel of the Lord, by the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kau man tan sabh dhevau jin har har naam sunaio ||
verses.translation: I offer my mind, body and everything to that humble being who recites the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan maiaa sa(n)pai tis dhevau jin har meet milaio ||1||
verses.translation: I offer my wealth, the riches of Maya and my property to that one who leads me to meet the Lord, my friend. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਕਿੰਚਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: khin ki(n)chit kirapaa karee jagadheesar tab har har har jas dhiaaio ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the world bestowed just a tiny bit of His Mercy, for just an instant, then I meditated on the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har bheTe suaamee dhukh haumai rog gavaio ||2||2||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master has met servant Nanak, and the pain of the sickness of egotism has been eliminated. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jan raam naam gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je koiee ni(n)dh kare har jan kee apunaa gun na gavaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even if someone slanders the Lord's humble servant, he does not give up his own goodness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aape suaamee har aape kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord and Master does, He does by Himself; the Lord Himself does the deeds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aape hee mat dhevai suaamee har aape bol bulaavai ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master Himself imparts understanding; the Lord Himself inspires us to speak. ||1||
